The Elrios Guardian Knight’s Costume will be added to EP Shop > Costume tab.
Elrios Guardian Knight’s items can be registered in the Magic Wardrobe and is bank shareable. Trade and Dismantle is unavailable.
Players can purchase the Elrios Guardian Knight’s Costume for the current active character in the EP Shop.
The Elrios Guardian Knight’s Costume set effects will be applied.
Weapon Costume will count towards the Elrios Guardian Knight’s Accessory set effects.

Professor Pho’s Second Growth Guide Lesson 1 1st Quest reward will be changed to ‘\[Ariel] +9 Restored Elrianode Armor & Elrios Guardian Knight’s Full Set (30 Days) Cube’ so that players can trial the Elrios Guardian Knight’s full set costume.
Following this change, players who already completed the Second Growth Guide Lesson 1 1st Quest will be able to complete it again.
The Item Exchange UI will be changed.
Item Exchange Category will be added.
Exchange Limit and Period (WEEK/DAY/LIMIT) marker will be added.
A checkbox will be added so that players can have items that are exchangeable at the top of the list.
A marker will be added so that players can see which item they’ve selected for exchanges where players can select the item to exchange for.
A detailed tooltip will display the Item Exchange Confirm, Exchange Limit Upon Result, and Limited-Time Item Exchange.
Improved Lord Chesterfield and Hidden Crowd Uniform Hair to be dyeable.
Improved the ankle size for the following character’s Cobo Intern Shoes.
Improved Shadow Incubus and Grace Fairy Hair to be dyeable.

tags.bug: Fixed a bug where the bottom piece had an unintended appearance when Lord Chesterfield Bottom Piece was equipped with certain costume shoes from another set.
Fixed a bug where visual effects would have an unintended appearance when using \[Mod] Particle Accelerator: Brutal Quake under certain circumstances.

tags.feature: Improved so that \[Mod] Abyss Scatter will reapply the buff even if the second cast is used with less combination gauge.

tags.bug: Fixed a bug where the Echo tooltip was missing in \[Enhanced] Bardiet for dungeon and PvP.
Fixed a bug where the Play Harmony Festival Ukulele Motion was slower than that of other characters.

tags.feature: Improved the motion to appear more natural after using \[Mod] Merry Haha and \[Mod] King le Pix.

tags.bug: Fixed a bug where the Guild Game: Hungry Ghost did not progress as intended.
Fixed a bug where the Dark Observer’s invincibility was not removed when all Silent Observers were destroyed under certain circumstances in the 2nd phase of Never-Ending Darkness. (Story/Normal/Solo)

Fixed a typo in \[Luriel] Inventory Expansion Ticket Select Cube.

Before:\[Luriel] Inventory Expansion (Life) x1
After:\[Luriel] Inventory Expansion Ticket (Life) x1
Fixed a bug where the Selected Item Rank Filter was deactivated after fusing items.

Fixed a bug where the duration was missing in the Guild Skill Tooltip below.

Skill NameBeforeAfterCritical CounterApply Critical buff at a certain chance when attacking/attacked.Apply a Critical buff at a set chance when attacking/attacked for 30 sec.Light StepsMovement Speed, Jump Speed Increase Every time ED is obtainedUpon acquiring ED, increase Movement Speed and Jump Speed for 5 sec.
Fixed a bug where the Selected Item Rank Filter was deactivated after fusing items.

Before: Sort by Hottest Guild: Show in the order of the guild that received the most EXP during the last 7 days.
After: Sort by Hottest Guild: Show in the order of the guild that received the most Honor Points during the last 7 days

(2025-07-16 00:00 ~ 2025-09-09 23:59)[/p][/*][*][p]Re-Order Shop: Burner [url="https://elsword.koggames.com/2025/07/ice-burner-reorder-shop-3/"]\[View][/url][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Rosa Lethe[/p][/*][*][p]Aurora Mustika[/p][/*][*][p]Gold Falcon[/p][/*][*][p]Nasod Battle Suit MK2[/p][/*][/list][p] (2025-07-16 00:00 ~ 2025-09-09 23:59)[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4961457/d40c4419bb38c4fe535e0f4b611a91dadad4880d.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]★ New Giant Boss Update - Spirit Lord’s Temple[/b][/h3][p]
A giant boss dungeon will be added to Atma’Ram: ‘Spirit Lord’s Temple’
[/p][list][*][p][b]Players cannot receive “Heroes Assemble” or “Hero in Battle” buff here.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Players cannot ride on a mount in this dungeon.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]This dungeon is not be affected by Item Drop Rate stat, Drop Rate Medal, Event, or other sources that increase the drop rate.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]There are no limits to entry and weekly rewards can be claimed up to 10 times.[/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Upon clearing the dungeon, a treasure box will appear. It will be opened once any party member interacts with F1.[/p][/*][*][p]Weekly Reward count will go down by 1 when the item drops from the Treasure Box.[/p][/*][*][p]Weekly Reward Count will reset [b]Every Wednesday at 00:00[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Weekly Reward Count will only be recovered up to 10 regardless of what remaining count the player had.[/p][/*][/list][olist][*][p][b]A new item that increases the Weekly Reward Count for Spirit Lord’s Temple: ‘Spirit Lord’s Temple Weekly Reward Count Restore Tag’ will be added.[/b][/p][/*][/olist][list][*][p]This item can be used by right-clicking on the item in the inventory. This item cannot be used if the player has max Weekly Reward Count (10).[/p][/*][/list][olist][*][p][b]Spirit Lord’s Temple Dungeon Information[/b][/p][/*][/olist][table colwidth=",,,,,"][tr][td][p][b]Dungeon Name[/b][/p][/td][td][p][b]Entry Requirement[/b][/p][/td][td][p][b]Entry Count[/b][/p][/td][td][p][b]Entry Time[/b][/p][/td][td][p][b]Demon Realm
 Debuff[/b][/p][/td][td][p][b]Players[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Spirit Lord’s
Temple[/p][/td][td][p]Lv. 99
3rd Class Entry 
Combat Power 
10,000,000 or Higher 
Tenebrous Armor or Higher[/p][/td][td][p]No Limit[/p][/td][td][p]Permanently Open[/p][/td][td][p]95%[/p][/td][td][p]1~6[/p][/td][/tr][/table][h3][b]★ Atma Accessory[/b][/h3][p]
Players can play ‘Spirit Lord’s Temple’ in Atma’Ram region to acquire Face Middle, Face Bottom, Arm, Necklace, and Top Piece accessories.
[/p][table colwidth=","][tr][td][p][b]Accessory Parts[/b][/p][/td][td][p][b]Accessory Name[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Face Middle[/p][/td][td][p]Lotus World Spirit Lord’s Third Eye - Atma of OO[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Face Bottom[/p][/td][td][p]Lotus World Spirit Lord’s Jewel - Atma of OO[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Arm[/p][/td][td][p]Lotus World Spirit Lord’s Bracelet - Atma of OO[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Necklace[/p][/td][td][p]Lotus World Spirit Lord’s Neck Ornament - Atma of OO[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Top Piece[/p][/td][td][p]Lotus World Spirit Lord’s Mandala - Atma of OO[/p][/td][/tr][/table][list][*][p][b]Each Accessory has a Rank. For the Accessory (Top Piece), there are Normal, Rare, Elite, Unique, and Legend Ranks. Other accessories have Normal, Rare, Elite, and Unique Ranks.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Atma Accessories cannot be traded or stored in the Shared Bank.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Face Middle, Face Bottom, Arm, and Necklace accessories have additional effects.[/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Note that these accessory cannot be re-identified using the Blessed Time and Space scrolls.[/p][/*][*][p]The higher the rank of these accessories, the more additional effects they have.[/p][/*][/list][table colwidth=",,,,"][tr][td][p][b]Item Rank[/b][/p][/td][td][p][b]Normal[/b][/p][/td][td][p][b]Rare[/b][/p][/td][td][p][b]Elite[/b][/p][/td][td][p][b]Unique[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Additional Effect[/p][/td][td][p]0[/p][/td][td][p]1[/p][/td][td][p]2[/p][/td][td][p]3[/p][/td][/tr][/table][list][*][p][b]Accessory (Top Piece) has a fixed effect.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Upon equipping 4 or more Atma Accessories, a set effect will activate.[/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The set effect will also have ranks. The lowest rank of the 4 Atma accessories of highest rank that activate the set effect will determine the rank of the set effect.[/p][/*][/list][olist][*][p][b]The Lotus World Spirit Lord’s Mandala - Atma of OO can be used as material along with Code of Honor and Engine Cooling System to craft the Lotus World Spirit Lord’s Mandala - Nirvana of OO of same rank.[/b][/p][/*][/olist][list][*][p]The crafted Lotus World Spirit Lord’s Mandala - Nirvana of OO accessory will have additional effects on top of the fixed effect.[/p][/*][*][p]The crafted Lotus World Spirit Lord’s Mandala - Nirvana of OO accessory can have its additional effects re-identified with Blessed Time and Space Scrolls.[/p][/*][*][p]Note that Code of Honor and Engine Cooling System that are registered in Magic Wardrobe cannot be used as materials.[/p][/*][/list][olist][*][p][b]Players can use ‘Lotus World Fragment’ - 1 guaranteed drop upon receiving weekly reward in ‘Spirit Lord’s Temple’ - to exchange for Unique Rank Accessory Cube from NPC Eris in Magmelia.[/b][/p][/*][/olist][list][*][p]Each exchange will cost 45 ‘Lotus World Fragment’.[/p][/*][*][p]Upon using the Accessory Cube, players will be able to acquire 1 Accessory Parts on equal chances.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]★ Atma Accessory Fusion System[/b][/h3][p]
The fusion system will allow players to fuse the materials acquired from dismantling the accessories dropped from the ‘Spirit Lord’s Temple’.
[/p][list][*][p]Players can talk to the NPC Eris in Magmelia to fuse the accessories.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Accessory Fusion can be done with each rank’s ‘Atma Aura’. ‘Atma Aura’ can be acquired by dismantling the accessories of each rank. The ‘Atma Aura’ will have the same rank of the rank of accessory used in dismantling.[/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Atma Aura cannot be traded or stored in shared bank. Players can acquire additional tradeable Atma Aura on a set chance.[/p][/*][/list][olist][*][p][b]Upon fusing, players will receive accessories of 1 higher rank based on the chances below.[/b][/p][/*][/olist][table colwidth=","][tr][td][p][b]Fusion Rank[/b][/p][/td][td][p][b]Chance to Upgrade to Next Rank[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Normal[/p][/td][td][p]50%[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Rare[/p][/td][td][p]20%[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Elite[/p][/td][td][p]10%[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Unique[/p][/td][td][p]5%[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Legend[/p][/td][td][p]-[/p][/td][/tr][/table][list][*][p]Fusing Legend Ranks will only yield Legend Top Piece Accessories.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fusion will cost a set amount of ED.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Players can use Fuse All to automatically fuse all of the lowest rank items.[/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Upon pressing Fuse All, Atma Aura at ranks of Normal > Rare > Elite > Unique will be selected in order. If they are of the same rank, items from the left will be prioritized.[/p][/*][/list][olist][*][p][b]Players can press Auto Register to register the lowest rank items out of the selected ones to fusion.[/b][/p][/*][/olist][h3][b]★ Other Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Changed the Effect display for FEVER.[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]★ Senpai Adventurers to the Rescue! Dungeon Support Operation Event Improvements[/b][/h3][p]
[b]Senpai, Carry Me in Dungeons! Event[/b]
[/p][list][*][p]‘Spirit Lord’s Temple’ dungeon will be added to Senpai, Carry Me in Dungeons! Quest.[/p][/*][*][p]‘Spirit Lord’s Temple’ dungeon will be added to list of available dungeons for Senpai Points♥. Senpai Players at 20 million CP or above can clear the listed dungeons with Kouhai Players to acquire Senpai Points.[/p][/*][/list][table colwidth=""][tr][td colspan="2"][p][b]Dungeons Available for Senpai Points[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Savage White-Ghost's Castle[/p][/td][td][p]The Great Steel Wall[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Altar of Invocation[/p][/td][td][p]Fabricated City[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Plegas's Labyrinth[/p][/td][td][p]Madame Corae's Garden[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Sunken Holy Ground[/p][/td][td][p]Magma Breath[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Blooming Mineral Field[/p][/td][td][p]Aqua Whistle[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Nightmare's Crib[/p][/td][td][p]Spirit Lord’s Temple [b](New)[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Birth of Origin[/p][/td][td][p][/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][b]Senpai Dungeon Support Operation Event[/b]
[/p][list][*][p]Senpai Adventurers to the Rescue! Dungeon Support Operation (Giant Boss) quest will now also have ‘Spirit Lord’s Temple’ added to the quest completion condition. Players with Combat Power above 20 million can clear ‘Plegas’s Labyrinth, The Great Steel Wall, or Spirit Lord’s Temple’ with party members’ Combat Power below 20 million 10 times to complete the quest.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]★ First Ever! +11 Submergence of Abyss Weapon Provision Event Improvement[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Special. +11 SoA Quest! Giant Boss: Entry Quest and Special. +11 SoA Quest! Giant Boss: Master Quest will have ‘Spirit Lord’s Temple’ dungeon added to the list of dungeons for Quest Completion Condition.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]★ Character[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]\[Common][/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where MEGA CAKE My Dear Sweet – Another Dance motion had an unintended display under certain circumstances.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where Noah’s Hidden Crowd and Floral Holiday Costume did not sort as intended in the Magic Wardrobe.[/p][/*][/list][olist][*][p][b]\[Eve][/b][/p][/*][/olist][list][*][p][b]\[Code: Nemesis][/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Improved so that players can use Atomic Shield after the stage has been cleared.[/p][/*][/list][olist][*][p][b]\[Add][/b][/p][/*][/olist][list][*][p][b]\[Mastermind][/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where Neutron Bomb effect does not work as intended when using Apocalypse skill.[/p][/*][/list][olist][*][p][b]\[Lu/Ciel][/b][/p][/*][/olist][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where Lu did not have a change in expression when using Ensemble Busking Piano motion.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[Turbids][/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the buff was not applied when Blanket Authority is used in rapid succession where the following Blanket Authority was used with lower Combination Gauge.[/p][/*][/list][olist][*][p][b]\[Ain][/b][/p][/*][/olist][list][*][p][b]\[Lofty: Anpassen][/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where \[Chant Explosion] will not activate under certain circumstances when Wind Einfallen skill is used in succession.[/p][/*][/list][olist][*][p][b]\[Opferung][/b][/p][/*][/olist][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the cooldown acceleration effect from \[Mod] Vorgehen was applied as 1.2 times and not as 1.3 times as in the tooltip.[/p][/*][/list][olist][*][p][b]\[Lithia][/b][/p][/*][/olist][list][*][p][b]\[Achlys][/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Rift UI had an unintended display under certain circumstances.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]★ Dungeon/PvP/Field[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the smoke effect from the player who initially turned into a zombie in the Guild Game – The Great Zombie Invasion did not have an intended appearance.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the character was stunned and could not move when transitioning to Phase 2 in Aqua Whistle.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where players who had their sizes increased could stand on the platform above the safe magic circles to bypass the mechanic during the magic circle pattern in Wilting Tower: Flight Phase 2.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the minimap did not display all the bosses in Aqua Whistle Boss Stage Phase 2.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]★ Item[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Improved the tooltip for certain Custom Motion items that did not have consistency as follows.
[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Before: Hot Spring Sit Elsword[/p][/*][*][p]After: Hot Spring Sit: Elsword[/p][/*][/list][olist][*][p]Noah’s Moonlight Fairy, Moonlight Rabbit Costume Suit and Accessories will be added to EP Shop.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the icon for Horde of Darkness Crown Cube Item appeared to be that of the normal hair cube.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where certain Erebus Elegy items had incorrect character names.[/p][/*][/olist][h3][b]★ ETC[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the HP had an abnormal display upon relogging after playing an event dungeon under certain circumstances.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Transcendence Skill Cut-In could not be applied under certain circumstances.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the search with a keyword was processed when the Favorite button was pressed after searching the keyword in the Magic Wardrobe.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where item could not be used as crafting material if hanger removal item was used under certain circumstances.[/p][/*][/list]

A giant boss dungeon will be added to Atma’Ram: ‘Spirit Lord’s Temple’
Players cannot receive “Heroes Assemble” or “Hero in Battle” buff here.
Players cannot ride on a mount in this dungeon.
This dungeon is not be affected by Item Drop Rate stat, Drop Rate Medal, Event, or other sources that increase the drop rate.
There are no limits to entry and weekly rewards can be claimed up to 10 times.
Upon clearing the dungeon, a treasure box will appear. It will be opened once any party member interacts with F1.
Weekly Reward count will go down by 1 when the item drops from the Treasure Box.
Weekly Reward Count will reset [b]Every Wednesday at 00:00[/b].
Weekly Reward Count will only be recovered up to 10 regardless of what remaining count the player had.
A new item that increases the Weekly Reward Count for Spirit Lord’s Temple: ‘Spirit Lord’s Temple Weekly Reward Count Restore Tag’ will be added.
This item can be used by right-clicking on the item in the inventory. This item cannot be used if the player has max Weekly Reward Count (10).
Spirit Lord’s Temple Dungeon Information
Players can play ‘Spirit Lord’s Temple’ in Atma’Ram region to acquire Face Middle, Face Bottom, Arm, Necklace, and Top Piece accessories.
Each Accessory has a Rank. For the Accessory (Top Piece), there are Normal, Rare, Elite, Unique, and Legend Ranks. Other accessories have Normal, Rare, Elite, and Unique Ranks.
Atma Accessories cannot be traded or stored in the Shared Bank.
Face Middle, Face Bottom, Arm, and Necklace accessories have additional effects.
Note that these accessory cannot be re-identified using the Blessed Time and Space scrolls.
The higher the rank of these accessories, the more additional effects they have.
Accessory (Top Piece) has a fixed effect.
Upon equipping 4 or more Atma Accessories, a set effect will activate.
The set effect will also have ranks. The lowest rank of the 4 Atma accessories of highest rank that activate the set effect will determine the rank of the set effect.

The Lotus World Spirit Lord’s Mandala - Atma of OO can be used as material along with Code of Honor and Engine Cooling System to craft the Lotus World Spirit Lord’s Mandala - Nirvana of OO of same rank.
The crafted Lotus World Spirit Lord’s Mandala - Nirvana of OO accessory will have additional effects on top of the fixed effect.
The crafted Lotus World Spirit Lord’s Mandala - Nirvana of OO accessory can have its additional effects re-identified with Blessed Time and Space Scrolls.
Note that Code of Honor and Engine Cooling System that are registered in Magic Wardrobe cannot be used as materials.
Players can use ‘Lotus World Fragment’ - 1 guaranteed drop upon receiving weekly reward in ‘Spirit Lord’s Temple’ - to exchange for Unique Rank Accessory Cube from NPC Eris in Magmelia.
Each exchange will cost 45 ‘Lotus World Fragment’.
Upon using the Accessory Cube, players will be able to acquire 1 Accessory Parts on equal chances.
The fusion system will allow players to fuse the materials acquired from dismantling the accessories dropped from the ‘Spirit Lord’s Temple’.
Players can talk to the NPC Eris in Magmelia to fuse the accessories.

Accessory Fusion can be done with each rank’s ‘Atma Aura’. ‘Atma Aura’ can be acquired by dismantling the accessories of each rank. The ‘Atma Aura’ will have the same rank of the rank of accessory used in dismantling.
Atma Aura cannot be traded or stored in shared bank. Players can acquire additional tradeable Atma Aura on a set chance.
Upon fusing, players will receive accessories of 1 higher rank based on the chances below.
Fusing Legend Ranks will only yield Legend Top Piece Accessories.
Fusion will cost a set amount of ED.
Players can use Fuse All to automatically fuse all of the lowest rank items.
Upon pressing Fuse All, Atma Aura at ranks of Normal > Rare > Elite > Unique will be selected in order. If they are of the same rank, items from the left will be prioritized.
Players can press Auto Register to register the lowest rank items out of the selected ones to fusion.
Changed the Effect display for FEVER.
Senpai, Carry Me in Dungeons! Event
‘Spirit Lord’s Temple’ dungeon will be added to Senpai, Carry Me in Dungeons! Quest.

‘Spirit Lord’s Temple’ dungeon will be added to list of available dungeons for Senpai Points♥. Senpai Players at 20 million CP or above can clear the listed dungeons with Kouhai Players to acquire Senpai Points.
Dungeons Available for Senpai Points
Spirit Lord’s Temple [b](New)[/b]
Senpai Dungeon Support Operation Event

Senpai Adventurers to the Rescue! Dungeon Support Operation (Giant Boss) quest will now also have ‘Spirit Lord’s Temple’ added to the quest completion condition. Players with Combat Power above 20 million can clear ‘Plegas’s Labyrinth, The Great Steel Wall, or Spirit Lord’s Temple’ with party members’ Combat Power below 20 million 10 times to complete the quest.

Special. +11 SoA Quest! Giant Boss: Entry Quest and Special. +11 SoA Quest! Giant Boss: Master Quest will have ‘Spirit Lord’s Temple’ dungeon added to the list of dungeons for Quest Completion Condition.

tags.bug: Fixed a bug where MEGA CAKE My Dear Sweet – Another Dance motion had an unintended display under certain circumstances.
Fixed a bug where Noah’s Hidden Crowd and Floral Holiday Costume did not sort as intended in the Magic Wardrobe.
Fixed a bug where Neutron Bomb effect does not work as intended when using Apocalypse skill.
Fixed a bug where Lu did not have a change in expression when using Ensemble Busking Piano motion.
Fixed a bug where the buff was not applied when Blanket Authority is used in rapid succession where the following Blanket Authority was used with lower Combination Gauge.
Fixed a bug where [Chant Explosion] will not activate under certain circumstances when Wind Einfallen skill is used in succession.
Fixed a bug where the cooldown acceleration effect from [Mod] Vorgehen was applied as 1.2 times and not as 1.3 times as in the tooltip.
Fixed a bug where the Rift UI had an unintended display under certain circumstances.
Fixed a bug where the smoke effect from the player who initially turned into a zombie in the Guild Game – The Great Zombie Invasion did not have an intended appearance.
Fixed a bug where the character was stunned and could not move when transitioning to Phase 2 in Aqua Whistle.

Fixed a bug where players who had their sizes increased could stand on the platform above the safe magic circles to bypass the mechanic during the magic circle pattern in Wilting Tower: Flight Phase 2.
Fixed a bug where the minimap did not display all the bosses in Aqua Whistle Boss Stage Phase 2.

After: Hot Spring Sit: Elsword
Noah’s Moonlight Fairy, Moonlight Rabbit Costume Suit and Accessories will be added to EP Shop.

tags.bug: Fixed a bug where the icon for Horde of Darkness Crown Cube Item appeared to be that of the normal hair cube.
Fixed a bug where certain Erebus Elegy items had incorrect character names.
Fixed a bug where the HP had an abnormal display upon relogging after playing an event dungeon under certain circumstances.
Fixed a bug where the Transcendence Skill Cut-In could not be applied under certain circumstances.
Fixed a bug where the search with a keyword was processed when the Favorite button was pressed after searching the keyword in the Magic Wardrobe.
Fixed a bug where item could not be used as crafting material if hanger removal item was used under certain circumstances.

Fixed a bug where Bifron would move and use the area explosion in the upper zone or lower zone under certain circumstances.
Fixed a bug where dead characters would resurrect in unintended locations in Phase 2 of Wilting Tower: Flight.
Fixed a bug where the flame effect would not go away if the character got hit while using the Jack-O-Lantern of Light custom motion.
Fixed a bug where Aisha’s Chiffon Costar Package had an unintended icon background color.
Fixed a bug where “Quest does not exist.” message would pop up if players rapidly pressed on Mission Complete for the Season Pass.
Fixed a bug where Certain Skill Damage Increase information could be found in the Reforge help guide.
Deleted the unnecessary comma(,) in the reward mail for Henir’s Time and Space clear.
Fixed a bug where jump would not work as intended on the donut spring in Dessert Heaven Guild Skin.
Fixed a bug where the inventory did not work as intended if Tenebrous Effect Select Ticket is used while the countdown for dungeon entry was ticking down.
Fixed a bug where the character’s position would be awkward on the moving platform for Hanging Gardens of Water Guild Skin.
Fixed a bug where the Artifact UI Slot Highlight would not update as intended if Artifact Ring was dragged onto the slot with a mouse.
Fixed a bug where PvP matching was delayed under certain circumstances.
Fixed a bug where Expedition UI and Party Finder UI did not display the intended combat power under certain circumstances.
Fixed a bug where Prof. Pho’s Quest Icon did not display under certain circumstances.

New Demon Realm Hot Springs, Spirit Haven will be updated.
New Hot Springs, Spirit Haven, can be entered through the Cobo Transportation Service or through the NPC Feihu after completing the Epic Quest: Entering Tirnog.
New Fish native to the Demon Realm Hot Springs will be added.
Fish can be acquired through fishing in Spirit Haven Hot Springs. There are no changes made to the items that can be exchanged.
New Buff ‘Magmna’s Blessing’ will be added.
‘Magmna’s Blessing’ buff can be obtained from Spirit Haven Hot Springs.
‘Magmna’s Blessing’ buff will remove any applied ‘Denif’s Blessing’, ‘Raid Party’s Resolve’, ‘Furniture Blessing’ buffs.
‘Magmna’s Blessing’ buff will not share waiting time with ‘Denif’s Blessing’.
Egg Items obtained through Hot Springs will have their cooldown be categorized into to ‘Hot Springs Egg’ group.
Clear missions every day and receive various rewards with the Elrios Pass Season 11 update!
Season Pass will go on for 16 weeks. Once the season ends, players will no longer be able to receive the rewards.
‘Elrios Pass Season 11’ will be from [b]July 16, 2025 After MA - November 4, 2025 Before 23:55.[/b]
Once Elrios Pass Season 11 ends, players will no longer be able to receive the rewards.
Click on the Elrios Pass UI at the top of the screen to enter.

The Abyss Mystic Stone Support Cube cannot be traded. However, players can open the cube to trade the contents.

tags.bug: Fixed a bug where the character would have an unintended appearance in character UI if Night Sky Drapes and Gloomy Stained Glass accessories were equipped at the same time.
Fixed a bug where “Dash Jump XZZ” Command would not be chained while in midair under certain circumstances.
Fixed a bug where the wing effect did not display upon awakening.
Removed the blackout and reduced the flashes with Holy Nemesis skill.
Fixed a bug where the Survival Instinct buff from Blood Mastery would disappear if resurrected under certain circumstances.
Fixed a bug where [Mod] Particle Accelerator: Entropy could not hit certain monsters as intended.

tags.feature: Improved so that riding on a mount is possible after using Great Birth skill.

tags.bug: Fixed a bug where the earring did not have the intended appearance in dungeons, fields, and villages if a Face Top Accessory that covers the face is equipped.

Fixed a bug where the Diorama effect did not follow the character if the character pressed Z to interact in the Mystical Aquarium Guild to gaze into the giant aquarium while Nocturn of Hernia is equipped.
Fixed a bug where players could see unapplied stat tooltip in [Luriel] 1st and 2nd Class Promotion Avatars acquired from Magmelia Gift Shop.
Fixed a bug where players could see tooltip that says “Item Obtain Rates Vary” for items where the cube only contained 1 type of item.
Fixed a bug where the item icon background did not appear as intended for Elesis’s Chrome Viper Earcuff – Obsidian.

tags.feature: Improved so that using Secret Dungeon Sweep Ticket will not cause the UI to close if players still have Weekly Reward available.
Added a comma for every 3 digits on ED and EXP so that players can see the Sweep Ticket information with more ease.

tags.bug: Fixed a bug where weapons acquired from mid bosses of Lanox, Atlas, and Elysion were not in the intended order in the Magic Wardrobe.
Fixed a bug where Raid Entry Reset Ticket could not be used if the player entered the party through Party Finder.
Fixed a bug where certain quotes from Prof. Pho upon clearing the 4th Growth Guide did not appear as intended.

tags.feature: Improved Rock Scissors Papers UI window to be movable and resizable.

[h3][b]★ Mailbox UI Improvements[/b][/h3]
[list]
 	[*]The Mailbox UI will be changed
[list]
 	[*]When opening the Mailbox UI, the most recently received unopened mail category is selected.[/*][/list][/*]
 	[*]System Mail: Menu for viewing System Mail
[list]
 	[*]The System Mail is categorized into Account, Character, Bond, Guild.
[list]
 	[*]Account: Players can view account-based mail, which can be viewed by all characters in the account.[/*]
 	[*]Character: Players can view character-based mail.[/*]
 	[*]Bond: Players can view reward mail related to Couple/Marriage and Partner/Soulmate.[/*]
 	[*]Guild: Players can view reward mail related to the Guild.[/*][/list][/*]
 	[*]The System Mail displays the Title, Attachment (Item Icon), and Deletion Date.[/*]
 	[*]Up to 300 System Mail are displayed.
[list]
 	[*]Players can view excess mail by clicking the Refresh button after deleting existing mail.[/*][/list][/*]
 	[*]The Stewardship Coin reward mail will be sent to the Account Mail.[/*][/list][/*]
 	[*]Normal Mail: Menu for viewing mail sent from other players
[list]
 	[*]The Normal Mail displays the Title, Attachment, and Sender (Sender’s Nickname).[/*]
 	[*]Up to 30 mail items are stored.[/*][/list][/*]
 	[*]Send Mail: Menu for sending mail to other players
[list]
 	[*]Players can view the Friend/Account List for the character by clicking the + button in the Recipient section. Players can click the Send to Guild Members checkbox to send a group mail to all guild members.
[list]

When opening the Mailbox UI, the most recently received unopened mail category is selected.
The System Mail is categorized into Account, Character, Bond, Guild.
Account: Players can view account-based mail, which can be viewed by all characters in the account.
Character: Players can view character-based mail.
Bond: Players can view reward mail related to Couple/Marriage and Partner/Soulmate.
Guild: Players can view reward mail related to the Guild.
The System Mail displays the Title, Attachment (Item Icon), and Deletion Date.
Players can view excess mail by clicking the Refresh button after deleting existing mail.
The Stewardship Coin reward mail will be sent to the Account Mail.
The Normal Mail displays the Title, Attachment, and Sender (Sender’s Nickname).

Players can view the Friend/Account List for the character by clicking the + button in the Recipient section. Players can click the Send to Guild Members checkbox to send a group mail to all guild members.
Items and ED cannot be attached to Guild Mail.
The title is automatically displayed as [‘Your Character’s Nickname’s Mail]. However, this can be edited.

Fixed a bug where the Achievement UI did not work as intended if the Character UI was closed after opening the Achievement UI when inspecting other characters.
Fixed a bug where the tooltip length changed based on the screen resolution when hovered over guild skills in the Guild UI.
Fixed a bug where the list of appearances in possession did not display as intended in the Magic Wardrobe viewer slot.
Fixed a bug where the Magic Wardrobe List category was automatically set to Face (Top) when certain Magic Wardrobe Tickets (Accessory) were used.

notes.title: The Stars Shine Brighter than Ever!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/YUgB0Sp.jpeg[/img]
Heya, adventurers! I do hope y'all have been helping Farmer Pho on their farm! There are a couple of weeks left still, so work hard and earn those rewards! But don't worry, cause we got something to brighten up your mood! The El★STAR Idols are coming back with new hits! Make sure to take a break, listen to the song previews, and keep an eye out for more juicy details!

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies
[/b][/h1]
I know that y'all are pumped up for the Idols but make sure to check yourself. Lithia has a new gig, and let's just say [b]Lithia Thanatos[/b] might want to visit if any of you happen to take your excitement too far.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/wdDa1GA.jpeg[/img]


I heard that the [b]City View[/b] is great, even more so if a [b]Theme Park[/b] is in town! So, make sure to grab your friends, set it up in your Guild Base and revel in the lively atmosphere it brings! Hurry, before they pack it up and move to the next city!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/iRfZuLK.jpeg[/img]

Time's a ticking! Head on over to the [b]Item Mall[/b] and get them, cause they ain't gonna stay there for long!

That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

notes.title: Stand out this Spooky Season with a new Punk-themed outfit!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/HyG7XTu.jpeg[/img]

Heya, adventurers! The 2024 Halloween Event is in full blast! But it’s also as good a week as any to take a step back and relax. Just remember to keep filling up your Pumpkin Basket every day for those tasty treats! You wouldn’t want to be tricked now… would you?

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies
[/b][/h1]
Feeling rebellious? Well, we got the outfit just for you! The [b]Punk Stomp[/b] line of clothing will be available this week! Everything does look good in black.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fJTPRoS.jpeg[/img]

But there's more! Take in the sights as you stroll through nature, a [b]Glorious Statue[/b] along the path, a nice [b]Elysion Tree[/b] to take a break on. Oh, is it raining? Grab a leaf and head to the [b]Small Corner in the Forest[/b] to let it pass. All of these custom motions are available just for Lithia!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZOCvm6U.gif[/img]

Get them at the [b]Item Mall[/b] before they get spooked!

That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZMn0Fvc.jpeg[/img]

Heya, adventurers! It may seem like a chill week, but is it really? The exciting Harmony Festival in-game events and boosts are still going strong! But that's not all—we've got even more in store for you. Don’t miss out on the fun by participating in our community events like the [b]Harmony Festival Fireworks Event [/b]and the [b]Harmony Music Festival Event[/b]. Show off your creativity and get a chance to snag some K-Ching! And of course, don’t forget to check out the fabulous new additions in the Item Mall this week!


[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies
[/b][/h1]

Your newest pet, [b]Merry[/b], is as sweet as a strawberry! But don’t be fooled by her cute looks—she’ll take down enemies with her sugar-coated attacks!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/EoB01Ct.gif[/img]

Add even more flair to Lithia’s already fire outfits! Don’t miss out on the [b]Elite Tailor, Abandoned Nobility, and Autumn Travels Costume Sets[/b], available starting this week!

That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

notes.title: Celebrate Another Bountiful Harmony Festival with the El Search Party!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/J5LEjDu.jpeg[/img]

Heya adventurers! This week is going to be extra fun and extra bountiful for everyone. Get your inventories for the [b]2024 Harmony Festival[/b]! We have tons of in-game and community events lined up for you and you'll find out more about them soon. But for now, don't forget to check out the Item Mall for all the wonderful things we have in-store!


[h1][b]Harmony Festival Events
[/b][/h1]
Fall feels are starting up! Plenty of rewards await just by logging in and doing super easy tasks!

[list]
[*] Let festival music fill the Elrios' airwaves! Strum along to Noel with your Ukulele and get [b][Cobo] Noel's Impromptu Music Sheets[/b] which you can exchange for awesome rewards! What those rewards are, you just have to find out!
[*] Don't forget to get your fishing rods ready because Helen has got some rewards to give you in exchange for certain fishes!
[*] Get ready because the Burning Boost for the duration is [b]FREE ENTRY[/b] to the [b]Heroic Dungeon, Elrianode, Pruinaum, Monaterra, and Serpentium[/b]! You also get [b]+1 Additional Dungeon Daily Special Reward[/b] which stacks with your Elrios Pass effect! Plus, there are more daily Burning Boosts which you wouldn't want to miss out on!
[*] We also have exclusive Harmony Festival Food! The [b]Harmony Festival Pie is totally FREE[/b]!
[*] The bonfire site is back! Hang out in there for a minimum of 1 minute to get dungeon-exclusive boosts like: [b]Physical/Magical Attack Power 5% Increase, EXP 50%, and Adaptation 3%[/b]!
[*] And there's truly so much more happening which you have to check out on your own!
[/list]

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies
[/b][/h1]
Nothing scares weak-willed enemies more than stern-looking heroes! Dress up in either the black or white coloration of the newest [b]Iconic Record Costume Sets[/b] this week!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vghmN0K.jpeg[/img]

Harness the shadows or control Time and Space; Lithia's ready for both! Choose to complete one or both of Lithia's newest fits: [b]Black Mass or Henir - Lord of Time and Space IB Sets[/b].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Y9zsyft.jpeg[/img]

That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

notes.title: A New Raid Has Appeared! Challenge the Tower of Serpentium!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/dPVitKG.png[/img]

Heya adventurers! Excited for the upcoming [b]Serpentium Raid[/b] update? Here's to hoping that your [b]Path to Becoming Stronger[/b] is going well!

This week will be filled with a lot of challenging updates. Cobo is ready to support you with your adventuring needs as you challenge Serpentium Raid with the [b]To Serpentium Event[/b]! 

[h1][b]To Serpentium Event
[/b][/h1]
[i]09/11/2024 – 09/24/2024 (23:59 PDT)
[/i]
To celebrate the addition of [b]Serpentium Tower[/b] and [b]Orchestra Hall[/b], Cobo is here to provide you with additional support with the [b]To Serpentium Event[/b]!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/O2n5sKU.jpeg[/img]


Characters level 99 and up can do the weekly tasks, per account, to acquire a [b][Cobo] Raid Support Consumable Cube[/b] and [b][Cobo] Serpentium Authorization Tag[/b]! What’s more is that this mission resets every Wednesday!

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies!
[/b][/h1]
[i]09/11/2024 – 11/05/2024 (23:59 PDT)
[/i]
This update doesn’t end with just the overflowing events! Who’s to say you can’t face all these challenges in style?

Lithia, for example, is ready to face the challenge wearing her new [b]Ice Cream Soda[/b] outfit!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Dv1ZcAv.png[/img]


That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

notes.title: Just Lithia and Her Casual Fits!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/vNcxv4G.png[/img]

Heya adventurers! Have you been enjoying the new [b]Serpentium [/b]update? There’s a lot of time for you to focus on your [b]Path to Becoming Stronger[/b], new region and all! There are no new events this week, as there are currently many on-going ones, but Lithia Mains will rejoice as there’s tons of [b]Item Mall Updates[/b] for the green gal!


[h1][b]Straight to Item Mall Goodies!
[/b][/h1]

Change your hair color into a captivating summer tone with the [b]Tropical Sunset Hair Palette[/b]! Get that summer glow!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ixvRdUs.png[/img]


It’s like Lithia went on a shopping spree! Three new [b]Lithia Outfits[/b] have been [b]added to the Item Mall[/b], all with their own casual and unique vibe!

The cutest apparel has arrived. Enjoy a comfy fit with the woolly [b]Cotton Tail Costume[/b]!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/GPayCaq.png[/img]


The adventurous Lithia has found a new hobby! Looking for a cooler look? [b]Street Skater Costume[/b] is right for you!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/mYIQYbY.png[/img]

Be best dressed even at a slumber party! Sleep good with the Sweet Dream Costume!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CfDSXqe.png[/img]


That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

New region Serpentium is added, and new dungeons ‘Fabricated City’, ‘Android Factory’, and ‘Madame Corae’s Garden’ are updated.
Players can enter Serpentium upon clearing Epic Quest: To a New Region > ‘Entering Serpentium’ Quest.
After clearing the [Epic] Entering Serpentium Quest, players can travel via Cobo Transportation Service or the portal on the right side of Magmelia.
If players are above the camp line, players can obtain the ‘Raid Party’s Resolve’ buff after a certain amount of time.
Players need an Entry Ticket (Serpentium Authorization Tag) to enter ‘Madame Corae’s Garden’.
Players can obtain Serpentium Authorization Tag as a daily special reward for playing Serpentium dungeons.
Exascale Armor refined from special metals found in the Land of Steel is updated.
Exascale Armor can be obtained directly from Epic Quests or crafted with Circuit Fragments through Camp: Steel Wall’s NPC Haivan.
Circuit Fragments can be obtained by disassembling Amplified Circuits and System Chips
A system that allows players to make their Exascale Armor stronger. Each Reforge Stage increases the Exascale Armor's stats and adds Reforge effects.
Reforge can be done through each villages’ Blacksmiths.
Exascale Reforge can be attempted with one of the following materials: Refined Exikel or Zetrium Steel.
This system is identical to the existing reforge system, excluding Reforge Material and Option per Reforge Stage.
Reforge Transfer is a system that allows players to move Tenebrous Armor's Reforge Stage to Exascale Armor.
Tenebrous Armor must be Reforge Stage 18 or higher and can only be transferred to the armor with the same item part.
There are 2 types of Reforge Transfer, Normal Reforge Transfer and Special Reforge Transfer.
The number of materials needed for Reforge Transfer differs depending on the Reforge Stage players wish to transfer. The transfer done will be 6 stages lower than the starting Reforge Stage.
(EX. Tenebrous Armor +18 Reforge Stage will become Exascale Armor +12 Reforge Stage upon Reforge Transfer.)
Players can earn unsealed System Chips by playing Raid Dungeons, which can then be used for [Chip Tuning] through Camp: Steel Wall’s NPC Haivan.
System chips that has completed tuning can be equipped to the new armor.
Only system chips with 0 remaining tuning counts can be equipped to Exascale.
Only unlocked System Chips can be attempted for Tuning, and can be equipped.
Equipped system chips can be overwritten by other system chips.
Upon pressing the Tuning button, it will either be success or fail based on chance.
ED is required for Tuning Attempts.
Tuning success rate is max. 70% and min. 30%.
Players can purchase ‘Amplified Circuit’ through the Shop or by playing dungeons, and can be equipped onto new armor through the Circuit Amplification UI.
Amplified Circuit has 4 different categories: color, shape, slot, and option.
Connecting a Circuit with only one color activates the Set Color for that part, and activating all 4 parts of the armor with the same Set Color activates the Set Effect.
The current Use Item key (Right Shift) will be changed to the Item Special Function key.
Players can create combinations by using circuit boards of their choice to complete their own circuit.
Circuits cannot be rotated.
Top Piece, Bottom Piece, Gloves, Shoes can only be equipped on each designated piece of equipment.
If the start and end of the circuit are connected without a break, players can receive the Option Effect.
Circuit Amplification can be done through [Equip Circuit] function from Camp: Steel Wall’s NPC Haivan.
Players can equip Owned Circuits to the Circuit Board, and is divided into parts: Top Piece, Bottom Piece, Gloves and Shoes.
Hovering the mouse over the equipped circuit shows the information about that circuit.
The combined stats of all circuits that are being applied is displayed.
Players can view information about Circuit items owned in the inventory. At this point, only the circuit with the same equipment slot as the circuit that is being assembled is visible.
Right-click on the circuit item to be equipped in the Owned Circuit List, then click on the area to equip on the circuit board.
Revert/Apply button will be activated if there is a Circuit equipped to the Circuit Board.

notes.title: Discover New Lands and Rally Beneath the Sky Fortress!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/XWThcDk.jpeg[/img]

Heya adventurers! Let us welcome another action-packed week and explore the newest region that's coming out - [b]Serpentium[/b]! Fight new enemies, explore novel surroundings, and interact with NPCs in this newly opened region. What's more is that plenty of simple tasks will reap amazing rewards, so don't miss out! And as always, don't forget to check out the wonderful new things we have the Item Mall just for you!


[h1][b]Path to Becoming Stronger Event
[/b][/h1]
[i]08/28/2024 - 09/24/2024 (23:59 PDT)
[/i]
After the Punch Master hype, we have another epic event that requires very little effort to get amazing rewards! Just [b]complete simple quest conditions[/b] to get your hands on rewards such as: [b]1,500 Tenebrous Auras, [Cobo] Consumable Bundles[/b], and more!


[h1][b]Serpentium Update Event
[/b][/h1]
[i]08/28/2024 - 09/10/2024 (23:59 PDT)
[/i]
Experience what kind of power Serpentium has to offer! Just [b]login for 10 cumulative minutes[/b] to get your hands on a [b][Cobo] Serpentium Region Trial Cube[/b]!


[h1][b]2024 Labor Day Event
[/b][/h1]
[i]09/02/2024 (00:00 - 23:59 PDT)
[/i]
Spend your well-earned holiday with Elsword and the gang because rewards and an epic burning event awaits! A total of [b]20 cumulative login minutes[/b] will get you [b]1 [Cobo] Unlimited Refined Recovery Potion and 1 [Cobo] Unlimited Fighter Potion[/b]! Enjoy [b]x2 Item Drop Rate for 24-hours[/b]!


[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies
[/b][/h1]
Head into the coast and enjoy the refreshing summer breeze as you don the newest [b]Chifon Costar Costume Set[/b]! Leave your heavy equipment behind and relax!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WtYiggG.jpeg
[/img]

Lithia leaves her worries behind as she enjoys a unique teatime experience with [b]Pink/Sky Teatime Splash Custom Motion[/b]! Now here's a different way to cool off!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/GuGWm4G.jpeg[/img]

That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

notes.title: Unleash Your Draconic Spirit and Break Power Ceilings with Hyper Punch Master!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/HlrgEZP.jpeg[/img]

Heya adventurers! Hold on to your seats because it's going to be an extremely jam-packed week as your ascend to power begins! Punch your way to the top but this time we're making it a little more challenging with the [b]Hyper Punch Master Event[/b]. But that's not all, find out how you can get your hands on a [b]+11 Vestige of Soul [/b]below. To top it all off get ready for an exciting weekend of burning with the[b] Summer Update Special Burning Event![/b] And don't forget, [b]Elrios Pass Season 8[/b] has begun, maximize your adventures and don't dawdle.  And as always, whether it's a chill of action-packed weekend, don't forget to take a look at the fun items we have at the Item Mall this week!


[h1][b]Solace PVP Championship (2v2 Tournament)
[/b][/h1]With the new PVP updates we couldn’t resist hosting a tournament to test out the new additions and feature even more classes from the last time we held one! Registration is now open until [b]August 18th (23:59 PDT) for Solace (NA)[/b] players, so find your duo partner and register! Those who make it to Top 8 are guaranteed prizes, including K-Ching or even cold hard cash! If you need help with finding a partner, reach out to our GMs to assist you!

You can register at the following link:
[b]https://elsword.koggames.com/elsword-solace-pvp-championship/
[/b]

[h1][b]Hyper Punch Master (HPM) & Clear the Raid Event
[/b][/h1][i]08/14/2024 – 10/08/2024 (23:59 PDT)[/i]
Becoming powerful is a truly arduous journey but we're here to reward your chosen character every step of the way! Reach a milestone, get rewards - it's that simple!
• Start racking up rewards through HPM if your Combat Power is anywhere [b]below 9 Million[/b]!
• Don't miss out on the Hyper Punch Master Burning Event where you'll get a buff of [b]Adaptation 20%[/b] as well as get increased Resonance Level through the [b]Resonance Burning Event![/b]
• Then immediately continue with even better rewards through Clear the Raid Event once your combat power reaches [b]above 9 Million![/b]
• Get [b]Senpai Points ♥[/b] when you clear Pruinaum and Abyss Raids and exchange your points for useful rewards!


[b][h1]+11 Vestige of Soul Weapon Provision Event
[/h1][/b][i]08/14/2024 – 10/08/2024 (23:59 PDT)[/i]
This is not a drill. I repeat, this is not a drill! Just complete [b]a cumulative login time of 60 MINUTES[/b] to get not only a [b][Cobo] Weapon Growth Quest Count x3 Medal - Vestige of Soul (1 Day) Cube[/b], but also get a [b][Cobo] +11 Vestige of Soul - Weapon of Requiem Cube[/b]. Don't miss your chance!


[b][h1]Summer Update Special Burning Event[/h1]
[/b][i]08/17/2024 (00:00 - 23:59 PDT)[/i]
Take your weekends to the level and make it hotter with a 24-hour burning event! For a whole day you can level up your ERP with a [b]Resonance Burning[/b] (does not stack with HPM Resonance Burning) and with just 10 minutes of cumulative login, you can get [b][Cobo] Unlimited Potion 2 Kinds (1 Day) Cube[/b]!


[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies
[/b][/h1]Harness the power of the epic mythical creatures with the[b] IB: Ascending Dragon[/b]. Enemies will flee at the sight majestic presence! Complete the whole set this week!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/S5WvEuN.jpeg[image]
[/img]


Move with grace and dance with purpose with the newest [b]Costume Suit: Pure White Attitude[/b]! Step left and right like a majestic swan with the included Custom Motion!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/LZpMPs0.jpeg[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/zoAbTYZ.gif[/img]

Lithia will never feel thirst again with her newest custom motion that's perfect for sweltering hot summers! Let her cool off with her very own [b]Sparkling Shower Custom Motion[/b] and let the heat dissipate!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/o50gyBq.jpeg[image][/img]

That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

As previously announced in the 2024 Summer Update notice, Boss Fight and Raid titles will become shared across characters. Boss Fight titles will be moved from the [Character] tab to the [Common] tab in the title UI.

If there are no characters that have obtained the title, the total count will be combined and be displayed. If there is a character on the account that has already acquired the title, the title will be accessible to other characters on the account.
For the “Attack of Steel Machines” title, players will receive 1 tradable title item to immediately unlock the title for each character over 1 that has acquired the title.
For the title item, the item can only be used if the “Attack of Steel Machines” title has been acquired.
With the Boss Fight and Raid title changes, the below Boss Fight and Raid equip requirements will be adjusted as below.

notes.title: Hedgehog is Here to Bring Wonderful Rewards!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/V3XvE6j.jpeg[/img]

Heya adventurers! Don't miss your chance for exciting activities and plentiful rewards this week! [b]Hedgehog Draw Lots[/b] is back so you can get free prize tickets just by logging in! Also, [b]Class Change Chance[/b] is here to let you experience something different. And as always, don't forget to check out the wonderful things we have at the Item Mall for this jam-packed week!


[b][h1]Hedgehog Draw Lots Event[/h1][/b]
[i]07/31/2024 - 08/13/2024 (23:59 PDT)[/i][list]
[*] Your daily log ins will not go unrewarded! Get prize tickets and accumulate them! You'll get a plethora of useful rewards for your adventures!
[*] When you clear dungeons within your level range 3 times daily, you'll get 1 Prize Ticket.
[*] Clearing 10 dungeons within your level range weekly will give you 2 Prize Tickets!
[*] The more you draw, the better the rewards you'll get! Get your hands on rewards like: [Luriel] Adventurer Support Potions, [Luriel] El Tree Seeds, a [Cobo] Spectral Amethyst or Tenebrous Aura Select Cube, and so much more!
[/list]


[h1][b]Class Change Event[/b][/h1]
[i]07/31/2024 – 08/13/2024 (23:59 PDT)
[/i]
Waiting for your chance to change things up? It's as easy as staying logged in to get your hands on [b]1 [Cobo] Class Change Select Cube[/b] for the first 30 cumulative minutes and [b]1 [Cobo] Physical/Magical Mystic Stone Change Ticket[/b] for the succeeding 30 cumulative minutes!


[b][h1]Item Mall Goodies[/h1][/b]
Don't waste your time under the sun. Go out and don an active look as you jog through the boundaries of sand and sea with the [b]Sporty Summer Costume Set[/b]! Coming this week to the Item Mall!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/xnusIUb.jpeg[/img]

Take a piece of the ocean out and swim your way to relaxation in the streets of Elrios with Lithia's newest [b]Ocean's Dance Custom Motion[/b]!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/iD8ZOaO.jpeg[/img]

Missed your chance to get these beloved mounts? Here's your chance to cop or more! Check out the [b]Reorder Shop for Summon Stones [/b]and grab your favorite ride this week!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/zorKdBv.jpeg[/img]

And so much more!

That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

notes.title: Stop Those Thieving Phorus! Take Their Stolen Goods and Rewards Await!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/zFlv5Z0.jpg[/img]
Heya adventurers! Are you making progress in your [b]Lithia 4th Path Events and Community Events[/b]? You don't have much time left if you want to complete it! For this week though, a fun new event is popping up randomly at dungeons. Go on and check it out when it comes out! And as always, don't forget to check out the new things we have at the Item Mall!

[b][h1]Catch the Thief Phoru Event
[/h1][/b]
[i]07/03/2024 - 07/16/2024 (23:59 PDT)
[/i]
We've seen reports of Thieving Phorus wreaking havoc inside dungeons and we need your help to stop this menace!

[list]
[*] Stop that thieving Phoru and take his [Cobo] Thief Phoru's Stolen Bundle of Essentials! inside you'll find [b][Cobo] Fighter Potions, [Cobo] Giant Stone Apples[/b], and[b] [Cobo] Thief Phoru Emergency Rations[/b]! That'll delay their pesky tactics!

[*] Defeat 3 Thief Phorus once a day to get [b][Cobo] Thief Phoru Extermination Exchange Tickets[/b]. Exchange them through Ariel for epic rewards such as [b][Luriel] Floaty Mascot Seal Stickers[/b] or [b][Luriel] Floaty Doodle Shape Seal Stickers[/b] and a bunch of high value adventuring essentials!
[/list]

[b][h2]Item Mall Goodies
[/h2][/b]
This new costume is serving up styles of cuteness and functionality! Don't choose between becoming a maid or a cat; you can be both! Don the [b]Nyan Maid and Servant Costume Set[/b] coming this week!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/J5Lexe7.jpg[/img]

That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game

notes.title: This Vengeful Mad Magician is Coming and Will Leave You Spell Bound!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/qIFHUkk.jpeg[/img]

Heya adventurers! It's going to be an exciting, jam-packed, show-stopping week filled with wonderful events and even more wonderful rewards! [b]Lithia's 4th Path Celebration[/b] is here, and we can't wait for you to try her out! The community's eagerly anticipating her launch in a couple days and has prepared a plethora of events with K-Ching and Merch rewards. Look forward to [b]Lithia's 4th Path Community Events[/b] this week! And as always don't forget to check out the many things we have at the Item Mall for this week.

[b][h1]Lithia’s 4th Path Updates
[/h1][/b]
Come one, come all! Lithia's incredibly hyped to get this show on the road. Walk the path of vengeance and unleash powerful demonic abilities all while filling your inventories with rewards!

[h3][i]06/19/2024 – 07/16/2024 (23:59 PDT)
[/i][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Lithia’s Contract Event [/b]is back. The whole El Search Party gets to participate and acquire rewards from the event quest every time a quest is completed daily! Gain a special reward once the whole chain quest is completed!
[/list]

[h3][i]06/19/2024 – 07/02/2024 (23:59 PDT)
[/i][/h3]
[list]
[*] Get ready for [b]Lithia’s Stage Preparation Event[/b]. Keep your eyes peeled or you just might miss Lithia's show stopping and twisted abilities to haul in tons of rewards!
[/list]


[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies
[/b][/h1]

"Beware of dogs". Especially when you see the newest [b]Pets Rime and Shiru[/b]! But don't underestimate these adorable poms, their attacks will leave you overwhelmed!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qC5xsiL.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/KTxNDuK.gif[/img]


Lithia is exuding a traditional demeanor but is looking extra blooming! Like a bud blossoming in Spring, [b]Lithia's Eternal Love Costume Suit[/b] will make your heart bloom even at a glance!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/VlO3vAx.jpeg[/img]

That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

notes.title: Block by Block, A Novel Weapon is Created!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/rsIKOSJ.jpeg[/img]

Heya adventurers! It's going to be a fun week with the introduction of a new event. It's very simple with an extremely unique and fun reward, so look forward to it! Also, we've already laid out a pretty rough schedule of our biggest summer updates (you can proceed to the website to check it out), so look forward for that as well. And as always, don't forget to check out the Item Mall for all the fun goodies we have instore for everyone this week!

[h1][b]Block Weapon Making Event
[/b][/h1]
[i]06/05/2024 - 07/02/2024 (23:59 PDT)
[/i]
Create your very own weapon that will certainly turn heads when completed! We've got the blueprints and all you have to do is make progress towards completion by completing quests! More details will be coming along this week so stay tuned!


[b][h1]Item Mall Goodies
[/h1][/b]
Spring has sprung and the season of knot tying has begun! Dress for the occasion and impress your loved one with the [b]Eternal Promise Costume Set[/b] in two colors! Match each other or show your contrasting personalities when it comes out this week!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/8g04355.jpeg[/img]

Pop one of the most important questions of your life with this new, romantic motion! They'll no doubt say yes when you go down on one knee with the [b]Surprise Gift for You Custom Motion[/b]!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/4MsW93a.jpeg[/img]

Lithia's arsenal of powerful Ice Burners is growing! This week, you can choose to complete her ominous [b]Dark Shadows IB Set[/b], her chilling [b]Glacial IB Set[/b], or her mech-tastic [b]Nasod Battle Suit MK2 IB Set[/b]!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/BIwG5re.jpeg[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/GV4c272.jpeg[/img]


That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

notes.title: Time is of the Essence! Punch Through Limits Quickly!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/6UZKtdA.jpeg[/img]

Heya adventurer! This week will be a great week to get stronger! Powerful Punch Master and Limit Break! Powerful Punch Master events are back to guide you and deliver rewards as you punch your way to power! Class Change Event has also returned so you could try out try out different paths to elevate your gameplay experience! And as always, don’t forget to check out the many wonderful things we have at the Item Mall!

[h1][b]Powerful Punch Master (PPM) & Limit Break! Powerful Punch Master (LB!PPM)
[/b][/h1]
[i]05/22/2024 – 06/18/2024 (23:59 PDT)
[/i]
Becoming powerful is a truly arduous journey but we're here to reward your chosen character every step of the way! Reach a milestone, get rewards - it's that simple!

[list]
[*] Start racking up rewards through PPM at 300,000 CP until 1,500,000 CP!
[*] Then immediately continue with even better rewards through LB! PPM at 1,600,00 until 3,000,000 CP!
[*] Apart from getting rewards for each Combat Power milestone achieved, you'll get additional rewards just by clearing dungeons within your level range 10 times weekly for both PPM and LB! PPM events!
[*] But that's not all! Get a powerful boost with [b]Weapon +11 Buff and Adaptation 20% Buff[/b] for the duration of the events! However, please remember that these effects do not stack on characters participating.
[/list]

[h1][b]Class Change Event
[/b][/h1]
[i]05/22/2024 – 06/04/2024 (23:59 PDT)
[/i]
Waiting for your chance to change things up? It's as easy as staying logged in to get your hands on [b]1 [Cobo] Class Change Select Cube[/b] for the first 30 cumulative minutes and a [b]1 [Cobo] Physical/Magical Mystic Stone Change Ticket[/b] for the succeeding 30 cumulative minutes!

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies
[/b][/h1]
Another powerful set has made its way to Elrios! With the new [b]Tourbillon Assemble Ice Burner Set[/b], you’ll become the master of time. Watch out for it this week in the Item Mall!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Z3tCXlR.jpeg[/img]

A cute, new companion is ready to tug on your heartstrings. Time is ticking so don't delay with taking the newest [b]Pet Nona[/b] as your new forever friend!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/JSQtqss.gif[/img]

Lithia is ready to patrol and take charge as she traverses Elrios' seas with the [b]Hamel Navy Officer Ice Burner Set[/b]! Or she can become a mythical, mystical creature with the [b]Holy Unicorn Ice Burner Set[/b]!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/2sE54b8.jpeg[/img]

That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

notes.title: A Week for Fanatics and Enthusiasts Alike!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/944oW1O.png[/img]

Heya adventurers! We’re halfway through Prof. Pho’s Attendance Event! How’s everyone holding up? Don’t forget to login daily to get your well deserved reward. For this week’s news, our Item Mall brings upon all kinds of praises for two things great: Henir and Hamsters!



[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies
[/b][/h1]
All the praises for the god of darkness, Henir! This week is the arrival of [b]Henir Fanatic Costume Suit[/b] for [b]Lithia[/b]. Join the fanatics with a slick looking robe which comes with a “For Henir” Emote! Guaranteed this won’t ever be out of style in any realities possible.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CmQCjtx.png[/img]



The hamsters are eating so good this week with this sit motion that makes you want to run endlessly! [b]Run! Run! Hamster Wheel[/b]! is the newest (and cutest) Item Mall addition in our limited roster of sit motions. Come feed the hamsters! Run for a “Course!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/U6uItlx.png[/img]


That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

[h3][b]★Secret Dungeon Reward ED Adjustment  Pre-Announcement[/b] [/h3]

From the overall ED Gain data  collected from last year 2023-12-06 Secret Dungeon Revamp  update to now, we believe that the polarization of obtainable ED has been  partly resolved.

However, we have noticed the ED Gain  from Secret Dungeons have increased 4 times since the Secret Dungeon update,  and the overall ED Gain up to 2 times. This numbers have far over-exceeded our  expectations, and brings concern that it may be a major factor in ED value  dropping in the long run. To prevent this outcome, we will be adjusting some of  Secret Dungeon ED Gain.

When looking at the ED Gain per CP stage in the Secret dungeon, the farming  based on CP has been functioning mostly as intended. We intend to adjust the ED  gain only in stage 3 and stage 4, as the amount of ED gained from stage 1 and  stage 2 have not been extensive, and we acknowledge the importance of  early-game ED acquisition. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4961457/a5e2c80ff5a879153b370a8468dc457a6eddb102.png[/img]

We understand that the issue of adjusting the amount of ED gain is a sensitive  matter and approach it as such, especially because ED acquisition is directly  connected to the game’s economy.

However, even with all  this consideration, we believe the current ED gain in Secret Dungeon will have  a major impact in future ED value and the overall game economy; therefore, it  is imperative to make adjustments now.
  
The above adjustments  will be applied with the 4-24 maintenance. We will continue to check on the issue of ED Gain  and make sure that all Elsword adventurers can enjoy a stable game environment.

notes.title: Switch Classes to Experience Something New!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ytXKSyZ.jpeg[/img]
Heya adventurers! It's time to get hyped this week because you'll be able to try out a new class with everyone's favorite, Class Change Event! But while that's happening, don't forget that [b]Powerful Punch Master and Limit Break! Powerful Punch Master[/b] events are still active! Don't delay though, it's ending really soon. And as always, remember to check in on the Items Mall for all the wonderful things we have instore for y'all this week!



[h1][b]Class Change Event
[/b][/h1]
[i]03/27/2024 – 04/09/2024 (23:59 PDT)
[/i]
Waiting for your chance to change things up? It's as easy as staying logged in to get your hands on [b]1 [Cobo] Class Change Select Cube[/b] for the first 30 cumulative minutes and [b]1 [Cobo] Physical/Magical Mystic Stone Change Ticket[/b] for the succeeding 30 cumulative minutes!

[b]Item Mall Goodies
[/b]
Manifest your nature-dwelling dreams into reality! Furnish your home like a whimsical forest complete filled cute animals with the [b]El House DIY: Forest Friends[/b]!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/7bqGay9.jpeg[/img]


Lithia's ready for classes with her very own [b]Velder Academy Uniform[/b], you'll be surprised as she is when she gets a love letter! Add pizzazz to the look with the beautifully drawn [b]Fluttering Heart (Ver. Secret) Skill Cut-In[/b] as well!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/x6urt5y.jpeg[/img]



These classic costumes are back! If you missed them before, then it's time to get your hands on these fantastic looks: [b]Goatman, Frost Pixie, 2017 Winter Casual, and Hamster[/b]. Each costume comes in 2 colorways so choose or get 'em all!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/7mPxKIM.jpeg[/img]


That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

notes.title: Enter the Year of the Wood Dragon and Celebrate with Elsword and the Gang!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Opbs149.jpeg[/img]
Heya adventurers! Advance Happy Lunar New Year! It's still a few days away but we can't contain the exciting celebration and events we have in-store for all of you! For a bit of recap: don't forget that we currently have [b]Powerful Punch Master and Limit Break! Powerful Punch Master[/b] to make you even stronger and fill your inventory with amazing goodies! Also currently happening is the Adventure Support Attendance Event where you get a random number of a featured weekly item! Don't forget to check out the other two events such as the: [b]Class Change Event and the Budding Sprout Event[/b]! And as always, don't forget to check out the many things we have at the Item Mall for this week!


[h1][b]Lunar New Year Event
[/b][/h1]
[i]02/10/2024 (00:00 - 23:59 PST)
[/i]
Celebrate the Lunar New Year with us! We've got tons of events and a plethora of amazing rewards to fill up your inventories! Better not miss this because this event only lasts for 24 hours!

Your 10 minutes of cumulative login time will reward you with a [b][Cobo] When Spring Comes Costume Suit (1 Day)[/b] and a [b][Cobo] Respectful Bow Idle Motion (1 Day)[/b].
When you clear dungeons within your level range a total of 9 times, you'll get a [b][Cobo] Respectful Bow Idle Motion Cube[/b] and a [b][Luriel] Hedgehog Lucky Bag![/b]


[h1][b]Enhancement Events
[/b][/h1]
[i]02/07/2024 - 03/05/2024 (23:59 PST)
[/i]
Level up your weapons and reach unimaginable power!

Choose to clear dungeons or win 10 PVP matches to get your hands on [b]1 [Luriel] El's Hammer (30 Days), 5 [Cobo] Blessed Fluorite Ores, and 3 [Cobo] Blessed Restoration Scrolls[/b]!
But that's not all! Login once for 10 cumulative minutes to receive 1 [Cobo] Lucky Enhancement Equipment (2) Cube! A must-have when you're trying to take your equipment to peak levels!


[h1][b]Magmelia Fireworks Event
[/b][/h1]
[i]02/07/2024 - 02/27/2024 (23:59 PST)
[/i]
Here's your chance to complete [b]Aether Nobilitas[/b]! You must first gather [b]Magmelia Fireworks Exchange Tickets[/b] which you can get from special [b]Magmelia Fireworks IB Package[/b] or [b]Lithia's Magmelia Firework's IB Package[/b] at the Item Mall. notes.title: Gain the Power to Punch Through Anything!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/giw5FYX.jpeg[/img]

Heya adventurers! Hold on to your hats because this week is going to be extremely jam-packed! You had your chill week but now, we're ramping things up with exciting events and a plethora of sweet rewards! Grab your partner and unleash your draconic spirit to welcome the [b][url=https://elsword.koggames.com/lunar-new-year-2v2-pvp/]Lunar New Year with a 2v2 tourney[/url][/b]! Sign-up (if you haven't yet) and you can win TONS of K-Ching plus the recognition of being one of Elrios' strongest warriors! And as always, don't forget to check out the Item Mall for all the wonderful things we have in-store this week!


[h1][b]Powerful Punch Master (PPM) & Limit Break! Powerful Punch Master (LB!PPM)
[/b][/h1]
[i]1/31/2024 – 02/27/2024 (23:59 PST)
[/i]
Becoming powerful is a truly arduous journey but we're here to reward your chosen character every step of the way! Reach a milestone, get rewards - it's that simple!
[list]
[*] Start racking up rewards through PPM at 300,000 CP until 1,500,000 CP!
[*] Then immediately continue with even better rewards through LB! PPM at 1,600,00 until 3,000,000 CP!
[*] Apart from getting rewards for each Combat Power milestone achieved, you'll get additional rewards just by [b]clearing dungeons within your level range 3 times[/b] for both PPM and LB! PPM events!
[*] But that's not all! Get a powerful boost with [b]Weapon +11 Buff[/b] and [b]Adaptation 20% Buff[/b] for the duration of the events! However, please remember that these effects do not stack on characters participating.
[/list]

[b][h1]Cobo Company Attendance Event[/h1]
[/b][i]1/31/2024 – 02/27/2024 (23:59 PST)[/i]

Your weekly logins have a chance to give you more![b] Just login once a week for 30 cumulative minutes[/b] and get the weekly featured cube that when opened would give you a random number of the item featured!


[b][h1]Class Change Event[/h1]
[/b][i]1/31/2024 – 02/13/2024 (23:59 PST)[/i]

Waiting for your chance to change things up? It's as easy as staying logged in to get your hands on 1 [b][Cobo] Class Change Select Cube[/b] for the first 30 cumulative minutes and a [b]1 [Cobo] Physical/Magical Mystic Stone Change Ticket[/b] for the succeeding 30 cumulative minutes!


[b][h1]Consumable Support Event
[/h1][/b][i]1/31/2024 – 02/27/2024 (23:59 PST)[/i]

Which of your characters need the most support in their journey to the top? In this event, it doesn't matter if their level 1 or 99, just input their names in the UI and they'll immediately receive [b]1 [Cobo] Budding Sprout Gift Cube[/b] that contains useful consumables they can utilize during their journeys!


[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies
[/b][/h1]
With Lithia's successful debut into the El Search Party, comes her full fledged debut as an ELSTAR idol! Check her out as a member of Mega Cake and get her all the bells and whistles that idol life has to offer: Custom Motions, Accessories, and more!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/3EdXKFp.jpeg[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/a4UsBAg.jpeg[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Cq6W9Us.jpeg[/img]


[b]ELSTAR [/b]is coming back for everyone! [b]ACE, MEGA CAKE, ALTER CROWN[/b], and [b]MAZE [/b]costumes, accessories, custom motions, and more have returned so that your characters can take a break from being a hero and experience the idol life for a change!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/1dBUGQe.jpeg[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/QyIfh7m.jpeg[/img]


That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

notes.title: Lithia's Debut is Imminent! Be Sure to Pre-Register!
notes.content:
Heya adventurer! We're a week away from Christmas so get ready for a busy and abundant week ahead! And whether you celebrate the occasion or not, we've got tons of event for you to enjoy and even more rewards to get your hands on! Also, don't forget to [b][url=https://elsword.koggames.com/lithia-pre-registration-event/]Pre-Register for Lithia's launch[/url][/b] or you won't get the extra special rewards! And as always, don't forget to check out the Item Mall for all the wonderful things we have in-store!


[h1][b]The Mysterious Rift that Appeared in Elrios
[/b][/h1]
Woah! There's a rift in Elrios that appeared out of nowhere! Simply fill the [b]Rift Shard[/b] by completing quests! Once filled you can get your hands on rewards such as [b][Cobo] Lithia's Soul Select Cube, [Luriel] Sage's Magic Stones, [Luriel] Fighter Potions[/b], and so much more!


[h1][b]Elrios Pass Season 6
[/b][/h1]
You’re in luck because this week, Elrios Pass Season 6 is here! Get your hands on even more rewards when you complete new Season Missions!


[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies
[/b][/h1]
Don't let the winter chills prevail! Envelop yourself in warmth and look cute to boot while you traverse the lands of Elrios! Get your hands on [b]Winter Preppy Look Costume Set[/b]!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/f2Q8HAm.jpg[/img]

Worried about what to wear this Christmas? We got you! These dapper looking garments are back! Don one of these impressive attires this week: [b]Christmas, 2012 Christmas, Christmas Dress/Tuxedo, Winter Salvation, X-Mas Fairy of Holy Nights, Christmas Velvet, or Christmas Party[/b]!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/AJpvLy1.jpg[/img]

[b]and more!
[/b]


That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

notes.title: Discover and Enjoy a New Secret Dungeon Experience!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/VaJj4f7.jpg[/img]
Heya adventurers! We've got something big planned before the year ends, but it'll remain a secret for now. However, for this week, we've got some exciting events planned that we know you wouldn't want to miss! And as always, don't forget to take a quick peek at the Item Mall for all the fun goodies we have in-store for this week!


[h1][b]Into the New Secret! Event!
[/b][/h1]
We're revamping Secret Dungeons and adding a new one before the year ends! Try it out on the day of release and haul in awesome rewards!

Completing conditions for the weekly quests will grant you high value consumables and a trial title!


[h1][b]Class Change Event[/b][/h1]

Here's your chance to experience a new class! Just login for a total of 60 cumulative minutes and we'll reward you with [b]1 [Cobo] Class Change Selective Cube[/b] (for the first 30 minutes) and [b]1 [Cobo] Physical/Magical Stone Change Ticket[/b] (for the succeeding 30 minutes)! The best part is you can claim these rewards again the following week!


[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies
[/b][/h1]
Take heed for the rulers of the sky has descended and ready to grant you powers! The new [b]Aether Nobilitas Ice Burner Set[/b] will help you rule not only land but the skies and seas starting this week!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NCxaeqF.jpg[/img]



Tired of the home-y set-up you got going on for your humble abode? Why don't you turn it into an exciting coin-operated laundry place? With [b]El House DIY: Coin Laundry[/b], your house will be smelling like fresh laundry 24/7!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/eqV9Lo0.jpg[/img]


That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

notes.title: Enjoy a Bountiful Week in Elrios! It's Raining Rewards so Don't Miss It!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/V89QCai.jpg[/img]
Heya adventurers! This is going to be a week full of bounty and rewards! The [b]Guild Revamp[/b] is coming this week, so try it out and you'll even get rewarded for it! Apart from that, [b]El Mega Day[/b] and [b]Black Friday[/b] Event is happening this week as well! Run, don't walk to the Item Mall this week because these are steals and deals you don't want to miss!


[h1][b]Bountiful Guild Life Event
[/b][/h1]
Enjoy an even better guild experience with the revamp! To celebrate the improvements and changes, we've got rewards you wouldn't want to miss!

Login daily and complete guild quests to eventually get the event-exclusive [b]Great Zombie Invasion Costume Suit[/b] and the I'm a Zombie! Custom Motion!
You'll also get consumables to help you on Elrios journey!
But that's not all! You can enjoy additional harvest on your guild farm during the duration of the event!


[h1][b]2023 El Mega Day & Black Friday Event
[/b][/h1]
The biggest day for deals and steals in Elrios is happening this week! Want to know what's in store for you? We'll keep mum about it for now but stay tuned and watch out for what's gonna happen on [i][b]November 23 and 24 PST[/b][/i]!



[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies
[/b][/h1]
Feeling drab and looking extremely bulky with old wardrobe? Elevate your style and your confidence with [b]Brand Elfenium Costume Set[/b]! Throw away your old style and look posh this starting this week!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/cL8wKV3.jpg[/img]


That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

notes.title: This is Halloween! Start the Hair-Raising Season with Spook-tacular Art!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/necE1Yf.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! Halloween is just a few hours away. Why don’t you take a breather and celebrate a wonderfully chilly week with us! This may be a chill week (excuse the pun) but that doesn’t mean you’ll just go empty handed. With the [url=https://elsword.koggames.com/halloween-costume-art-contest/]Halloween Costume Art Contest[/url] going on, artists only have a couple more days left before art submissions close! And then once it does, it’s the rest of the player base to predict who will be chosen as Top 1! The more players join the Prediction Event the higher the prize pool! Meaning, everyone who predicted correctly gets a big slice of that K-Ching autumn pie! So, what are you waiting for? And as always don’t forget to check out the many things we have at the Item Mall!


[url=https://elsword.koggames.com/halloween-costume-art-contest/][img]https://i.imgur.com/NJkvd7p.jpg[/img][/url]


[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]

Are you itching to get [b]Street Skater, Antique Library, or Sweet Waitress / Sweet Barista[/b] but missed your chance before? Well, sigh no more adventurer! These beautifully crafted costume sets are back to grace your wardrobe! Watch out for them this week!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/pfGcrnb.jpg[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/DqcfSjW.jpg[/img]


That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!
