notes.title: Get Ready for a Bountiful Festival Month! Harmony Festival is Back!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/SqeoIFp.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! Whether you like the smell and taste of Pumpkin Spice, it's that time of year again! You know what else is back? The [b]Harmony Festival [/b]is! But that's not all, [b]Prof. Pho Attendance Event[/b] is also returning because we really want to fill all your inventories in preparation for the coming cold season! And as always, don't forget to check out the many things we have at the Item Mall for this week!


[h1][b]Harmony Festival Events
[/b][/h1]Fall feels are starting up! Plenty of rewards await just by logging in and doing super easy tasks! 
[list]
[*] Want to help out during the festival? Deliver food to the customers to get[b] [Cobo] Harmony Festival Exchange Tickets[/b] which you can exchange for awesome rewards! What those rewards are, you just have to find out!
[*] Don't forget to get your fishing rods ready because Helen has got some rewards to give you in exchange for certain fishes!
[*] Get ready because the Burning Boost for the duration is FREE ENTRY to Elrianode, Secret Dungeons, Heroic Dungeons, Pruinaum, and Monaterra! You also get +1 Additional Dungeon Daily Special Reward which stacks with your Elrios Pass effect! Plus, there are more daily Burning Boosts which you wouldn't want to miss out on!
[*] We also have exclusive Harmony Festival Food! [b]The Harmony Festival Pie is totally FREE[/b]!
[*] The bonfire site is back! Hang out in there for a minimum of 1 minute to get boosts like: Physical/Magical Attack Power 5% Increased in Dungeon and Fields, EXP 50%, and Adaptation 3%!
[*] And there's truly so much more happening which you have to check out on your own!
[/list]

[h1][b]Prof. Pho's Attendance Event
[/b][/h1]You want rewards? Well, we got ‘em! All you have to do is log-in every day for 14 days to get goodies like: [b]Spectral Amethysts, Dungeon Entrance Tickets, [Luriel] Sage's Magic Stones[/b], Elixirs, Potions, and so much more!


[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies
[/b][/h1]Go get your cottagecore aesthetics! With the new [b]Cozy Garden Costume Set[/b], you'll look like you're having a cozy time even in the midst of an intense battle!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TTTI2RS.jpg[/img]

That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

notes.title: A New Dungeon Opens in Monaterra! Prepare for a Colossal Battle!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/D3D8Nwa.jpg[/img]
Heya adventurers! The action-packed weeks just continues! How are y'all loving these back-to-back events? Are your inventories filled to the brim? This week, you better hold on to your bags because we're smashing through the [b]Great Steel Wall[/b] to defeat a new boss! And as always, don't forget to take a gander at the Item Mall for all the fun and new things we have instore!


[h1][b]The Great Steel Wall Event
[/b][/h1]
Get ready for another great challenge in the land of demons. The best part of course is after the fight, and you get rewarded for your hard! Clamber on to the Great Steel Wall and prove your mettle!

Get a taste of Monattera with a [b][Cobo] The Great Steel Wall Trial Cube[/b] as well as other rewards including [b]Sage's Magic Stones, Spectral Amethysts, Tenebrous Auras[/b], and more!
Once you're ready to conquer the Great Steel Wall, get rewarded with [b][Luriel] Steel Wall Keys[/b] so you can keep coming back!


[h1][b]Super Growth Event
[/b][/h1]
Come to Elrios and grow in power! The growth continues with a newly created character that will receive all these help and amazing rewards!

Create a new character that will be receiving all the amazing rewards we have to offer!
Reach level milestones with that character and haul your rewards! Once again fill your inventory with high value consumables, an epic weapon, [b]Camilla's Secret Manuals[/b], and so much more!


[h1][b]Plus Alpha Event
[/b][/h1]
The Plus Alpha Event continues but with the brand-new [b]Nox Venator Ice Burner![/b] Here's your chance to complete this amazing set!


[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies
[/b][/h1]
Careful where you thread at night especially if you plan to do something shady. The El Search Party patrols the night donning the [b]Nox Venator Ice Burner Set[/b] ready to take down enemies in a heartbeat! Complete it this week!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/FjbD9Eb.jpg[/img]

That's all for now folks~

See y'all in-game!

notes.title: The El Search Party Continues and Enter a New Region!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/sn3Ft9e.jpg[/img]
Heya adventurers! Hold on to your mounts because it's going to an extremely jam-packed week! First, we open the gates to [b]Monaterra [/b]where you'll find out what's next for the El Search Party as they continue their story! Next, is of course the many events and rewards that follow as the new region is unveiled! And, lastly, don't forget to check out the Item Mall for all the goodies we have for you this week!



[h1][b]Monaterra Update Event
[/b][/h1]
Elsword and the gang continue their adventures as they brave a new region. Participate in the events and plenty of epic rewards will follow!

notes.title: The Phorus Go Up as well as the Incoming Intensity of Summer! Check It All Out!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/RDfbqk7.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! Summer is here and to celebrate, we've got a jam-packed week! First of all, you've got another chance to choose a different path - try something new for a change! Then, you can pile up cute Phorus as high as you can to get awesome rewards! And lastly, to prep you for our amazing summer updates, we've got the exciting Summer Pre-Event for you! And as always, don't forget to check out the fun things we have at the Item Mall!


[h1][b]Build a Phoru Tower Event
[/b][/h1]
Play this fun mini game to get[b] [Cobo] Special Gift Exchange Tickets![/b] You can exchange it through Ariel for a plethora of rewards! Which includes potions, [b]Shining Mystic Stones, Sage's Magic Stones,[/b] exclusive accessories, and so much more!



[h1][b]2023 Summer Pre-Event
[/b][/h1]
Can you feel it? The summer is heating up! Join the event to get event exclusive rewards!

Login once this weekend to get a[b] [Cobo] +10 Flames of Judgement - Demonic Weapon Cube[/b]! The character you use to open this cube will get the weapon that's right for them!
That's not all, you can complete the daily quests to get your hands on[b] [Cobo] Pre-Event Preparation Coins[/b] to exchange for more rewards through Ariel!
Get rewards like potions, tickets, consumables, and you can even get a NEW pet!


[h1][b]Class Change Chance Event
[/b][/h1]
Wanting to try out a new class? Here's your chance! When you login for 30 minutes you'll get a[b] [Cobo] Class Change Select Cube[/b] where you can choose which Class Change Ticket is most suitable for your needs! And if you login for a total of 60 minutes you'll also get a [b][Cobo] Physical/Magical Mystic Stone Change Ticket[/b]!


[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies
[/b][/h1]
Get ready to sport sweet summer dos with the newest [b]Hair Color Palette: Sugar Rush[/b]! Get it this week and level up your look for a steaming summer!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Gyoe9K1.jpg[/img]


Cloudless Skies, the heat of the sun, and catching beautiful tans! Summer is here and it's time to suit up and make waves! the [b]Summer Getaway, ELS Beach Wear[/b], and [b]Core Black/Natural White Swimwear Costumes[/b] are back! Get 'em in time for the hot season!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/DXTZKta.jpg[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/9yo3WuG.jpg[/img]



That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

notes.title: Create Partnerships or Become Soulmates with this NEW UPDATE!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/uvY49Bf.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! We've got a big fun update for Elsword's bond system! With the [b]Partner & Soulmate System[/b], you can either choose to be in a partnership with someone or become each other's soulmate! Each will have their own benefits so better prep yourself to ask that special someone and get all fun benefits and rewards! And don't forget to check out the fun new things we have at the Item Mall!



[b][h1]Love Vs Friendship Select Event
[/h1][/b]
It's time to build that relationship with the other El Gang member! For this event, you can choose to build your relationship with one character, but building relationships with more characters will reap more rewards!

[list]
[*] Increase your Affinity Stage with your selected character by 1 when you Login for 5 accumulative minutes AND clear dungeons within your level range twice!
[*] You can get another increase in Affinity Stage by 1 when you use your selected character to clear dungeons within your level range twice!
[*] Keep increasing character Affinity Stage and you'll get enough [b][Cobo] Mark of Love[/b] or [b][Cobo] Mark of Friendship[/b] which you can exchange to Ariel for consumables, costumes, custom motions, and more!
[/list]


[b][h1]Item Mall Goodies
[/h1][/b]
Present yourself in a stunning, head-turning manner! Mesmerize your enemies and dazzle them not only with skills but with your looks! Get your hands on [b]Ambience Paramatric[/b] this week!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/x3HmlTP.jpg[/img]


Spend time alone or with your soulmate in this relaxing [b]Memory of a Soulmate Custom Motion[/b]! You'll definitely be making wonderful memories here!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/y343it0.jpg[/img]


That's all for now folks~

See y'all in-game!

notes.title: The 1st Wave of 4th Path Mod Force Skills are Here!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/RzJqkLe.png[/img]
Heya adventurers! It's time to get extra hyped because Elsword, Aisha, Eve, and Raven are getting their [b]4th Path Mod Force Skills[/b]! You can spend the week trying them out and getting rewarded for it. Don’t forget, you only have a few days more before [b]Prof. Pho’s Attendance Event[/b] ends, get as many rewards as you can just by logging in! And as always, don't forget to check out the some returning items to the Item Mall!


[h1][b]Mode Force Skill Update Celebration Event
[/h1][/b]
Prepare Elsword, Aisha, Eve, and Raven for gathering [b][Cobo] Remaining Tenacious Powers[/b]! Just complete the event conditions to receive these materials which you can exchange through Ariel for rewards such as: [b][Luriel] Sage's Magic Stones[/b], [b][Luriel] Ring of Skills Select Cube[/b], potions, consumables, and more!


[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies
[/b][/h1]
Prepare for the wedding season with a selection of marital attire that fit your personality! Go for the [b]Elternal Wedding Costume Set[/b] if you're a fan of the classic look, don the [b]Luxury Wedding Costume[/b] Set for that regal touch on your special day, or try on the [b]Gloomy Night Costume Set[/b] if you're a fan of something unique!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/LNYuZ2Y.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/2fs0Rii.png[/img]


That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

[u][b][h2][Announcements][/h2][/b][/u]

[b][h3]★ Pruinaum Raid Challenge Mode[/h3][/b]

Pruinaum Raid Challenge Mode can be  challenged as a Striker Party and is separated to dungeons that separate the 8  players into 2 parties and dungeons that have all 8 players enter together.[b][/b]
  
[b]Dungeon  Entry Requirements[/b]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4961457/22ea608071254a59a40314aaf1c1452743616d38.jpg[/img]


[b]Enter  Challenge Mode[/b]
[list]  [*]Each dungeon for Pruinaum Raid  Challenge Mode has a time limit and the countdown will start the moment on  clicking the ‘Challenge Start’ button.[/*]  [*]Clear records are reset every  week on Wednesday, and the Challenge Mode you can enter will change.
    After the 4/12 update until 4/19, players  can enter Pruinaum Raid Challenge Mode, and cannot enter Varnimyr Challenge  Mode.[/*][/list]
[b]Challenge  Mode Battle Start[/b]
[list]  [*]For dungeons for 3~4 players, the  battle will start when all party members are in the waiting room,[/*]  [*]For dungeons for 4~8 players, all players  will enter together and fight in the same space.[/*]  [*]Other characters that started  the challenge together that’s not in the striker party cannot be invited to the  striker party during the challenge. But when a party member somehow exits from  the party, then that party member can be invited again provided that every  striker party member is not playing the dungeon.[/*]  [*]Party Buff/Heal/Item/Special  effects will only apply to your current party and the debuff applied to the  boss will be shared to all striker party members.[/*]  [*]When the time limit ends, the  dungeon will automatically be forfeited and will start from the first boss of  each dungeon when challenging again. (You will be exited from the dungeon if  it’s during the dungeon.)[/*]  [*]The party leader can forfeit  the challenge when there’s time remaining and when every party member agrees  through the pop-up window, they can forfeit the challenge.[/*][/list]
[b]Raid  and Raid Challenge Mode System Changes[/b]
[list]  [*]Raid and Raid Challenge Mode  Reset time is changed from Every Tuesday 23:00 ~ Wednesday 00:10 to Every  Tuesday 23:50 ~ Wednesday 00:10. Playtime will end at Tuesday 23:50.[/*]  [*]Raid Ranking will be removed  from the ranking boards available at boards and Camp NPCs. Raid Ranking Rewards  for after the 04/05 Raid Clearance Update will not be distributed.[/*][/list]
[b]Reward  Item[/b]
[list]  [*]You can obtain ‘Annihilating Soul Aura’ as a reward  every week 1 time by clearing the last stage per dungeon. This item can be  exchanged with Pet: Annihilator Automata, Pruinaum Region Accessory Select Cube  and other various items through Camp: Aurora NPC, Asella.[/*]  [*]Players may obtain the following  force skills as drops when clearing Altar of Invocation: Annihilator dungeon.[/*][/list]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4961457/064802ecdd21cc7311a36cedcad8228ff28a7bb7.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]★ Elrios Pass Season 4[/h3][/b]

Clear missions every day and receive various rewards  with the Elrios Pass Season 4 update!
  Season Pass will go on  for 12 weeks. Once the season ends, you will no longer be able to receive the  rewards.
  * Elrios Pass Season 4 will be from 2023/4/12  00:00 ~ 2023/7/4 23:59.

[b]How  to Use Elrios Pass[/b] 
[list]  [*]Click on the Elrios Pass UI at  the top of the screen to enter. [/*]  [*]Clear Daily/Weekly/Season missions to gain  Season Pass EXP. Achieve specific levels to obtain Normal (Free)/Premium  reward.[/*][/list][b]Elrios  Pass Item Mall Item[/b]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4961457/c4216ec1bef2fc1d05999a4f74135326f504d555.jpg[/img]

 [b]How to use Tenebrous Effect Select  Ticket[/b] 
  * Here are instructions on how to  use the Elrios Pass Season 4 reward, Tenebrous Effect Select Ticket.
  * What are Tenebrous Effect Select  Tickets? Tenebrous Effect Select Tickets allow you to imbue the max stat  of the desired Shadow Effect to your Tenebrous Equipment.

notes.title: Noah Threads the Land of Dreams with His 4th Path!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/BNFGGaU.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! It's time to get hyped because Noah's latest path has opened up and it's taking us to the land of dreams! Discover his story and experience his power! Get all the benefits just by completing quests and getting your hands on the rewards! And as always, don't forget to check out the Item Mall for the all the fun goodies we have this week!



[h1][b]Noah 4th Path Events
[/b][/h1]
Not wanting to face the harsh truth of what happened, Noah has locked himself in a fantasy and became the traverser of unrealistic dreams! Learn more about Noah's 4th Path while hauling in exciting rewards!

[list]
[*] New path coming means you get a new character slot! Get a free[b] [Cobo] Character Slot Expansion Card (1 Space)[/b] just by logging in for 30 minutes!
[*] Clearing dungeons at least twice a day will reward players with [b][Cobo] Mark of Phantasy – Noah[/b]! Use these to exchange epic rewards through Ariel! Rewards include:[b] [Luriel] Inventory Expansion Slots, [Luriel] Fighter Potions, [Luriel] Sage’s Magic Stones[/b], and so much more!
[*] Complete the chain quest to get rewards such as: [b][Ariel] Milky Way Party Accessories, [Ariel] El Tree Seeds, [Ariel] Sinister Intent Entrance Tickets[/b], and MORE!
[/list]


[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies
[/b][/h1]
Time to conjure up some powerful magic with Elsword and the gang! Be witchy and magical with these enchanting vestments! Complete the [b]Flos Magica IB Set[/b] this week!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/773FzAD.jpg[/img]



Which academy do you go to? Flaunt your favourite school uniform and strut around Elrios! If you've missed these before [b]Elrios Detective Academy, Hamel School of Wizardry, Velder Academy: Uniform, and Fantasy Star Academy[/b] are back!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/hiEkKQl.jpg[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/5gv02Fl.jpg[/img]





That's all for now folks~

See y'all in-game!

notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/5YR3tm2.png[/img]
Heya adventurers! Ain's 4th Path is coming this week! Get ready because in this new path, Ain’s faith in the Goddess has turned for the worse. Find out more as you uncover his backstory during this week's 4th Path launch! And as always, don't forget to check out the cool stuff we have in store at the Item Mall!

[/h1][/b]

The Messenger of the Goddess takes his faith to the next level and not in a healthy way! Get rewards while you explore his story. Has the Goddess truly abandoned him?

[list]
[*] New path coming means you get a new character slot! Get a free [b][Cobo] Character Slot Expansion Card (1 Space)[/b] just by logging in for 30 minutes!
[*] Clearing dungeons at least twice a day will reward players with [b][Cobo] Mark of Longing – Ain[/b]! Use these to exchange epic rewards through Ariel! Rewards include: [b][Luriel] Inventory Expansion Slots, [Luriel] Fighter Potions, [Luriel] Sage’s Magic Stones[/b], and so much more!

[/list]

notes.title: THE CHRISTMAS CHEER IN ELSWORD IS BURSTING AT THE SEAMS! COME CELEBRATE WITH US
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/G6vbr7d.jpg[/img]
Heya adventurers! The Christmas Season is going to be extremely jam-packed with events and even more rewards! In addition to jolly, merry making, we’re launching the new Hair Dye System to elevate your style and individuality further! There’s also a limited-time event where you can upgrade your Raid weapons to be even stronger, but you’ll have to find out how by tuning in! And as always, don’t forget to take a peek at the wonderful new things we have at the Item Mall for this week!

 

[h1][b]Hair Dye System Update Event
[/b][/h1]
There are more ways to customize your look! Change the color of your locks and that’s one more way to distinguish yourself among the rest!

[list]
[*] Choose between a [Cobo] Hair Color Palette (Daily) or a [Cobo] Hair Color Palette (Natural) when you clear dungeons within your level range 5 time!
[*] And when you clear dungeons within your level range 15 times, you get to choose a free hair cube!
[*] And when you dye your hair once you get 1 more [Cobo] Hair Color Palette (Daily) or a [Cobo] Hair Color Palette (Natural)!
[/list]
 

[h1][b]Powerful Punch Master Events
[/b][/h1]
Once you’ve reached 99, the higher your CP is the better the rewards! Reach certain CP milestones and haul the goodies you deserve!

[list]
[*] Achieve certain Combat Power (CP) milestones to gain rewards like: [Ariel] Fighter Potions, [Ariel] Sage’s Magic Stones, [Ariel] Stamina Potions, and so much more! The highest CP you can achieve for the event is 1,500,000 CP!
[*] Test out your power by clearing a series of quests to get even better rewards like: [Cobo] Sanctus Seraphim Costume Full Set (30 Days) Cube, [Cobo] +9 Flames of Judgement – Demonic Weapon Cube, [Cobo] Varnimyr Raid Accessory Select Cube, titles, amulets, and so much more!
[/list]
 

[h1][b]Christmas Event
[/b][/h1]
Tis the season to decorate your homes for the holidays! The best part? You’ll get ’em for free!

[list]
[*] Just login for 10 accumulative minutes every day to get 3 [Cobo] Christmas Tree Ornament Lights!
[*] But when you login on the 24th and the 25th, get the special [Cobo] Colorful Christmas Tree Ornament Lights. Get 15 on each day!
[*] After you’ve collected enough Ornament Lights, exchange them through Ariel for Holiday themed furniture! The [Cobo] Colorful Christmas Tree Ornament Lights can get you awesome stuff like: Spectral Amethysts, Tenebrous Aura, and more!
[*] Plus, there’s more reason to log in on the 24th and the 25th! Enjoy 2x EXP on the 24th, and 2x Drop Rate on the 25th!
[/list]
 

[h1][b]Raid Weapon Upgrade Event
[/b][/h1]
Are you level 99 and want to upgrade your weapon? Tune in this week, to find out more!

 

[b][h1]Item Mall Goodies
[/h1][/b]
Battle the chill in the air with a nice warm cup o’ joe! Plus, it doesn’t hurt to dress warmly with the [b]Winter Cafe Costume Set[/b]!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/cda2lA3.jpg[/img]
 

To celebrate, the launch of the Hair Dye System, we’re bringing a bunch of popular hairstyles back so you can try and recolor them to suit your personality! Get a load of these returning favorites!

Featured: Core [b]Black Swimwear Hair, Blossom Bird Hair, Abandoned Nobility Hair, and Tropical Solar Hair.[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/YBLOrRt.jpg[/img]

Check out more hair returnees at the Item Mall!

 

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/cxdKN4c.jpg[/img]
Hi, everyone! How are you liking the Harmony Festival? We’re almost halfway through, and I can never have enough of these Harmony Festival pies from Ariel! Now you’ve got just a little more than a day to enjoy [b]FREE ENTRY to Elrianode, Secret Dungeon, Heroic Dungeon, and Pruinaum[/b], so it’s time to hustle!

notes.title: Celebrate the Wonderful Tranquility Around Elrios During the Harmony Festival!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/C7TgrzU.jpg[/img]
Heya adventurers! Halloween is just around the corner, but you only have a little more than a week to finish the awesome [b]Halloween Event[/b] and get all the rewards! Bag that K-Ching and be known all around Elrios! And as always, don't forget to check out all the fun, new things we have at the Item Mall this week!



[h1][b]Harmony Festival Events
[/b][/h1]
Your abundant fall starts here! Plenty of rewards await just by logging in and doing super easy tasks!

[list]
[*] Time to pop some balloons and get rewarded with [b][Cobo] Harmony Festival Balloon Darts[/b] which you can exchange through Ariel for epic rewards such as: [b][Cobo] Harmony Festival Candle Fireworks Custom Idle Motion Cube, [Cobo] Fused Elixir Selective Cube, [Luriel] Blessed Time and Space Scrolls[/b], and so much more!
[*] Don't forget to get your fishing rods ready because Helen has got some rewards to give you in exchange for certain fishes!

You also get [b]+1 Additional Dungeon Daily Special Reward[/b] which stacks with your Elrios Pass effect! Plus, there are more daily Burning Boosts which you wouldn't want to miss out on!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KwDPGI8.jpg[/img]
Heya adventurers! There are so many freebies this week! Announce your presence and prepare your inventories because it’s going to be filled with tons of epic rewards once again! Plus, don’t forget to participate on our current Community Events and get yourself a chance to win K-Ching and be recognized for your talents! Come check out and join [b]Laby’s 4th Path Fan Art Event and 4th Path Emote and Sticker Event[/b]! [/h1][/b]

[/b][/h1]
Show your school spirit and cheer for the heroes of Elrios! Let your shouts and high jumps scare the enemies away as you dress up your El Search Party hero with the preppy [b]High Teen Cheerleader Costume Set!
[/b]

[*] Elrios Pass Season 2 will be from 8/17 0:00 ~ 11/08 23:59 PDT.

[*] Click on the Season Pass UI at the top of the screen to enter.
[*] Clear Daily/Weekly/Season Mission to gain Season Pass EXP. Achieve specific levels to obtain Normal (Free)/Premium Reward.

[/list]

[b][h2]★ 2022 Summer Update Revamp
[/h2][/b][list]
[*] 2022 Summer Update will alleviate the overall difficulty of raising your character to allow players to try out many characters and make it easier and fun not only for regular players, but also new and returning adventurers.
[/list]


[b][h2]★ Varnimyr Region
[/h2][/b][list]
[*] You will no longer obtain Common and Refined Mystic Stones, instead, obtaining Shining Mystic Stones only.
[*] [Varnimyr] Searching the Demon Realm and [Varnimyr] Demon Realm Adventure quest reward ‘Mystic Stone Random Cube’ will only have Shining Mystic Stones.
[*] Only obtain Shining Mystic Stones from Varnimyr Raid Weekly Clear Reward Cube.
[*] Varnimyr Raid Weekly Clear Reward Cube obtained before 8/17 MA will be changed to ‘(Old) Varnimyr Raid Weekly Clear Reward Cube’. This item will drop random Common, Refined, or Shining Mystic Stones.
[*] Achievements ‘I Should Have Known’, ‘It’s Hard to Get a Drop, Even Harder to Get the Wanted Effects.’ Achievement rewards will be changed to Giant Shining Mystic Stone.
[/list]


[b][h2]★ Rigomor Region
[/h2][/b][list]
[*] Amethystine Prophecy Armor and Spectral Amethyst items can be stored and moved in Shared Bank.
[*] Rigomor Region Daily/Weekly quests reward amount is improved.
[*] Rigomor region entrance epic quest ‘Entering Rigomor’ requirement has changed.
[/list]

[b][h2]★ Master Road Region[/h2][/b][list]
[*] Master Road dungeon accessory can be store and moved in shared bank.
[/list]

[b][h2]★ Title
[/h2][/b][list]
[*] Normal Dungeon titles will be shared (Boss Fight, Raid titles excluded), Shared/Character/Favorite tabs will be added the Title UI.
[*] [b]Shared:[/b] Titles that can be shared between characters within the account.
[*] [b]Character:[/b] Titles that can be used after completing the title requirements for each character.
[*] [b]Favorite:[/b] List of titles registered to favorites. Players can register up to 20 titles.
[*] Check the list of titles in Shared/Character/Favorite tabs in-game after 8/17 0:00 PDT. [/list]


[b][h2]★ ETC
[/h2][/b][list]
[*] Shared Bank will be free so players can use shared bank immediately upon creating a character. The standard normal member rank (Store 8 item slots, 1B ED). It can be expanded via ED or by purchasing an item via the Item Mall. Shared Bank can also be expanded via ED.
[*] Max Stat for ‘Polarize: Attack/Attacked Damage’, ‘Adaptation’ socket effect will increase from 45% → 55%.
[*] Party request list will show the character in order of application.
[*] Inventory slots and skill page can be expanded with ED.
[*] Fixed the accumulative login event tooltip not disappearing even after completing when you check the tooltip by hovering over the accumulative login event icon (clock shaped) on the mini map using a specific method.
[*] Fixed level up effect happening on the wrong location.
[*] Fixed (complete) mark disappearing when logging in to the game again after obtaining a title.
[*] Fixed a problem in which when a player inputs certain filtered words, the speech bubble will not have the filter applied even when it’s properly applied in the chat box.
[*] Region base titles requirements will be improved to match the number of titles per region.
[/list]

[b][h2]★ Dungeon/PvP/Field
[/h2][/b][list]
[*] Fixed ‘Impossible to connect to the network’ message popping up occasionally in sparring waiting room despite there being no network problems such as crashing or disconnection.
[/list]

[h2][b]★ Item[/b][/h2][list]
[*] El Search Party Collection – Synergy Effect Ticket item can be used in El House and Guild Base.
[/list]

[h2][b]★ Character Balance[/b][/h2]
See the full list of character balances in our [b][url=https://elsword.koggames.com/2022/08/august-17th-patch-notes/]Patch Notes[/url][/b]

notes.title: The NEW Market Board Revamp Is Here! Enjoy A Fresh Buying And Selling Experience

Heya adventurers! Hold on to your mounts because this is going to be a truly jam-packed week! We’ve got another [b]Summer Community Event[/b] this week, so check our website for more info! It’s quite the puzzling event too if we do say so ourselves. Try out the newest Market Board update and you’ll get rewarded handsomely! The best part? You only have to do this chain quest weekly!

Simply talking to the board will give you [b]1 [Cobo] Market Premium Ticket[/b] which you can use to apply the Sales Fee benefits.
After talking to the board, all you have to do is Register or Purchase 1 item on the market! This will give you [b]1 Phoru’s Foot Stamp (Elite)[/b] or [b]1 Phoru’s Foot Stamp (Unique)[/b] respectively!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/uNF8wKs.jpg[/img]

 

Missed these awesome costume sets before? You better get a hold of them now before they disappear again! Add the [b]Elrios Noir, ELS Beach Wear 2.0, Lord Chesterfield[/b], and [b]Magician to Illusion [/b]Costume Sets to your wardrobe today!

notes.title: Game Life In Elsword Just Keeps Getting Better! MORE Quality-of-Life Updates!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/4d1ibIe.jpg[/img]
Heya adventurers! How’d you like Part 1 of our QoL updates? We hope y’all are loving it because we’ve got more quality-of-life updates coming this week that’ll make your endgame life much, much easier! And as always, don’t forget to take a gander at the Item Mall this week because there’s a few fun stuffs coming in for Spring that we know you’ll love!
 

[b]Quality of Life Events: Part 2[/b]

Test out the latest QoL update and your time spent in-game trying out these changes will be rewarded!

[list]
[*] Your daily [b]30 minutes[/b] of login will reward you with a[b] [Cobo] Quality of Life Support 2 Cube[/b] that contains [b][Luriel] Adventurer Support Potions[/b] and a [b][Luriel] Dungeon Entrance Ticket Selective Cube![/b] So you can choose which dungeons you wanna hangout in!
[*] Your weekends will be even better! When you login for [b]60 minutes[/b], you’ll get a [b][Cobo] Quality of Life Special Support 2 Cube[/b]! When opened, it has [b]Spectral Amethysts, [Luriel] Chlorite Seeds (5%)[/b] and other special goodies! So, don’t forget to check back on the weekends!
[*] But we’re not even done yet! When you login for 60 minutes weekly you’ll get this awesome cube: [b][Cobo] Quality of Life Celebration Cube[/b] which contains titles to boost you up! Find out which titles when you get’em!
[/list]
 

[b]Item Mall Goodies
[/b]
Nothing says “Spring is here” than a parade of florals and pastels wherever you go! Time to get the gang on board with a refreshing spring ensemble with [b]Colorful Bloom![/b] Get ‘em when it comes out!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/MPtJkyJ.jpg[/img]


 

Noah and Laby are the sweetest heroes! Give your foes more than a toothache with [b]Noah/Laby Chocolatier[/b] sets! And let your enemies learn that even sugar has a kick! Get it this week!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/sz54tR6.jpg[/img]

 

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: The Full Moon Will Rise Soon… Prepare for Noah’s Last Path with the Pre-Event!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3kWDLnI.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! It’s an action-packed week because of the amount of things we have for you! Here’s a few reminders before you get all hyped up with this week’s events: Don’t forget, there’s still the [b]Enhancement Event[/b] and[b] Treasure Hunter Event[/b] going on! Keep logging in and doing quests to receive EPIC goodies! And not only are the events packed but also the Item Mall! Don’t forget to take a peek because we have TONS of new stuff not only for Noah but for the rest of the El Search Party as well!

[b]Noah 3rd Path Pre-Event[/b]

Noah's last path is coming soon but we want you to be prepared for another awesome path! Get ready to greet the Full Moon and be blinded by its light!
[list]
[*] Login for 20 mins to get NEW [b]Full Moon Orbs[/b]! You can test ‘em out immediately during battle!
[*] Get [b]2 Full Moon Shards[/b] when you clear dungeons within your level range. You can use these to exchange for cool items like: Phoru’s Foot Stamp (Gold), Sage Magic Stones, Dungeon Entrance Tickets, and more!
[/list]

[b]Noah ELSTAR Trainee Locker Room Event[/b]

Noah’s about to train to become part of the ELSTAR group! But first, he needs his training uniform to train! Successfully open the lockers to collect Clothing Tags so you can exchange them for costume pieces! And even if you fail to open a locker, you’ll still get an Exchange Ticket so you can exchange them for items!

[b]Item Mall Goodies[/b]
The El Search Party coming in hot with this red and fiery Ice Burner! The best part? [b]For a limited time, players have a chance to acquire MORE Eligos Ice Burner because it’s the new featured Ice Burner for the Treasure Hunt Event![/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/OQfqK0s.jpg[/img]

This new mount is extremely wooly and fluffy! But don’t be fooled [b]Mount: Pom Pom[/b] is a strong ride that can deal damage! Meet this ride when it comes out!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/UG9yJnT.jpg[/img]

Fight the cold Elrios winter by staying at home and keeping warm! Decorate your El House as a warm and welcoming abode with the [b]DIY El House: Snuggly Winter Set[/b]!

 [img]https://i.imgur.com/zgKr84e.jpg[/img]

And there’s more fun rest motions and costumes for Noah to enjoy! Beat the cold by dressing up warm with [b]Noah Winter Casual Sets[/b]! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/HUn0B4N.jpg[/img]

Need to hug for warmth while you rest? Choose between the [b]Snuggly Seal[/b] or the [b]Cuddly Seal[/b]! Premium versions have extra cute animations!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WAn29a7.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

Heya adventurers! There are only a few days left in the Noah 1st Path Events! Better make sure you got all the fun stuff before it disappears! notes.title: Out of the Shadows and Into the Streets of Elrios! Noah has Arrived!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Hjms0dI.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! We know you’re super excited to meet Noah because we are too! The best part is that when he finally arrives our newest boy will come bearing gifts of the best caliber! We’ve got tons of EPIC events for you to join in so you can get your hands on TONS of rewards not only for our moon child here but for the rest of the gang as well! So, stay tuned! And as always, don’t forget to check out the Item Mall for all the wonderful things we have in-store this week, including items for Noah! 

Moon Shadow Noah Release
We’re pulling all the stops to welcome the El Search Party’s newest member! He’s bringing tons of new items and rewards for everyone!
[list]
[*] Login for 30 minutes and 60 minutes respectively to get these Noah exclusive items: [b]Noah Diorama[/b] and a H[b]arque Ebalon Voice Speaker (90 Days)![/b]
[*] Excited to play as Noah? Good! Because when you keep leveling up Noah from 1 to 99, you’ll get rewarded for every 10-level milestone you reach! So, go on and get this boy to MAX!
[*] But that’s not all, spend your Saturday (PST) with Noah, to get a [b][Cobo] Noah Special Support Cube[/b]. Open it up to receive [b]Magic Stones[/b] and [b]Mystic Stones[/b]!
[/list]

[b]Invitation to the Moonlight Gala Event[/b]
Noah’s inviting you to his very special welcoming party and he’s got plenty of rewards to give away when you complete various quest conditions!
[list]
[*] Get rewards like [b]Spectral Amethysts, Sage’s Magic Stones,[/b] and even a [b][Luriel] Hedgehog Adventure Costume Suit [/b]not only for Noah but for the rest of the gang (well, depending on who opens the cube)!
[/list]

[b]Item Mall Goodies[/b]
Not up to go adventuring outside because of the chilling cold? Just slap on this adorably cozy [b]Fluffy Rabbit[/b] and you can go on your merry way to slicing and dicing enemies out in the open once more!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NAZbOhE.jpg[/img]

Be on your guard because Laby’s ready for a noble fight! Dress her up in this beautiful and elegant Elrios Noble Duelist Costume Suit and stick it to the man… or monsters!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/f3GPIdy.jpg[/img]

Aw lawd he comin’! Noah’s hauling in tons of costumes, accessories, customizations and more just so he won’t get left behind by the rest of the El Search Party’s fashionable ensembles! Here’s a preview of what he’s bringing along!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/BQdpj8p.jpg[/img]

And there’s more! Watch out for it!

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: The New Year is Bringing Something New on the Horizon!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3kkYJsj.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! The end of the old year means the coming of the new! Prepare for TONS of amazing New Year rewards, deals, and more! Plus, get ready to meet the newest hero to join the El Search Party: Noah! Check out the sneak peeks and pre-register to get exclusive rewards but you’ll meet him soon! And as always, don’t forget to check out the Item Mall for all the wonderful things we have for you in-store this week!

[b]New Year’s Event[/b]

Enter 2021 strong and with TONS of new items!

[list]
[*] Get a random reward when you log-in! The Fortune Cookie will decide what you’ll get! Which may be one of these: Awakening Customization, Mystic Stones, Spectral Amethysts, Refined Recovery Potions, and so much more!
[*] For the whole day, enjoy [b]EXP x2, Normal Drop Rate x2[/b], and [b]Unlimited Stamina[/b]! Time to get stronger before you enter the New Year!
[*] Plus, get ready for BIG DEALS coming!
[/list]

[b]Noah 1st Path Pre-Event[/b]

It’s almost time to meet and greet Noah! We’ll get you ready to welcome the El Search Party’s newest hero by getting tons of rewards before he’s actually here!
[list]
[*] Login for 20 mins to get NEW Moon Orbs! You can test ‘em out immediately during battle!
[*] Get 2 Shining Moon Shards when you clear 3 dungeons within your level range. You can use these to exchange for cool items like: Phoru’s Foot Stamps, Sage Magic Stones, Dungeon Entrance Tickets, and more!
[*] 
[/list]

[b]Item Mall Goodies[/b]

Add fanciness when you dish out skills and mesmerize allies and opponents alike! Get each one for your characters and show off fancy illustrations with [b]Illustration Skill Cut-In Pt. 3[/b]! Get ‘em all when they come out!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qRiVpp4.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Go from Level 0 to 99! Jump to Max Level & Unlock Your Full Potential!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4961457/57b03778faa0f44381cc669bef83caf39864663e.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! This week is going to be totally action-packed! First, we’ve added a new way for you to express yourselves! We’ve added this system called ‘Stickers’ so you can react and show a much wider range of emotion! Check it out for yourself when it comes out! Next up, we have an exciting Jumping Event! And as always, don’t forget to take a look at the new things we have at the Item Mall for this week!

[b]Full Growth Support Event[/b]
When you create a new character during the event, they get all sorts of EPIC advantages and rewards! This is your time to get another powerful character!
[list]
[*] When you create any character from Elsword to Laby, you are guaranteed EPIC rewards once certain milestones have been reached (Regions for Elsword to Ain; Levels for Laby)! 
[*] Get rewards such as:[b] [Cobo] Combat Power Jump Support Special Accessories Cube, [Cobo] Shaviana Truffles Costume Full Set, [Ariel] +9 Apocalypse Type-Void Weapon Cube, [Ariel] +9 Elrianode Armor Cube[/b], and so much more! 
[*] Plus, there are even more rewards to get once you hit MAX Level with Level 99 Chain Quests!
[*] And to pair with the release of the new Sticker System, we’re giving a bunch of stickers to use when you log in for [b]60 accumulative minutes! [/b]
[*] And every Saturday during the event is Burning Time! Watch out for either [b]EXP x2[/b] or[b] Normal Dungeon Drop Rate x2[/b]!
[/list]

[b]Item Mall Goodies[/b]
Ready for a date in town but it’s super chilly? Worry not! We have the perfect attire just for Elsword and the gang! The [b]Romantic Date Costume Set[/b] is a posh winter outfit that will keep you warm but still fashionable! Get it when it comes out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4961457/ef7e3d28dcdb888d0211d13011efe43aa0349125.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Don’t Look Now! TONS of New Rewards Are Dropping! It's the Best Time to Join!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/gE8crvD.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! We’ve got events on top of events this month that you won’t know where to put all the rewards you’ll be getting! But don’t forget you only have a few days left to experience an [b]Abundant Harvest[/b] in Elrios is you haven’t yet! And for those of you that have, keep logging in and haul those rewards! And as always, don’t forget to take a little peek at the Item Mall to check out what’s new and poppin’!

[b]New & Returning Adventurer Event[/b]
Tell your friends to join or comeback (if they took a nice, long break)! Because the rewards for joining or coming back are through the roof! 
[list]
[*] [b]New Player Rewards[/b] include goodies like a pet and a mount, dungeon tickets, an epic title, a costume suit and so much more!
[*] But here’s the kicker: to celebrate this update in rewards for new players, we’re gonna do an Oprah and give everybody the [b]New Player Rewards[/b]! Just login to get ‘em!
[*] If you’re a returning player, you’ll be tempted by these: a cube that includes a +9 Apocalypse Type-Void Sword and the full Elrianode set, Magic Stones, an epic title, TONS of consumables, and so much more! 
[*] But wait, you’ll also get the very awesome [b]New Player Rewards[/b] when you come back and login and every day!
[/list]

[b]Item Mall Goodies[/b]
Add a little darkness into your life because these violet delights have violent ends – well, towards your enemies at least! Be darkness manifest in the newest [b]Ice Burner: Horde of Darkness Set[/b]! Get ready to complete it when it comes out!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WV7RdX3.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: GM Plays is Back & There’s More to Do! Time to Make Your Skills Look Fancy!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/m5rWigC.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! GM Plays is back for the month of November! Instead of helping you clear one region, we’ll help you with multiple ones! Plus, we’ve added PVP-based activities which will give you a chance to nab TONS of K-Ching for you and the whole winning team! Isn’t that just perfectly splendid? So, go prep for both PVE and PVP events and your favorite GMs will see you there! Also, don’t forget to take a quick gander at the new stuff we have for you at the Item Mall this week!

[b]GM Plays[/b]
When you play with GMs, the rewards are sweet but that K-Ching prize is sweeter! Join other players for a heckin’ good time at dungeon runs and team PVPs!

[b]SCHEDULE OVERVIEW:[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Mondays[/b]: Elrianode Region Dungeons
[*] [b]Tuesdays[/b]: Varnimyr Region Dungeons
[*][b] Wednesdays[/b]: Master Road Dungeons
[*] [b]Thursdays[/b]: GMs vs Community Events (NA Only)
[*][b] Fridays[/b]: 2v2 Pop-Up Tourney Event (NA Only)
[/list]
For a more detailed look at the GM Plays Event, please check the article [url=https://elsword.koggames.com/2020/11/come-join-the-gm-plays-this-november/]here![/url]

[b]Item Mall Goodies[/b]
Waiting long for Ain & Laby’s Skill Cut-Ins based on class? Well, wait no more! We got ‘em right here! Get your hands on the [b]Ain, Laby Promotional Skill Cut-In 2 [/b]when it comes out this week!

notes.title: Characters Have Been Balanced & We’re Dancing for Joy!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/xT9WNZk.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! We’re balancing the skills and the abilities of a few characters this week! There will also be a few changes in general which you can check out when they come out! Plus! We’ve got awesome events to accompany these awesome changes so you can test ‘em out for yourself! And don’t forget to take a long, hard peek at the Item Mall because this week we have wonderful stuff that you’ll definitely love!

[b]Balance Patch Event[/b]

notes.title: Get Together! Join The El Search Party for an Epic Harmony Festival!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/FvNCylV.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! The Harmony Festival is here! It’s going to be an extremely abundant week for everyone with all the buffs, rewards, freebies and more that we have in store! So, get hyped and prepare yourself for the onslaught of bounty coming to you! And as always, don’t forget to take a gander at the Item Mall to check out all the cool, new things we have!

[b]Harmony Festival Event[/b]

Free your inventories because we’re about to fill ‘em up yet again! Get ready for weeks of freebies and buffs ahead!

[list]
[*] We’ll start off with a Harmony Festival-exclusive title: [b]Wise Peace Maker (7 Days)[/b]! All you have to do? Just login for 30 minutes and it’s yours! Get one once every week!
[*] Don’t miss out on our event-exclusive food items! The [b]Harmony Festival Pie?[/b] Absolutely free! Take as much as you want! The others cost a mere 100,000 ED! Just talk to Ariel to haul ‘em!
[*] The [b]Bonfire Site[/b] is back! Hang out there solo or with friends for 1 minute and get a buff! It’s a different buff each week!
[*] Also, get a [b][Luriel] Crimson Trace Reset Ticket[/b] once a week when you login for 30 mins!
[*] But that’s not all! Starting this week, enjoy 2 whole weeks of dungeon runs with these boosts: [b]Free Entry to Secret and Heroic Dungeons, Free Entry to Elrianode, [/b]and [b]ALL Secret Dungeons[/b] are open!
[*] Complete Quests to acquire [b]Harmony Festival Part 1 Tickets[/b] which you can exchange for epic items and rewards. Including the new [b]Harmony Festival Ceremonial Robe[/b]!
[/list]

[b]Item Mall Goodies[/b]

It won’t be a traditional Elrios Harmony Festival with a costume! Blend in the crowd when you don this costume suit and exude an air of mystery as the festivities commence! Get the [b]Harmony Festival Ceremonial Robe[/b] when it comes out!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/e1wgeVs.jpg[/img]

A new, adorable companion is here! Super lovable and absolutely darling, Sherbet will guarantee ‘aawws’ wherever you go! Take them home now!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bKqp8kH.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Traverse New Lands and See Where the White-Ghost King Rests!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/93miDsd.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! This is going to be an action-packed week! A new mysterious new land has revealed itself to the El Gang and it is up to our heroes discover what fate awaits them in a new place! Get ready players, Pruinaum is here! Meet new characters, take in the new environment, and grow even stronger! We’ve got TONS of events and even more rewards for you to haul in so you can prepare for this brand-new adventure! We’re also introducing a new system to make your already EPIC weapons, stronger! Watch out for the Imprint System! And as always, don’t forget to check out the Item Mall for all the goodies we have in-store for you this week!

[b]Pruinaum is Coming Event[/b]

Feel you’re not prepared to take on the land and the people of Pruinaum? Worry not! We’re here to help! Don’t miss these events!

[list]
[*] Log in for 10 and 20 minutes to get the new [b][Cobo] Start of a New Adventure (1 Day)[/b] and [b]20 [Cobo] Adventurer Support Potion[/b] respectively!
[*] But that’s not all! When you login [u][b]ONCE[/b][/u] on the weekends, prepare to get [b]1 [Cobo] Pruinaum All-in-One Support Package![/b] Which includes items like Accessory sets, a title, a pet, and more!
[*] Hold on to your hats because for the duration of the event, you’ll get to enjoy [b]x2 Drop Rate[/b] in the [b]Varnimyr Raid[/b]!
[*] Oh, and check out the opening of the [b]Aurora Shop[/b] where you can exchange your [b]Aurora Shop Points[/b] (you can get them by clearing dungeons in your level range) for awesome items!
[/list]

[b]Pruinaum Dungeon Events[/b]

Want to do more? We have more awesome events with even more awesome rewards for everyone!

[list]
[*] Get a small taste of Pruinaum when you log in [u][b]ONCE[/b][/u] for [u][b]20 minutes[/b][/u] on specific dates to get a[b] [Cobo] Pruinaum Trial Cube[/b]! It contains [b]1 [Cobo] Danger Close (7 Days) Title, 1 Mark of Alliance, 1 [Cobo] King of Yeti (7 Days) Title,[/b] and [b]1 Glacial Aura[/b]!
[*] Get [b]Imprint Stones[/b] by clearing the Glacial Land and the Old Village Site! You can add them to your weapons so they’re much stronger!
[*] And just for this weekend, get [b]1 [Cobo] 3rd Class Advance Ticket [/b]once on the 15th and [b]1 [Cobo] Class Change Select Cube[/b] once on the 16th!
[*] But it doesn’t stop there! Also on the 16th, don’t forget to do the chain quest to get [b][Cobo] Elrianode Color Change Tickets[/b] as well as,[b] 1 [Cobo] Physical/Magical Mystic Stone Change Ticket![/b]
[/list]

[b]Item Mall Goodies[/b]

It’s definitely home, sweet home when you come back after a busy day and go home to views of the cosmos! The low-light ambience helps with the relaxation too! Get the [b]DIY El House (Starlight)[/b] when it comes out!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/6IGCNgq.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Enjoy the Opening of Elrios Park & Solve Puzzles to Earn Rewards!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/sr5ErDZ.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! After a chill week last week, we’ve got tons of rewards and events prepared for you! First up, we have a fun but puzzling mini-event where you can get awesome rewards!
Next, you’ll find out what we have in store for US Independence Day Celebration (hint: it’s gonna be spectacular!). 
And then we have a new function called “Presets” where you’ll be able to store different.. setups and switch them up with a click of a button! And as always, don’t forget to check out Item Mall for all the fun, new things we have for you this week!

[b]Heart El Puzzle Mini-Game[/b]
There’s something puzzling going on and it’s up to you to solve it! Get ready to do this quick and easy mini game for TONS of rewards!
[list]
[*] Get [b]2 [Cobo] Heart El Puzzle Play Tickets[/b] when you login for 10 minutes every day! Be warned, you’ll only get 2 tickets while the event is ongoing!
[*] After successfully solving the puzzle, you’ll get [b]Faded Pictures[/b] which you can use to exchange for wonderful items including an awesome [b]Heart El Skill Cut-In (Ver. Basic)[/b].
[/list]

[b]US Independence Day Event[/b]
Come one, come all! Elrios Park opens just in time to celebrate US Independence Day!
[list]
[*] 5, 15, and 25 minutes of your login will reward you with several[b] [Cobo] Tension Up Potions.[/b]
[*] Clear dungeons within your level range to get [b][Cobo] Elrios Park Magic Pass Tickets[/b] which you can exchange through Ariel for a plethora of rewards including an[b] [Ariel] Elrios Park! Spinning Teacup [/b]for Elsword to Laby!
[*] And more will be revealed! Just stay tuned and keep your eyes peeled for updates!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4961457/b4caec6e93c6c11b017f846d096d661e19ed2044.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! Let's start the New Year with a bang and we have plenty of exciting events to make sure that your year ends and begins epicly! Fill your inventory with goodies for every Minute you stay logged in (Up to 10 Minutes!)! Then,  we’re getting you ready for a new power that’s coming soon so stay tuned! And as always, we’ve got new items at the Item Mall that we know you’ll love!

[b]New Year’s Event[/b]
Countdown (and up) to Elrios’ best New Year’s celebration! These rewards are for one day ONLY so you better not miss it!
[list]
[*] On New Year’s Eve, login for 1 – 10 minutes and watch those rewards arrive one by one! Get elixirs, dungeon tickets, magic stones, and more!
[*] Then do it again on New Year’s Day!
[*] Also, it’s[b] EXP X2[/b] on New Year’s Eve and New Year’s Day.
[*] The best part? We have a New Year’s Day Sale to start your year right! It’ll be shame to miss these deals!

[list]
[*] Watch out for the mysterious new creature lurking in the dungeons! Defeat it and get a [b]Mark of New Power.[/b] You can exchange that with Ariel for a [b]Mark of Special Power![/b]
[*] Once you’ve collected a few[b] Marks of Special Power[/b], you can get awesome rewards to help you on your adventures!
[*] [b]10 Marks of Special Power[/b] will guarantee[b] 1 Mark of Absolute Power[/b]. 10 of those will nab you [b]1 [Luriel] Armor Only Magic Amulet Lv. 9[/b]! How awesome is that?!
[/list]

[b]Item Mall Goodies[/b]

New eyes to match the new Ice Burner! These mystical sea eyes will mesmerize friends and foes alike. Launch an epic attack with just one look with the [b]Nereid Eyes.[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/gHzZf2b.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Don’t Miss the Last Character Reboot! Haul In those Rewards Before They’re Gone!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/GOxcIiQ.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! This week will be the last week of Character Reboots! This is the week you definitely don’t want to miss because this will be the last time you’ll have a chance to get the rewards you’ve been getting from previous reboot events!

Next, the 3rd and 4th dungeons of Rigomor comes out this week as well! That means more events, more rewards, new titles and more discoveries in the Demon Realm are uncovered!  

Lastly, we have an extra hot burning summer to give you the boost you need to make you stronger and better than before! And as always, don’t forget to check out the Item Mall for all the new goodies we have!

[b]4th Character Reboot Event[/b]

The last of the reboots is here! Take advantage of these events before they disappear!

[list]
[*] This is your last chance to take advantage of the [b]FREE ENTRY[/b] to Secret/Heroic Dungeons and Elrianode Dungeons!
[*] When you log-in daily for [b]30 accumulative minutes[/b] you’ll get rewards like: [b][Cobo] Elrianode Color Change Ticket Cube, [Luriel] Fighter Potions, [Cobo] Reboot Potion Sets[/b], and more!
[*] Plus, when you run dungeons within your level range, we’ve got special rewards for you to claim once you complete the quest conditions~!
[*] AND! Don’t miss this last burning weekend happening this Saturday and Sunday!
[/list]

[b]Rigomor 3rd & 4th Dungeon Event[/b]

After traversing the 1st and 2nd dungeons of this new land, our heroes move to conquer the next dungeons! But can they? With your help, it’ll be a piece of cake!

[list]
[*] High levels aren’t the only ones who’d get rewards. Players level 10 and up will get a [b][Cobo] Electrostimulation Field (7 Days)[/b] and a [b][Cobo] Trosh’s Nest Dungeon Title Trial Cube[/b].
[*] As with before, characters level 99 will still have to complete quest conditions to get extra [b]Spectral Amethysts[/b] to be able to craft the new equipment sets!
[/list]

[b]Hot Burning Summer[/b]

We’re making your hot days much better with these fun summer boosts coming your way!

[list]
[*] Everyone! And we mean, everyone will receive up to [b]+10 Weapon Enhancement Buff[/b] to their weapons +10 and below!
[*] Don’t worry about your pots running out! We’re here to give you more! Just [b]10 accumulative login minutes[/b] will guarantee [b]50 [Luriel] Refined Recovery Potion DAILY![/b] So, what are you waiting for?
[/list]

[b]Item Mall[/b]

Your heroes get a new Elstar costume! Well, new-ish but something’s different and I can’t quite put my finger on it. Get the new[b] Elstar (ver. Switch) [/b]costume set and figure out what’s different this time!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fscePRR.jpg[/img]

Under the sea! Darlings it’s better, take it from Laby! Get Laby’s Dance of the Sea custom motion for some magical underwater feels!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4961457/3189be1e38f6ea1b122d9a7627a5d7be8ddb92b2.gif[/img]

E.L.S - Elrios Livestream Service

[img]https://i.imgur.com/JRfXafA.jpg[/img]

The Final Wave of the Re:Boot is here... And our E.L.S Streamers are all ready to showcase all the changes alongside the new story about to unfold in the Rigomor Dungeons!

Join the E.L.S Streamers for some epic gameplay, giveaways and more!

[b]RoughHouse[/b] | Tuesday 08/27 | 3:00 PM PT / 6:00 PM ET

[b]DeadGrim [/b]| Wednesday 08/28 | 24-Hour Live-stream

[b]SenAkari [/b]| Thursday 08/29 | 12:00 PM PT / 3:00 PM ET

[b]MeteorFalcon[/b] | Thursday 08/29 | 5:00 PM PT / 8:00 PM ET

[b]Lumenescense[/b] | Thursday 08/29 | 7:00 PM PT / 10:00 PM ET

[b]
KayneTheSlayer[/b] | Saturday 08/31 | 5:00 PM PT / 8:00 PM ET

notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/KupSSqt.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! We’ve got another week full of fun and exciting events lined up just for you! First up, we have the much-awaited reboot for Aisha, Raven, Add, and Laby! I know all you stans have been waiting for this and the events, so get hyped and get ready!

We also have a new mini event where you’ll get to help a cute hedgehog in distress, and you’ll be rewarded handsomely! And finally, it’s time to welcome everyone to the mysterious lands of Rigomor! Prepare yourselves for new dungeons to explore, new NPCs to meet, and new stories to uncover! Apart from that we’ve got quality of life stuff peppered here and there to keep things interesting. And as always, don’t forget to check out the new stuff we have at the Item Mall!

[b]3rd Character Reboot Event[/b]

Third time’s the charm! And, oh, all the charming rewards you’ll get!

notes.title: Round 2 Is Here! It’s Ara, Elesis, And Ain‘s Turn To Experience A Change!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/uXseoqF.jpg[/img]

Hey adventurers! Better buckle up because this week will definitely be an awesome ride! 

First up, as you all know, we have the 2nd Round of Character Reboots for Ara, Elesis, and Ain! That means these lovely three are getting new and improved skills for maximum damage output! 

Next, the wonderful world of Elrios is expanding! Yes, they’re getting a new region and you have to pre-register to get rewards! Are you wondering what kind of adventures and shenanigans the El Gang is going to end up having?

We also have an exciting Growth Support event with TONS of rewards both for new players and even for old players with new characters (we know you’re all eyeing those rewards)! And we also have a Treasure Hunter event happening this week! Collect ALL the tickets and coins! There’s a reward for everything! 

And as always, don’t forget to check out the new stuff we have at the Item Mall this week. We know you’ll love ‘em!

[b]2nd Character Reboot Events[/b]

You know the drill, you don’t even need to worry about the rewards!

[list]
[*] FREE ENTRY to Secret/Heroic Dungeons and Elrianode Dungeons! Starting on Wednesday until the event ends!
[*] When you log-in daily for [b]30 accumulative minutes[/b] you’ll get rewards like: [b][Cobo] Elrianode Color Change Ticket Cube, [Luriel] Fighter Potions, [Cobo] Reboot Potion Sets[/b], and more!
[*] Plus, when you run dungeons within your level range we’ve got special rewards for you to claim once they complete the quest conditions~!
[*] AND! We’re gonna end the week hot! Prepare for a burning weekend on Saturday and Sunday!
[/list]

[b]New Region Pre-registration Event[/b]

If you’re wanting rewards, all you have to do is pre-register and you’ll get them when the new region opens! Here’s what you’ll get:

[b][list]
[*] [Luriel] Ring of Skills Selection Cube
[*] [Luriel] Fighter Potion
[*] [Luriel] Sage’s Magic Stone
[*] [Luriel] Complete Recovery Potion
[*] [Luriel] Phoru’s Foot Stamp (Gold)
[/list][/b]
[b]Character Growth Support Event[/b]

It’s the best time to recruit your friends! These new player rewards are super enticing and extremely helpful! Old players can also get rewards when they make a new event character! There’s different rewards for players of Elsword through Ain than there are for Laby, so be sure to play as many as you can!
[b]
Treasure Hunter Event[/b]

All those keyholes! Which one will open the chest?! Fail or succeed, you get rewards! If you fail, you can get tickets and if you have enough you can exchange them! If you succeed, you get coins and the chest resets for another chance to get more! If you have enough coins you can get event-exclusive cubes that contain the super rare [b]Radiant Flower (Black) Set[/b]!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/B9Cm7zV.jpg[/img]

Plus, more! Stay tuned!

[b]Item Mall Goodies[/b]

The squad is ready to hit the beach! Don’t be that dude who wears armor to the beach (but if you want to, go for it) and go for something refreshing instead! Check it out and try the swimsuits on when it comes out!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/twV6FsY.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in game!

notes.title: Your Pets Are Leaving You… Temporarily and Going on An Expedition!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/wa5GGpp.jpg[/img]
Heya adventurers! We’ve got an exciting update coming this week and it’s for your beloved pets! You’ll finally be able to send them (1 – 3 pets) to epic expeditions and in turn they’ll bring you back wonderful rewards! How awesome does that sound? Your pets will now have a Trait system that will help them on their journeys, so don’t forget to consider that before sending them out, otherwise, they might fail! Apart from that, you can learn more and have a go at it when it comes out! And as always, we’ve got more amazing stuff at the Item Mall so don’t forget to take a peek and maybe do a haul *wink*

[/list]

notes.title: Elsword's Laby Gets Her 3rd Job Path
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/qTKQJ3r.jpg[/img]

The Eternal Night Takes Over the Adorable Brawler

Irvine, Calif., March 6, 2019 – KOG Games, a leading developer and publisher of popular free-to-play action MMORPGs, today released the 3rd Job Path, Rusty Child, for their newest, playable character, Laby (pronounced lab-ee). [url=https://youtu.be/A5b9OsAhnAw ]Check out the new trailer here[/url].

Laby's excitement from entering a new world soon faded and was replaced by a feeling of discomfort. She could not shake the feeling, eventually leading her to make a mistake in the battlefield. Despite this, she was able to defeat the enemies with Nisha’s help. Bellonde, however, was injured in the process and his wounds were not healing immediately like hers. She finally realized where her feelings of discomfort were coming from. 

Trusting Nisha to take care of her, Laby gives all of her emotions to Nisha allowing her to become corporeal while Laby slowly fades away. To prevent Laby from disappearing, Nisha turned her into a mirror and promised to make this world a place just for Laby - where she can be happy like before. 

Rusty Child, Daydreamer, and Nisha Labyrinth; come to realize the nature of their existence... together. Until the day all light fades to nothing.

Dark path stans and Laby lovers unite! Today is the day you’ve all been waiting for! The gloom and doom of Nisha is upon us! An Exciting New Adventure and special rewards are available today, including:
[list][*]Every 10 levels plus accomplishing specific tasks will give Laby plenty of rewards to keep her afloat as she explores her new world! Fill your inventories with rewards like: Accessories, Expansion Cubes, Potions, Mounts, a Mini Poco, and so much more!
[*]Plus, get more consumable rewards daily like Sage’s Magic Stones, Elixirs, and Potions when you clear dungeons within her level range![/list]

The Laby 3rd Job Path Event begins today and concludes on March 19 at 11:59 PDT.

notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/wJNNw8w.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! There are tons of fantastic new events happening this week! Get ready for another character pre-event as we prepare for Laby’s newest and happiest path! Plus, get your wallets ready because we have the most awesome Premium Ice Burner Package Event happening this week too. If you love Ice Burner Popcorns events, you’ll definitely love this! You’d think that was it but there’s still more – more rewards and events!

The time to improve your weapons and equipment is now! – err, tomorrow – at the Enhancement Event! Become stronger, faster, and better at the start of the year! We also have an awesome Treasure Hunter event that guarantees you a reward whether you open the chest or not! And as always, there’s wonderful stuff at the Item Mall waiting for y’all tomorrow!

[h1][b]Laby 2nd Path Pre-Event[/b][/h1]
We know you’re super excited for the new path but it’s time to make a new Laby so she’ll be ready to kick some baddies’ butts (with a smile) as her newest path enters the picture soon.
[list][*]You’ll get [b]Lively Flowers[/b] for completing daily quests and chain quests with Laby. You can use these to get rewards such as [b][Luriel] Blessed Time and Space Scrolls, [Cobo] Twisted Time and Space Keys, [Luriel] Phoru Foot Stamps[/b] and more![/list]

[h1][b]Premium Ice Burner Package Event[/b][/h1]
Get a chance to receive up to 200 Radiant Flower Ice Burners through this EPIC event! You just need [b]Premium Ice Burner Tickets[/b] from the [b]Premium Ice Burner Packages[/b]. So, don’t miss this chance to complete your Radiant Flower set!

[h1][b]Enhancement Event[/b][/h1]
New year, new strengths gained! We all want to get a little stronger and what better way to do that than an Enhancement Event! Go crazy and lineup at your favorite blacksmith spot!
[list][*]Logging in daily for 20 minutes will reward you with [b][Cobo] Blessed Fluorite Ores![/b] And there are other special login events where you need to login at specific dates. Don’t miss those too!
[*]It’s our favorite Lucky Enhancement tickets once again! Get a [b]Lucky Enhancement Equipment/Armor Cube[/b] when you login for [b]10 minutes[/b]. 
[*]Enhance the amulet until it reaches +8 and above to get an equivalent Amulet which you can then use for your actual weapons! Isn’t that just ingenious? The fear of breaking your weapons is gone! 
[*]Plus, get your K-Ching ready for a wonderful enhancement sale! This is your chance to snag ALL your enhancement essentials for less! [/list]

[h1][b]Treasure Hunter Event[/b][/h1]
Instead of going Treasure Hunting, you’re going on a keyhole guessing journey! The treasure chest is here – but it has 10 keyholes! Can you guess which keyhole is the correct one to get yourself some sweet coins?
[list][*]Get keys by completing Daily Key quests or spending 100 K-Ching in the Item Mall to receive 1 Key! 
[*]Players who successfully open the chest will get coins which they can exchange for much better rewards such as [b]Radiant Flower IBs, Sage’s Magic Stones, Wardrobe Tickets, Magic Amulets, [/b] and more! The best part is, once the chest has been opened, it will reset and you get some of the rewards multiple times (others, just once)!
[*]Players who fail to open the chest get a ticket which they can exchange for [b]5 Premium MP Potions, 10 Organic Apples, 10 Complete Recovery Potions,[/b] or [b]10 Red-Bean Sherbet.[/b][/list]

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
Molly is the roundest and bounciest pet you’ll ever own! She may look like a dungeon monster but this precious creature will be your forever friend! Get your [b]Molly[/b] when she comes out tomorrow!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/1smsDhi.gif[/img]

Although Laby is the sweetest and happiest girl you’ll ever meet, get ready to bring out her evil side. Just aesthetically, though! Clothe Laby in her very own [b]Archdevil Ice Burner Set[/b] because sometimes, evil is cute!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/jDYOqxg.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.content:

Heya adventurers, we’ve got a fun week ahead of us with new game updates, new events, and new Item Mall goodies – so let’s just jump into it! First up, we have new Guild updates! We’re making being part of a guild that much fun for everyone. Bond with your guildies and check out the new Halloween-themed mini-games that we know you’ll enjoy for hours! And then, if you think your Guild Base needs a little sprucing up, we’ve got just the thing because you (or your Guild Masters) will finally have the ability to change the look of your base! Check out the guild update tomorrow! Next up, we have some kind of evil darkness tainting the moon. It’s up to you to help purify it by doing quests while getting TONS of rewards along the way! And last but not least, don’t forget to check out the awesome new stuff we have at the Item Mall tomorrow!

The moon has been shrouded in some kind of demonic energy and that spells danger! Can you completely purify the moon and get all its treasures?

[*]Plus! When you’re less than level 40 and you login for 30 minutes, you’ll get a [b][Cobo] 1st, 2nd Class Advance Ticket Cube[/b] to speed up your advancements so you can purify the moon faster!

notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/InFPcT5.jpg[/img]

Heya adventures! For most of you, you’ll have noticed how the leaves are changing and everything just smells and feel very autumnal. It’s really fall and many people are excited for Halloween, including us! That’s why we’ve got a fun new Halloween event coming to you! There’s also a balance patch coming out. Check which skills have changed for each character and test them out on Thursday (no maintenance on tomorrow for this week only – we’ll be back to our regular schedules next week!)! And as always, don’t forget there’s always fun stuff at the Item Mall coming on Thursday so go check ‘em out then!

notes.title: Let the Peaceful Days Come! Celebrate the Harmony Festival with Friends!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/mAo4frm.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! We’re giving you more reasons to be extra excited this week starting with our fun yearly celebration of the Harmony Festival! Enjoy boosts, free consumables, titles, epic rewards, pets and more! This is a festival you definitely don’t want to miss! After some fun at the festival, it’s time to get pumped up for a show at Velder Academy's very own concert hall! Defeat the Phoru wreaking havoc on music-loving patrons and get awesome rewards (even an adorable exchange-exclusive pet) from this new Event Dungeon! And lastly, don’t forget that we have some fun new stuff at the Item Mall for you to check out so watch out for all of these and more, tomorrow!

[h1][b]Harmony Festival Events[/b][/h1]
There’s so many ways for you to enjoy this year’s Harmony Festival and much like past festivals, it’s going to be totally awesome!
[list][*]Everyone’s going to get a festival boost that adds [b]+5% of Physical, Magical Attack Power[/b] and [b]HP![/b]
[*]Special Harmony Festival titles and special consumables are back! But only available for a limited time!
[*]There will also be an awesome Special Dungeon Burning event, so watch out for it!
[*]Don’t forget to do quests for the [b]Harmony Festival Tickets[/b] which you can use for Ariel exchanges! They have some really cool and useful rewards tomorrow!
[*]Simply logging in for 30 minutes will reward you with a [b]7-Day [Cobo] Milky Way Accessory Set![/b] So, you can try out some fun, new accessories for music lovers!
[*]And there’s so much more! You’ll have to see for yourself![/list]

[h1][b]Velder Academy Concert[/b][/h1]
Let the music control you and experience the fun of defeating monsters unleashed by that pesky musical Phoru! 
[list][*]Get [b][Cobo] Velder Academy Concert Tickets[/b] when you clear the event dungeon! Exchange them for special items and a very special pet, [b]Mellow – Yellow![/b] You can’t get this adorable pet anywhere else![/list]

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
Air guitar, shmair guitar. Bring the house down with your awesome rock and roll moves and get people pumped up! [b]Velder Rock n’ Roll Custom Motion[/b] comes tomorrow!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/aWftomJ.jpg[/img]

A cute little creature pops out! [b]Mellow – Pink[/b] is the perfect music lover’s pet! Have him pop some tunes on his little flute while you shred on stage! Make this adorable raccoon yours!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/70vrkum.gif[/img]

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Brace Yourself! A New Week Means TONS of New Updates and Events!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/jt0jUkt.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! It’s time to brace yourselves again this week because we’ve got tons of exciting new updates! First up, the El Search Party has discovered another dungeon at the Demon Realm, journey with them and find out what manner of creatures roam the area and uncover what will happen in their journey! Speaking of the Demon Realm, we’re adding a Story Mode in the Raid Dungeon which requires less Combat Power! Now, you can learn the story with less stress and then you can just come back to deal with the real fight in Normal Mode if you wish!

Next up, it’s the start of PVP League Season 3! Ranks will reset and everyone will get a fresh start! Will you remain on top or will someone take your place? For this season’s PVP update, we have two new maps for you to enjoy your fights in! So queue up for a match to check them out! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/wxfhf2t.png[/img]

Then, we have a Balance Patch to iron out certain character skills. Plus, more Guild updates are released to increase every guilds’ quality of life in the game! And last, but not the least, we’re rolling out a fun new event with rewards to choose from! Come have a look tomorrow to find out what rewards you’ll get to choose from! And as always, don’t forget to check out the Item Mall for some brand-new goodies! 

[h1][b]Choose Your Reward Event[/b][/h1]
We’re giving plenty of rewards and you get to choose which one you’ll receive! From potions to amulets to magic stones, take your pick!
[list][*]After clearing 2 dungeons within your level range, you can choose your reward for the day! Do that again the next day and choose another reward! It’s totes awesome![/list]

[h1][b]Shadow Vein Event[/b][/h1]
The new dungeon brings new adventures and events which means tons of new rewards! 
[list][*]Login for 20 minutes to get awesome items like [b][Cobo] Varnimyr Region Title Cube, [Cobo] Varnimyr Region Accessory Trial Cube,[/b] and [b]Mystic Stone Fragments![/b]
[*]You’ll also get [b]Mystic Stone Fragments[/b] and [b]Shining Mystic Stone Fragments[/b] daily for clearing certain Varnimyr dungeons! Go on, get those dungeons cleared and watch the rewards roll in! [/list]

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
Sweet Dreams are made of these… or at least they start with this attire! Get all comfy and cozy before a big fight and wake up refreshed! Who am I to disagree? Get the [b]Sweet Dream Set[/b] tomorrow!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/yl9Tuwj.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Bring Out the Mod Skills! Bring Out Your Strongest Powers!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/QUQTDv3.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! We’re rolling out two new Mod Skills for each characters this week just because we want you to be able to pack a mightier punch! We’ve also implemented new functions for a more streamlined Mod Skills experience so don’t forget to check it out! Plus, we’ve revamped the process of selling sealed items in the Market Board and we’ve added 1 more page to the El Resonance and Equipment pages! So, starting tomorrow you can customize another page and quickly transition from three different builds! How convenient is that?! And as always, we’ve got a new awesome Ice Burner set that you can complete! All these and more tomorrow!

[h1][b]Elsword Official 2018 2v2 Tournament[/b][/h1]
The time is upon us for the Official Elsword 2v2 Tournament! Registrations will open up [b]Friday, August 24th at 5PM PDT (UTC -7), and $500 + 50,000 K-Ching is on the line for the winning team[/b], so [url=https://elsword.koggames.com/2v2-tournament/]check out the rules[/url] and find your partner to prepare! Good luck!

[h1][b]RushAin Roulette Livestream is Back AGAIN! [/b][/h1]
Come join GM Rush as he hosts his own little 2v2 PVP Livestream tomorrow! No premades, so it’s the luck of the game on who you will be paired with. Winners will win K-Ching, and the only way you’ll have a chance of winning will be to participate! Livestream will start tomorrow, [b]August 22nd, at 5PM PDT / 8PM EDT on our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/Elsword]twitch channel[/url][/b], so see you there! 

[h1][b]New Mod Skills Event[/b][/h1]
When the Mod Skills come so do the epic events to help you get ‘em all!
[list][*]10 minutes of login time will get you an awesome [b][Cobo] Force Skill Support Box[/b] which contains [b][Cobo Refined Recovery Potions[/b] and a [b][Cobo] EXP 50% Medal (1 Day)![/b]  So, login in daily!
[*]Clear Elrianode and Varnimyr Dungeons to receive rewards ranging from [b][Cobo] Elrianode Defense Requests[/b] to [b][Cobo] Adaptation Elixir (1 Day)[/b] and MORE![/list]

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies [/b][/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/QBGwdBq.jpg[/img]

notes.title: The Varnimyr Region Raid is now Live!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/AmWfLBb.jpg[/img]

We’ve launched a new 3-part raid with 3 all new dungeons, the [b]Crimson Tower of Howling Flames[/b], [b]Never-Ending Darkness[/b], and [b]Crimson Cradle of Flames[/b]. 

After Nephilim Lord regains his senses, the El Search Party asks Nephilim Lord the location of the Dark El. Nephilim Lord asks the El Search Party to get rid of a tower that formed centuries ago, which was the cause of all the abnormalities in Spirit Asylum and in turn, he will give them the location of the Dark El. The El Search Party agrees to his demand, and head towards the tower, guided by a spirit they saved in Spirit Asylum…

The raid update also introduces the new Weekly Raid Ranking System. The top 100 players receive a 7-day sit motion Item. For more details on the raid, and to check out the current raid-related events, be sure to check out our [url= https://elsword.koggames.com/varnimyr-region-raid/]website[/url] for more details!

[h1][b]Don’t miss out on the August special events:[/b][/h1]
[list][*]For anybody new to Elsword that’d love to take a crack at what this massive end-game content is all about, this [b]Saturday, August 11, EVERYBODY who logs in for 10 minutes will receive 50 Philosopher’s Scrolls; when activated, each scroll is a free level up![/b] That means, you get to level a character 0 to hero just for showing up. Spend 20 minutes in-game and received a 3rd Job Advance Ticket and receive one Sage’s Magic Stone per every successful dungeon run!
 [*][url= https://elsword.koggames.com/summer-jumping-event-update/]Summer Jumping Event[/url] lasts through August 28. Receive 50% Bonus EXP and +2 Bugg to all weapons on all characters! Spend at least 30 minutes in-game per day and get one of the following: Heroic Equipment, Potions, Sage’s Magic Stone, or a Magic Wardrobe Ticket.[/list]

To learn more about Elsword please visit www.elsword.com and keep watching the official Steam page for more updates.

Play to Win, Play Your Manga, The time for the culling is now!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/sWErlCr.jpg[/img]

notes.title: The Time Has Come to Prepare for the Upcoming Raid!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/QWWeex3.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! After exploring the depths of the Demon Realm, the El Search Party may have encountered their most formidable opponents yet!
