notes.title: Put on Your Overalls and Till the Land for A New Farming Experience!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/xTtHjvJ.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! We know you haven’t even taken a breather from last week’s exciting events but we’ve got TONS of fun activities and even more events coming at you starting tomorrow! First, Varnimyr will reveal two more Dungeons – The Dark Elves’ Outpost and the Forsaken Spirit Asylum! Gather your mates and traverse these treacherous new lands for glory and bragging rights! For something totally unexpected, Elsword now has a farming function for you and your guildmates to enjoy! Plant and grow crops which you can use raw or cook them to make food with much better boosts, recovery, or buffs! Spend time cultivating guild soil so you can grow more! And lastly, we have a massive Magic Wardrobe update for you, you fashionable bunch. You can now store and apply literally hundreds of costume and equipment pieces even those from way back! Don’t miss all these wonderful events and more tomorrow!

And as always, we’ve got delightful stuff for you at the Item Mall. All you have to do is take a look!

[h1][b]Varnimyr Dungeon Events[/b][/h1]
Survive the demon realm and get those sweet rewards for your hard work!
[list][*]20 mins of login on the 1st Week gets you a [b][Cobo] Nightmare Blindfold (7 Days)[/b] and a [b][Cobo] Dark Elves’ Outpost Dungeon Title Trial Cube[/b]. A [b][Cobo] Code of Honor (7 Days)[/b] and a [b][Cobo] Forsaken Spirit Asylum Dungeon Title Trial Cube[/b] on the 2nd Week. You get these rewards once so don’t miss it!
[*]You’ll also get a daily reward per account of [b]1 Mystic Stone Fragment[/b] when you login for 20 minutes.
[*]And, your daily quests include clearing dungeons to get more of those [b]Mystic Stone Fragments[/b] which you can exchange through Ariel for useful consumables![/list]

[h1][b]Guild Farm Events[/b][/h1]
Start living the simple life and grow something useful for yourself and your guildmates. You’ll be reaping what you sow, fo sho!
[list][*]A daily login of 10 minutes will reward you with [b]1 [Cobo] Delicious Food Basket[/b] per character. You can also clear dungeons within your level range to get another food basket which contains a plethora of delicious consumables!
[*]Plant a seed and then harvest your crops up to three times for an awesome [b][Cobo] Antique Seed Pouch[/b]. It contains 10 seeds for your farming pleasure![/list]

[h1][b]GM Rush’s Play-The-Update[/b][/h1]
Watch GM Rush on the [url=https://www.twitch.tv/elsword]Elsword Twitch Channel[/url] on [b]Wednesday at 4:30 PM PDT[/b]. He’ll have a go at our all-new updates to help you understand what these are all about! Don’t miss this exciting blow-by-blow!

Here is your schedule so far for the COBO Crew streaming! More streams will be scheduled later, and you can keep tabs of who will be streaming and when by following our Twitch channel as the schedule is posted there (and we will be hosting their streams as well!).

[list][*]3 PM PDT: [url= https://www.twitch.tv/Jette15]Jette[/url]

[list][*]12 PM PDT: [url=https://www.twitch.tv/gytka312]Gytka[/url]

And then as always, the GMs will have their livestream on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/elsword]Friday at 5 PM PDT / 8 PM EDT[/url], so see you there!

[h1][b]OPNoobs Presents 2 Versus 2 Elsword Tournament[/b][/h1]
Watch as 32 teams battle it out for PVP Glory, and a chance to win a total of 60,000 K-Ching! Our friends over at The Overpowered Noobs are hosting this 2v2 tournament on their [url=https://www.twitch.tv/opnoobsonline]Twitch Channel[/url] this Saturday, July 28th, at 9:30 AM PDT / 12:30 PM EDT. You WON’T want to miss this! [url=https://www.opnoobs.com/e4i/elsword/details]View all the details on their website today![/url] 

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
Your mythical and mystical dreams finally come to life as we bring you this majestic creature! Get your hands on [b]Celes[/b] and start your gallop towards all the rainbow bridges tomorrow!

notes.title: We’re Raising the Quality of Life Once Again for You and the El Gang!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/LZZlVN2.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! Make sure your schedules are open because we’ve got TONS of exciting events happening this week! First up, we have another Quality of Life update where a plethora of exciting changes await you! From free inventory expansion of old characters who haven’t expanded yet to an ED Shop in the Item Mall where you can buy costumes, consumables, pets, and more using your hard-earned ED! This may be the most exciting update yet! Apart from that, we’re also introducing a new Enchant System for all your end-game gears, as well as a more streamlined way to display and distinguish your stats on the character UI and on the weapons! And we have another balance patch to go along these wonderful updates! 

But that’s not all because next up, we have two new end-game dungeons for your adventuring needs. The El Search Party goes into the Demon Realm where all manner of new and sinister creatures are waiting for them! Explore these new lands starting with the [b]Labyrinth of Ruin[/b] and then moving on to [b]Guardian’s Forest[/b]. And as always, don’t forget to check out the Item Mall for all the fun stuff we have in store for you!

[h1][b]Demon Realm Events[/b][/h1]
Explore the uncharted lands of the Demon Realm and defeat its mighty rulers. Epic rewards are waiting for you!
[list][*]For characters level 99, clear the Labyrinth of Ruin daily to get [b]1 Leviathan Fragment[/b] and [b]15 [Cobo] Highly Concentrated Recovery Potion[/b] every time! And get [b]1 Forginay’s Leaf[/b] and [b]15 [Cobo] Highly Concentrated Recovery Potion[/b] when you clear the Guardian’s Forest once daily!
[*]You can also exchange [b]Leviathan’s Fragments[/b] and/or [b]Forginay’s Leaves[/b] thru Ariel for even more wonderful rewards![/list]

[h1][b]Are You Ready Event[/b][/h1]
Are you ready for more daily rewards? Who doesn’t want more awesome rewards every day? Not us!
[list][*]All you have to do is Clear dungeons within your level range once for the lowest number of rewards, twice to get more rewards than the first, and three times for the most number of rewards! Check out the website tomorrow to find out what you’ll get![/list]

[h1][b]GM Rush’s Play-The-Update[/b][/h1]
Watch [url= https://www.twitch.tv/elsword]GM Rush on our Twitch Channel[/url] on [b]Wednesday at 4:30 PM PDT[/b]. He’ll have a go at our all-new updates to help you understand what these are all about! Don’t miss this exciting blow-by-blow!

[h1][b]COBO Crew Streaming[/b][/h1]
The COBO Crew are back at it again! Come hang out with some of your favorite Elsword streamers as they play Elsword! We have a handful of streams this week, so you can plan accordingly! We will be hosting the streams on our own channel as well as have the schedule posted there, so if you forget who is streaming you can always visit our page and go from there!

[b]Wednesday, July 11th[/b]
[list][*]2 PM PDT: [url= https://www.twitch.tv/hanzo_j2c]Hanzo_J2C[/url]
[*]6 PM PDT: [url= https://www.twitch.tv/silvershimo]SilverShimo[/url]][/list]

[b]Thursday, July 12th[/b]
[list][*]12 PM PDT: [url= http://www.twitch.tv/gytka312]Gytka[/url]
[*]3 PM PDT: [url= http://www.twitch.tv/Jette15]Jette[/url][/list]

[b]Saturday, July 14th[/b]
[list][*]5 PM PDT: [url= http://www.twitch.tv/KayneTheSlayer]KaynetheSlayer[/url][/list]

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
From school swimwear to champion swimwear, level up your water sports attire to something cooler! Choose between the [b]Velder[/b] or [b]Hamel High Swim Team[/b] for your champion swim set and get it tomorrow!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NcGYwEo.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, folks~
See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Upcoming Quality of Life Changes (July 11th Update)
notes.content:
[h1][b]MORE CONVENIENT[/b][/h1]

[b][Free Skill Slot Medal/Quick Slot][/b]
[list][*]All characters’ b slot and quick slot expansion will be free.
* Transcendence Skill Slot will not be expanded for free but you can acquire it by clearing a quest or purchasing it from the ED Shop in the Item Mall.[/list]

[b][ED Shop Update][/b]
[list][*]ED Shop contains Skill Slot Medal (Transcendence), Adult Pet, Fetch Aura, Costumes per Character, and etc. will be sold.
* Items purchased from the ED Shop can be stored in the share bank but cannot be traded.[/list]

[b][NPC Reward Exchange Function Change][/b]
[list][*]When exchanging multiple Random items from an NPC, you can receive different items.[/list]


[h1][b]FASTER[/b][/h1]

[b][Beginning Section Improved][/b]
[list][*]Noah’s Lake field will disappear and Elder Town and Ruben Town will be directly connected via porta.
[*]Quests related to Fields will either disappear or have their quest rewards and exp will be changed.
[*]Elrios Guide will be changed to Contents Guide and can be searched by key words.
[*]Required Level for Ereda Island and Quests will be changed to Lv.90.
[*]Quests related to Luto Mode will require Lv.75.[/list]

[b][Skip Function Improved][/b]
[*]When a Lv.5 or higher character uses the Quest Skip function, they will receive 50% of the EXP and receive the reward item.
(However, ED will not be rewarded and some quests related to Secret/Heroic Dungeons will not be skippable.)
[*]Recommended level for dungeons will be displayed on the dungeon select screen.[/list]

[b][Elrios Studio Quest Removed][/b]
[list][*]All quests related to Elrios Studio will be removed. (Players with already accepted quests can still complete it.)
[*]Quests rewards like ‘High-Performance Nasod Megaphone’ and ‘Cobo Entertainment Studio’ can be purchased from the Item Mall using K-Ching or ED.
[*]However, items purchased from the ED Shop will be tagged [Cobo] and cannot be traded.[/list]

[b][Mentor Quest Improved][/b]
[list][*]Mentor Quest requirement will be improved.[/list]

[b][El Resonance Quest Improved][/b]
[list][*]El Resonance Quests will be improved.[/list]

[b][Camilla’s Skill Quest Improved][/b]
[list][*]Camilla’s Intermediate/Advanced/Expert Manual quests will be improved.[/list]

[b][Stamina Improved!][/b]
[list][*]Stamina spent from all dungeons and fields will be reduced and Ereda Island no longer consumes stamina. [/list]

[b][Old Character Inventory Expansion] [/b]
[list][*]All old characters with Inventories smaller than 8 x 5 will be expanded to 8 x 5. [/list]

[b][Market Board ED Limit Increase] [/b]
[list][*]Market Board ED Limit will increase from 3 Billion ED to 5 Billion ED. [/list]

[b][Share Bank Improvement] [/b]
[list][*]You can now deposit ED in share bank. (Limit 5 Billion ED depending on the player’s Bank Rank) [/list]
Share Bank now has a sort function.

[b][Secret/Heroic Dungeon, Elrianode City, and El Tower Defense can be entered 1 time a day for free] [/b]
[list][*]Free Daily Entry will reset every midnight server time. [/list]

[b][Secret Dungeon Tab] [/b]
[list][*]All Secret Dungeons will be moved to a Secret Dungeon tab. The Secret Dungeon tab will be opened at Lv.70. [/list]

[b][Heroic Gear Improved] [/b]
[list][*]All Heroic Gears can no longer go below Heroic Rank Lv.10. [/list]


[h1][b]MORE IMPROVEMENTS![/b][/h1]
[b][Equipment Enhancement Safe to +8!)][/b]
[list][*]Equipment Enhance can no longer fail up to +8.
[*][Apocalypse Type – Void Weapon Cube can now be share banked.]
[*][As you clear Add’s Energy Fusion Theory Dungeon without getting the Weapon Drop, the chances of the weapon cube dropping will increase.] 
[*]Even if you don’t pick-up the weapon cube, once it drops, the increased drop rate will reset.[/list]

[b][Epic PVP Quest Improved][/b]
[list][*]Required level for quest will become Lv.75 and the quest will become easier. 
[*]When clearing an Epic PVP Quest, you will be given Camilla’s Sparring Equipment Cube (+8) as a reward.[/list]

[b][Character Slot Revamp] [/b]
[list][*]Avg. Item Level will be removed from the Character Info UI but will be replaced by Combat/Defense Power. 
[*]Also, dungeon entry requirements will be changed from Item Level to Combat Power. 
[*]You can now check the below options from the Stats window.
[*]Some stats will be shown as % instead of numbers. 
[*](Example: Maximize 572 à Maximize 4%)[/list]

[b][Item Revamp][/b]
[list][*]Equipment set effect from beginning leveling part will be removed. (lv.1 ~ Lv.90, Secret Dungeon Excluded), Magic Stone Enchant Socket numbers will increase depending on the level. 
[*]Depending on the Rank of Lv.1 ~ Lv.90, Secret Dungeon Excluded, will be provided more random effects.
[*]Specialization A & B will be removed and the A & B options will be changed.[/list]

[B][If Specialization A & B is a fixed effect][/b]
[list][*]Critical Chance, Maximize % 
[*]Certain Set Effects or Title Effects will be changed.[/list]

[b][If Specialization A & B is a random option or a socket effect][/b]
[list][*]You can change to the below effect from Ariel. 
[*]* Critical Chance, Add Damage, Maximize, Add Damage, Attack Speed, Damage Reduction, MP Gain (Attack), MP Gain (Attacked)
[*]Specific Skill Damage Increase effect will no longer appear from equipment. 
[*]However, effects that existed before this change will remain and all new equipment will have ‘All Skill Damage Increase’ option.[/list]

[b][Old Ice Burner Improvement][/b]
[list][*]Old Ice Burners will no longer require phoru footstamps to trade. You can now freely trade all Ice Burners without seals.[/list]

[h1]For more details on all the changes happening with the 7/11 update, please visit our website [url=https://elsword.koggames.com/2018/06/upcoming-quality-of-life-changes-july-11th-update/]here.[/url][/h1]

All old characters with Inventories smaller than 8 x 5 will be expanded to 8 x 5.
Market Board ED Limit will increase from 3 Billion ED to 5 Billion ED.
You can now deposit ED in share bank. (Limit 5 Billion ED depending on the player’s Bank Rank)
Share Bank now has a sort function.
Secret/Heroic Dungeon, Elrianode City, and El Tower Defense can be entered 1 time a day for free
Free Daily Entry will reset every midnight server time.
All Secret Dungeons will be moved to a Secret Dungeon tab. The Secret Dungeon tab will be opened at Lv.70.
All Heroic Gears can no longer go below Heroic Rank Lv.10.
Equipment Enhance can no longer fail up to +8.
Apocalypse Type – Void Weapon Cube can now be share banked.
As you clear Add’s Energy Fusion Theory Dungeon without getting the Weapon Drop, the chances of the weapon cube dropping will increase.
Even if you don’t pick-up the weapon cube, once it drops, the increased drop rate will reset.
Required level for quest will become Lv.75 and the quest will become easier.
When clearing an Epic PVP Quest, you will be given Camilla’s Sparring Equipment Cube (+8) as a reward.
Avg. Item Level will be removed from the Character Info UI but will be replaced by Combat/Defense Power.
Also, dungeon entry requirements will be changed from Item Level to Combat Power.
You can now check the below options from the Stats window.
Some stats will be shown as % instead of numbers.
(Example: Maximize 572 à Maximize 4%)
Equipment set effect from beginning leveling part will be removed. (lv.1 ~ Lv.90, Secret Dungeon Excluded), Magic Stone Enchant Socket numbers will increase depending on the level.
Depending on the Rank of Lv.1 ~ Lv.90, Secret Dungeon Excluded, will be provided more random effects.
Specialization A & B will be removed and the A & B options will be changed.
Critical Chance, Maximize %
Certain Set Effects or Title Effects will be changed.
You can change to the below effect from Ariel.
* Critical Chance, Add Damage, Maximize, Add Damage, Attack Speed, Damage Reduction, MP Gain (Attack), MP Gain (Attacked)
Specific Skill Damage Increase effect will no longer appear from equipment.
However, effects that existed before this change will remain and all new equipment will have ‘All Skill Damage Increase’ option.
Old Ice Burners will no longer require phoru footstamps to trade. You can now freely trade all Ice Burners without seals.

notes.title: New Guild Expeditions and Permanent Daily Rewards are Coming At You!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/oEACopF.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! We’ve got big things coming tomorrow! Tons of exciting changes and fun events that we know you’ll go crazy for are happening this week so strap in and read on! First up, we have the awesome new Guild Revamp. We’ve added something called Guild Expeditions to make your guilding experience a tad more exciting. We’ve also added the use of Guild Banners because we want your Guild to Represent! Getting excited yet? You can find out more when it comes out. Next is something totally exciting because it involves rewards and who doesn’t like rewards?! We’ve just made Daily Login Rewards permanent addition to the game! That’s right, just log-in, spend time in game, and claim your rewards! Returning users will also get a special set of rewards when they come back, and the best part is, they can also get the Regular player set of rewards! This is the perfect time for you or your friends to return!  

Then we have another Elrios World Travel event! Same simple mechanics but totally different epic rewards! And lastly, we have balanced some of the characters once again for your enjoyment! But importantly, Transcendence Skills have been added as a socket option! You’ll feel more powerful! And as always, don’t forget to check out the fun new stuff at the Item Mall tomorrow!

[h1][b]GUILD EXPEDITION QUESTS[/b][/h1]
Build your Guild Banner so you can represent your members anytime, anywhere! These quests will help you get your foot out the expedition door!
[list][*]The more guild members you party with, the bigger the boost! So, party up with as many guildmates as you can to create that lasting bond and an epic looking flag!
[*]Clearing appropriate dungeons will reward each member with either [b][Cobo] Guild Honor Points 50% Medal, [Cobo EXP 50% Boost Medal, or [Cobo] Dungeon Entrance Ticket Selective Cube![/b]
[*]Participate in the Guild Expeditions and you can get special items like [b][Cobo] Royal Roll Cake,[/b] and [b][Cobo] Guild Elixirs![/b][/list]

[h1][b]ELRIOS WORLD TRAVEL 2[/b][/h1]
Go around the world in few days and you’ll get exclusive event costumes from places you’ve visited!
[list][*]Once you’ve selected a destination, you already get [b]25 [Cobo] Phoru Airlines In-flight Food, 25 [Cobo] Phoru Airlines Special Drinks,[/b] and a [b]1-Day Hair and Costume![/b]
[*]Don’t forget, all the [b][Cobo] Elrios Travel Coins[/b] you get can be exchanged to Ariel for consumables and exclusive costumes![/list]

[h1][b]ITEM MALL GOODIES[/b][/h1]
Your enemies will let their guards down when they see you and when they do that’s when you’ll strike! Become a fierce hero in this cute sheep’s ensemble with the [b]Mary’s Little Lamb Costume Suit![/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Mlqsfi0.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

Heya adventurers! How y’all doing? Before we get to talking about awesome events we have for you this week, here’s a little reminder about the Super HOT Attendance Event: You only have a few days left to complete your login days. And when you do, you’ll have with you a total of [b]9 [Cobo] Phoru Foot Stamp (Gold)[/b] for all your sealing needs! Complete the login! 

For this week’s events, we have the continuation of the Super HOT Attendance Event! That’s right, that means two more weeks of daily rewards when you login! Isn’t that awesome? The next set of rewards will start tomorrow, so don’t miss out! 

Aside from the Super HOT Event, maintenance will happen Wednesday night instead of tonight as usual, so you will have to wait one more day to see the rest of the content reach the game, like the new awesome Mod Skills! We can’t wait to see more power, more destruction, and more fun during your fights! You can test out these new skills and the new balance adjustments as we start the new season of PVP, and who knows, they just might take you to the top! And as always, we’ve got awesome new goodies at the Item Mall for you this week! Don’t forget to check ‘em out!

[h1][b]New Mod Skills Event[/b][/h1]
With the new Mod skills out, we’ll make it easier for you to find them so you can collect them all!
[list][*]10 minutes of login will give you [b]10 [Cobo] Elrianode Defense Request[/b] so you can hunt for these epic skills like there’s no tomorrow!
[*]For players level 99, clearing the Elrianode dungeon once daily will give them a [b][Cobo] Stamina Potion 100%[/b] and a [b][Cobo] Drop Rate Bonus 25% Medal![/b][/list]

[h1][b]The Void Weapon Rush Hour – Tues, Wed, & Thurs[/b][/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Z5jhxwJ.jpg[/img]

GM Rush has heard your requests to stream his Add's Energy Fusion Theory Dungeon runs, and he is now ready to bring you along with him on his journey to obtain the coveted Void Weapon!

How many runs will it take him to receive it? 1 run? 100 runs? 596 runs? Who knows! We won't until he gets it (and that could be a while, maybe), so why not tune in to our Twitch channel and join this adventure with him!

The Void Weapon Rush Hour will occur every Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday @ 4:30 PM PDT / 7:30 PM EDT 
[url= https://twitch.tv/elsword]https://twitch.tv/elsword[/url]
 
[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
Search for clues high and low, piece them together, and find the culprit before he bolts! Become Elrios’ greatest sleuth by matching your looks with your demeanor! Get the [b]Elrios Detective Academy Costume Set[/b] coming this week!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/d8BfTyH.jpg[/img]

notes.title: The Quality of Gaming Life is About to Get Some Major Improvements!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/PyQNU4F.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! You may not know or you just may have forgotten and we really don’t want you to be taken by surprise, but today will be the last you can purchase [b]IB: Mariposa Requiem[/b] pieces! You have less than 24-hours to complete this set haul up on as many as you can! Take a look at how awesome this set is and may the odds be in your favor!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/oh1zezj.jpg[/img]

We have a lot of activities for you this week, starting with major [b]Quality of Life[/b] changes! Even the small changes make a big impact so don’t forget to check that out! Our next awesome event this week has daily rewards and who doesn’t want to get their hands on some rewards? Not me, that’s for sure! [b]The Super-HOT Attendance Event[/b] guarantees you get your reward every day as long as you login! The [b]Combo Video Submission[/b] for Luciel, Rose, and Ain are also on-going so you better conjure up some of your fanciest move for the last video submission event.  And as always, don’t forget that we have wonderful new stuff at the Item Mall this week! 

[h1][b]Elsword Quality of Life Event[/b][/h1]
These new and wonderful improvements also bring with them awesome rewards! Get Daily rewards and, check out the benefit/boost for the day!
[list][*]For players level 10 and up, they can clear a dungeon within their level 3x for [b]5 [Cobo] Twisted Sage’s Magic Stone[/b]
[*]Don’t forget to log-in every day for boosts and benefits galore! Get a different boost every day of the week![/list]
[h1][b]Super HOT Attendance Event[/b][/h1]
Log in everyday for wonderful daily rewards with more rewards on the accumulative day! Complete your attendance tomorrow!

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]

Get ready to harness the power of Night and Day! The [b]Dusk & Dawn Sovereign Ice Burner Sets[/b] will be your powerful aid no matter the time of day!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/QBGwdBq.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, folks~

notes.title: Let’s Get Physical and Banish the Epidemic at The Athletic Meet!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/TX5FVnV.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! What are you up to? We hope you have lots of time to spare because this is going to be a fun-filled week! First, we’ve got an exciting new event dungeon that’ll keep you coming back for more! We’ve also made more rebalances to select characters that you’ll be able to see and test out tomorrow! 

Combo Video Submissions for Raven, Eve, and Chung are about to end but you still have a bit of time to submit them until midnight tonight, if you haven’t yet! K-Ching and a chance to be recorded by GM Zero is within your reach! Lastly, don’t forget to watch our PVP Finale and witness the birth of a mighty champion! And as always, don’t forget the fun new stuff we have at the Item Mall tomorrow!

[h1][b]Velder Academy Athletic Meet[/b][/h1]
Don’t forget to warm up for this fun and exciting event dungeon we have for you! Destroy all the La-Z viruses and clear the field of all infections by beating them to a pulp! You’ll get awesome rewards when you do!
[list][*]10 minutes of logging in on the weekdays will give you [b]2 [Cobo] Velder Academy Athletic Meet Qualification[/b] so you can join in taking out the viral plague! AND, 10 minutes of log in on the weekend will give you [b]5 [Cobo] Velder Academy Athletic Meet Qualifications![/b]
[*]Plus, get extra special rewards for two weekends! What those are, you’ll have to find out!
[*]And once you’ve collected enough [b]Velder Academy Batons[/b] you can exchange them to Ariel for consumables but more importantly, COSTUMES![/list]

[h1][b]Combo Video Submission[/b][/h1]
As one batch ends, another one opens! As the submission for Raven, Eve, and Chung is almost ending, it’s now Ara, Elesis, and Add’s turn in the spotlight. Show us your best moves because [b]BIG[/b] prizes are waiting for you!

[h1][b]PVP Championship[/b][/h1]
The final 6 are wrapping up with Team SilverShimo finishing up later today [b](5 PM PDT / 8 PM EDT on our Twitch channel)[/b], and this coming [b]Friday, May 18th at 4 PM PDT[/b] you can bear witness to the birth of our PVP Champion! Who will reign supreme? Watch the exciting finale only on https://www.twitch.tv/elsword!

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
The best school deserves the best uniform and if you want to be the best, the [b]Velder Academy Uniform[/b] is for you! 


[img]https://i.imgur.com/A9UcdpZ.jpg[/img]

Get the Premium package for an adorable motion to match!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Yhy1vea.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/wOYPLAQ.gif[/img]

Plus, go cheer on your favorite team (or yourself) during the Athletic Meet with these accessories!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/hobmhs9.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: The Corrupted Warden of Darkness Brings More Rewards with New Events!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/7LmFHug.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! What are you up to this fine week? We hope you Level 99 peeps are going all out on Drabaki this week as well. If you’re not 99 yet, don’t fret! We know you’re going to make it in time to be able to test out your skills against this mighty beast, just keep leveling up! We’ve got exciting things happening this week and as always, we’ve got a fun new item at the Item Mall you’ll definitely want to own! All these and more, tomorrow!

[h1][b]Drabaki Event 2[/b][/h1]
A new event pops up just in time to help you stock up on essential items before you go charging towards Drabaki!
[list][*]For players level 99, you’ll get a [b][Cobo] Drabaki Update Promo Selective Cube[/b] when you use your skills 100 times in the Arena and in any Dungeons not including those in Ruben! Such a simple way to earn rewards![/list]

[h1][b]1v1 PVP Tournament Starts Tomorrow![/b][/h1]
The brackets have been set, the matches are lined up, and all that’s needed now is a big bowl of popcorn to snack on while you watch some of the best PVP players in Elsword duke it out for glory, honor, and the ultimate prize!

The first bracket airs tomorrow, May 9th, at 4 PM PDT / 7 PM EDT, and you can watch all the fun on our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/Elsword]twitch channel[/url]. Also, be sure to check out the brackets [url=https://elsword.koggames.com/1v1-tournament/]on our website here[/url] to make sure you don’t miss out watching your favorite players try to climb the ranks to ultimate PVPness!

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
Don’t start pulling your hair out when stress gets too unbearable, let our heroes relax in a hot spring that you can bring anywhere! The [b]Warm Mini Spa[/b] is a calming sit motion that’s available tomorrow!

notes.title: Slay the Beast of Fahrmann’s Peak and Celebrate 7 Years with the El Search Party!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/zmirwJb.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! We’ve got an awesome and jam-packed week ahead of us starting with Elsword’s 7th Anniversary Celebration! Join us in this wonderful event or you’ll miss out big time on a week of boosts, and TONS of awesome giveaway! Then here’s some good news for the raiders this week – Drabaki, The Serpent of the Mountain, is wreaking havoc in the lands of Elrios. Get ready to battle and test your strength against this great beast and see how you fare! Fashionistas rejoice and sing your hallelujahs because accessory looks can now be overridden with looks that match your unique style! Complete a streamlined look but keep your stats in this newest Magic Wardrobe update coming in tomorrow! Never choose between form and function again, you can have both! And as always there’s new stuff at the Item Mall just for you!

[h1][b]Elsword 7th Anniversary Event[/b][/h1]
Join us as we celebrate 7 years of Elsword! That’s right, our beloved game turns 7 and we’re bringing TONS of boosts and epic rewards that are only available during this time! Don’t miss out!
[list][*]All characters level 10 and up will get an exclusive sit motion! The [b]Ely’lywood Blue Carpet![/b] Make sure to login all of your characters for ONLY 10 minutes so they can get it!
[*]Next, 30 minutes of accumulative login time will give you a [b][Cobo] Anniversary Trial Cube[/b] that contains tons of useful consumables and a [b]1 Day 7 Year Anniversary Skill Cut In![/b]
[*]Want a permanent skill cut-in though? Easy-peasy! Collect Anniversary stamps by logging in for an accumulated time of 30 mins and once you have enough, exchange them via Ariel for different types of cubes that include the permanent [b]7 Year Anniversary Skill Cut-in![/b][/list]

[h1][b]Drabaki Event[/b][/h1]
Meet the corrupted warden of darkness at Fahrmann’s Peak. Stop the beast from wreaking havoc and prove yourself in the rankings! Are you deserving of this great monster’s bounty?
[list][*]20 minutes of accumulative connection for characters level 99 will get [b]1 [Cobo] Twisted Time and Space Key[/b] so they can enter and fight![/list]

[h1][b]1-on-1 With Pie[/b][/h1]
Ever wanted to ask some of your favorite GMs a question, such as who their favorite Elsword NPC is, their favorite dungeon to run, or the one food they wouldn’t touch with a 10-foot pole? Now is your chance! Come join GM Pie as he interviews some of the GMs this week, starting with GM Moshup today, and prepare some questions you want to ask. [b]There is a chance you may get picked to ask your questions![/b] See you later today, and then come back tomorrow to interview GM Srirachalada, and then again on Thursday, leading up to the weekly GM Livestream on Friday!
[list][*]Livestreams will happen today, tomorrow, Thursday, and Friday on our Twitch channel at 4 PM PDT / 7 PM EDT. [url=https://www.twitch.tv/Elsword]See you there![/url][/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ydqkNHH.png[/img]

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
We’re bringing some simple and basic accessories to the table this time around. Completely chill and dress down with the [b]Hedgehog Tote and Pen Accessory Set![/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/FRe4bOk.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Become the Coolest Jet-setter in Elrios and Travel the World Elsword-style!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/yffXOis.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! How are you this fine day? We’ve got a jam-packed week for you so get ready for tons of fun events and awesome rewards! First up, we have a Balance update coming up, get ready for tiny tweaks that make a big impact on your skills, and don’t forget to test them out as well! Next, we have an event perfect for all the travelers out there – pair it up with tons of amazing rewards and you’ll be going places non-stop! And lastly, it’s time to get your winning character combos ready! Show the world what you can do because you have a chance to win TONS of K-Ching! And as always, don’t forget to take a peek at the Item Mall for new stuff and things! All these and more, tomorrow!

[h1][b]Balance Patch Event[/b][/h1]
Newly rebalanced skills bring for a more streamlined gaming experience and we bring a very simple but fun event with this important patch!
[list][*]Clear dungeons daily up to three times and get these rewards: [b][Cobo] Recovery Potions, [Cobo] EXP Boost Medal 50% (7 Days), [Cobo] Stamina Potions,[/b] and [b][Cobo] Mana Elixir![/b] How’s that for easy questing?
[*]And if that’s not simple enough, we’re having an attendance event where all you need to do is login for 20 mins to get epic rewards![/list]

[h1][b]Elrios World Travels[/b][/h1]
Become the coolest jet-setter in all of Elrios! Choose your destination for the day and complete the quests to get awesome rewards including an extra awesome [b]event-exclusive sit-motion[/b]!
[list][*]Complete your destination quests for the day and get [b]Elrios Travel Coins![/b]
[*]Use the coins to exchange them with Ariel for the following costume suits: [b]Yukata, Martial Arts,[/b] and [b]Water Spirit![/b] 
[*]You can also exchange just [b]1 Elrios Travel Coin[/b] for [b]5 Phoru Airline Beverages![/b] Happy travels~[/list]

[h1][b]Combo Video Contest[/b][/h1]
Showoff your character’s greatest moves and become a combo master! Let out your creativity and mesmerize the audience with your character’s impeccable techniques. And, if enough people are absolutely stunned by your flawless feats, they can vote for it and you might get a chance to win grand prizes! Be sure to check it out tomorrow!

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
You won’t need to ask your father to take you to the city to see a marching band! Dress up like in you’re in one and let out beautiful beats with the [b]Elrios Marching Band Costume Set[/b] tomorrow! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/X4lSrFW.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Bring Order Back to the Velder Academy Library and Check Out New Sparring Features!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/2Jb3k9o.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! How are y’all doing? Have you reached the peak of 3rd Job goodness? If not, don’t worry, you’ll reach it soon! Just hang tight and keep leveling. This week, we have TONS of new improvements in our Sparring System like Free Training improvements where you can now check for damage info, choose map options, choose a new NPC, and many more! We’ve also added Spectator Mode where a maximum of 4 spectators can watch and observe a match! Then there’s also a new El Resonance feature where you can add an El Resonance page with a completely different build! How awesome is that?

Apart from these improvements, there’s a new event dungeon as well where you can beat those pesky Phorus and teach Professor Banthus a lesson! And as always, don’t forget to check out the Item Mall for all the awesome goodies we have in store for you! All these and more, tomorrow!

[h1][b]Love, Love Academy Event[/b][/h1]
Deep within the shelf-lined halls of the prestigious Velder Academy’s Library lies a Suspicious(?) Book. Phoru Students and Professor Banthus are wreaking havoc just to get it. Stop the destruction and reap the rewards!
[list][*]Get [b]2 [Cobo] Velder Academy Library Card[/b] when you login for 10 minutes! Get inside that library and collect [b]Suspicious(?) Pages[/b]!
[*]Exchange your [b]Suspicious(?) Pages[/b] with Ariel and if you’ve collected enough you can get epic rewards like idle motions, skill cut-ins and more![/list]

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
Don’t just stand around looking awkward, do something fun! Like take a selfie! [b]Selfie 101[/b] is a new idle motion that’s sure to catch everyone’s attention!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kmIbUhr.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/DdtYneO.gif[/img]

Dish out powerful skills but don’t forget you’re still just a youth in spring! Show how epic damage dealing makes your heart go ‘doki-doki’! [b]Fluttering Heart Skill Cut-In[/b] comes out tomorrow!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kA7bxsu.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in game!

notes.title: 3rd Job Madness Brings Endless Fun, Amazing Boosts, and Epic Rewards!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Fum7ZGD.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! How are y’all doing? We hope you’re still pumped and still have that 3rd job high because we’ve got so much in store for you now that you’re all very familiar with your favorite 3rd Job classes! This week, you can test out your characters and match up against other players with the PVP Revamp now that PVP Season 6 begins tomorrow! We’ve also got an awesome Enhancement Event to help you make your epic equips more awesome! And don’t forget, there are always new things at the Item Mall we can’t wait for you to get your hands on!

[h1][b]PVP Revamp + Season 6[/b][/h1]
It’s time to oil your gears once more because PVP Season 6 begins tomorrow! Ranks have been reset and you may just become the top dog this time around!
[list][*]Login for 10 minutes to receive a [b][Cobo] +10 Sparring Equipment Cube[/b] and a [b][Cobo] PVP Essential Items Cube (15 Days)[/b] which contains rings and a magic necklace!
[*]Plus, earn milestone rewards by completing individual and guild PVP![/list]

[h1][b]Enhancement Event[/b][/h1]
Hold on to your hats because another round of enhancement event awesomeness is here! Be sure not to miss it, though, because this awesome event is only for 1 day tomorrow!
[list][*]Login for an accumulative time of 10 mins to receive [b]2 [Cobo] Blessed Fluorite Ore, 2 [Cobo] Blessed Restoration Scroll,[/b] and [b]2 El’s Hammer![/b]
[*]Most exciting of all, for one day only, all enhancement aid requirements will be reduced to 1 when enhancing from level 8 to 13![/list]

[h1][b]Elsword Amazon Shop Is Now Open![/b][/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/T9aFUM9.jpg[/img]
Check out the awesome items we have in store for you! This Elsword swag is not only fun but very well-made and in high demand. All these items all waiting to be purchased and just a click away!

More items will be added soon, but supplies are limited, so grab them now while they’re still hot! [url=https://elsword.koggames.com/2018/03/elsword-amazon-shop-is-now-open/]Visit our website to see all the goodies on sale![/url]

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
Take to the streets and turn it into your runway! Flaunt this fashionable set and garner the stares of friends and enemies alike! The [b]Street Star Costume Set[/b] comes out tomorrow!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CuG6IdL.jpg[/img]

Complement your Street Star ensemble with a pair of heart-shaped tinted sunglasses to match! This accessory is sold separately.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/PhZL0zG.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now folks~

notes.title: Continue Your Leap to Greatness with Your New Companion!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Wcd52eQ.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! We’ve finally completed the epic Third Job transformations for all paths, at last! Since you’ve probably already spent enough time with your characters, which one is your favorite so far? Are you digging the canon paths more or is the call of the dark side too strong to ignore? Let us know! By the way, how are y’all loving our list of amazing events, so far? Have you made that great jump to 90 yet? If you haven’t, you better not dawdle because this event won’t last long! With that said, last week’s events are still on-going so enjoy it while you can! 

We have two new awesome Forum Events with to keep your creative juices flowing, so don’t forget to check those out as well because winners will get TONS of K-Ching! And as always, don’t forget to check out the Item Mall to see what’s

[h1][b]Forum Events[/b][/h1]
[b][url=https://forum.elsword.koggames.com/forum/news-and-announcements/contests/229848-eldoodle-3rd-job-edition]El Doodle: 3rd Job Edition[/url][/b]
Now that ALL of the third jobs are out, we know y’all are gawking at their beautiful forms so why not show off your awesome art skeelz and win some K-Ching? All you have you have to do is draw your favorite 3rd Job Character and that’s it! That’s your entry! But make sure you follow the guidelines and don’t forget to include your IGN + Server!

[b][url=https://forum.elsword.koggames.com/forum/news-and-announcements/contests/229841-luck-of-the-irish]Luck of the Irish[/url][/b]
It’s time we go green… for St. Patrick’s Day! Celebrate the occasion by wearing your greenest and best outfit! Show off your flair for fashion! Take a screenshot of your character celebrating St. Patty’s Day and post it on the forums! 10 lucky winners will get 1,000 K-Ching!

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
This messenger of death walks with you to complement your ominous presence! You can raise her up yourself for a cute (but just as intimidating) little [b]Morte[/b] or if you want to reap the full benefits immediately, the adult version will be right up your alley!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/nSoSYk7.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now folks~

See y’all in-game!

[list][*]Don’t forget, just like before, each quest in the chain quest you complete will reward you with extremely useful items, costumes, accessories, and more!
[*]Get a [b]Topiary of Transformation (15 Days) and (Permanent)[/b] when you complete Quest 2 and 20 respectively![/list]

[h1][b]GM Livestream Today[/b][/h1]
The GMs will be hosting a special livestream today that will have exciting news too big to tell you in this blog, so if you want to be one of the first people to know what is headed your way, you won’t want to miss this Livestream! Livestream starts at 5 PM PST / 8 PM EST on our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/Elsword]Elsword Twitch Channel[/url]. See you then!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/lP5jGHW.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
Fly like a butterfly, and sting like a… butterfly? Sure, why not! This elegant [b]Mariposa Set[/b] will make the calmest friend you have convulse in envy. Show off and slay foes while donning giant butterfly wings! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/jilSFmq.jpg[/img]

And if you just want those piercing [b]Mariposa Eyes[/b], you can buy it separately! Stun your enemies with a powerful glance!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/DeU5yAG.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, folks~
See y’all in-game!

notes.title: The 3rd Path Opens the Road to Greatness! It’s Prep Time Again!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/86pVEeL.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! How y’all doing today? As you may have read in the title, 3rd Jobs for 3rd Paths Preparation Event (including 4th Path for Rose) is just a few hours away! It’s time to prep once again for the last time if you’re ready to transform because we are so ready! And as always, don’t forget that we have new stuff and thangs at the Item Mall that guarantees an Olympic gold medal! Check these out and more tomorrow!

[h1][b]Openbucks Promo[/b][/h1]
Still on the fence about purchasing K-Ching? This may be the promo you need to get you started! From February 21 to 27, 2018 players who load up using Gift cards from CVS, Subway, and Dollar General will get 20% BONUS K-Ching! Don’t miss it!

[h1][b]3rd Job-3rd Path Pre-Event[/b][/h1]
Get your 3rd Path characters ready because it’s their turn to have an epic transformation! Events, rewards, and more await!
[list][*]Characters you selected to participate in the event automatically gets half of the EXP required to level up at no cost! You only have to do half the job of leveling that character up!
[*]Characters who achieve [b]Lvl 70[/b] during the event will get the [b]Book of Transcendence: God’s Will[/b] to bypass quests and requirements so you can Transcend in no time!
[*]When you reach level 90, you’ll get a [b]Unique-Grade Heroic Weapon[/b] to deal an even mightier blow! This weapon alone makes it all worth it!
[*]And there’s so much more than you’ll definitely need to check out the site tomorrow for all the juicy details![/list]
[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
Go for gold and outmaneuver your enemies on ice with the new [b]Frozen Edge Costume Suit[/b]. Perform pirouettes and ace your landings with the motion that comes with the package!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZgMbiOP.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Show Your Burning Passion Because Love Is in The Air This Week!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/1Md6tp7.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! This week we show our love to you with an awesome event that’ll grow your heart 3 sizes! So, watch out for a fun-filled day full of love tomorrow! And don’t forget our awesome Sweepstakes Event with TONS of epic prizes for players of all regions. The more playtime hours you accumulate, the more entries you get for a chance to win 15,000 K-Ching! 

In case, you don’t already know the New & Returning Characters Event is back at it again with boosts and rewards. Whether you’re a returning character or a player making a new character, we’ve got something to help you reach third jobs quickly! And if you have some K-Ching to spend, don’t forget to check out the Item Mall! There’s always something new and fun for everyone!

[h1][b]Valentine’s Day Event[/b][/h1]
Here’s a simple but sweet event for you to do on Valentine’s day when you’ve got no date! But of course, you can also do this together with your date!
[list][*]Get [b][Cobo] Sweet Chocolates[/b] every 2 times you use your Quick Slot items!
[*]Get your [b][Cobo] Couple Rings[/b] and show the world that you’re the best pair! Just clear 10 dungeons within your level!
[*]All this and more tomorrow![/list]

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
When the cold never really bothered you in the slightest, flaunt these [b]Shining Snowy Accessories[/b] in front of your friends! Available tomorrow!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/4PKoN1g.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ppgLQNR.gif[/img]

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in game!

notes.title: The Second Ultimate Path Opens! Start Your Ascend to Greatness Tomorrow!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Zc8ygPS.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers, tomorrow is the big day! Are you ready?! Because we are so pumped for everything that will happen tomorrow! We have plenty of events and TONS of awesome rewards for everyone so you really shouldn’t miss the 3rd job-2nd path launch! We also have something for new and returning characters so you can catch up and reach 3rd Jobs as fast as you can! And as always don’t forget to check out the Item Mall for new stuff!

[h1][b]3rd Job Events[/b][/h1]
Feel the rush of new-found powers once more! Unlock 2nd Path’s 3rd Job and reach the pinnacle of might and magic! Fantastic rewards are waiting just by logging in for 10 minutes and doing quests!
[list][*]Only need a few more levels to get to 3rd jobs? We got you, fam! Login for 10 minutes (per account) and you’ll get not 1, not 3, not even 5, but [b]10 Philosopher’s Scroll![/b]
[*]If you want a permanent accessory, this event has got the thing for you! Just complete the chain quest and you’ll get a [b]Topiary of Growth![/b]
[*]After reaching 3rd Jobs, head right on to the dungeons to test out your newly unlocked powers! You’ll even get rewarded for it![/list]

[h1][b]New & Returning Characters[/b][/h1]
Whether you want to start from scratch, you’re completely new to the game, or want to continue your epic journey, we’ve got just the thing to help you out!
[list][*]1st and 2nd Class Advance Tickets are [b]FREE[/b] in the Item Mall during this time! 
[*]Awesome chain quests for both New and Returning characters are available and will reward you big time![/list]

[h1][b]Facebook[/b][/h1]
Don’t forget to check out our Facebook page to be the first to know about news, announcements, events, and more! [url=https://www.facebook.com/Elsword]Follow us![/url]

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
No one is as sweet as the boy or girl who dresses up as a chocolate maker! Get the [b]Chocolatier Costume[/b] and start showing off your sweet side tomorrow!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/0Qm6jLz.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Don’t Stop Me Now! Dungeon Fun Runs and 3rd Job Prepping Continues!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/kmPBMLA.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! This week we’re bringing you ways to looks epic and fierce while you prep for round two of 3rd Jobs! Speaking of, if you don’t already know what’s happening, prepping week is on-going again for characters in the 2nd path so if you haven’t started, we urge you to do so because if you miss this, you’ll miss the awesome rewards as well. 

Don’t you also forget about the awesome Gear Up Burning Event that grants you double drop rates in Heroic Dungeon and Add’s Energy Fusion Theory Dungeon for an hour. Plus, that 2 hours of Unlimited Stamina is sooo tempting! Don’t miss this and more tomorrow!

[h1][b]ITEM MALL GOODIES[/b][/h1]

For days when you’re feeling that a cutesy mount won’t cut it, we have our newest mount for players that aim to intimidate. [b]Amba[/b] is a white tiger mount that means business. Get it tomorrow!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/De6HIZv.jpg[/img]

Feeling a bit foxy? Same! The [b]Miho Ears[/b] is perfect for adding a pop of cuteness to any look! Check it out tomorrow!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/gVf9VHy.jpg[/img]

Don’t just stand there! Strike a pose and an awesome one at that! These new [b]Swordsman Pose[/b] and [b]Devious Fox Pose Custom Motions[/b] will give new life to your characters!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/3yGdJPq.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/BZrQY3V.gif[/img]

That’s all for now folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Get Ready for Another Round of Extreme 2nd Path Prepping!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/VQYL4E9.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! Guess what? 3rd Job 2nd Path is coming very, very soon and so we have another round of extreme prepping just for you! It’s time to hype yourself up and get ready! Before that though, let us remind you that you only have until next week to complete your attendance checks. Don’t miss out on another day so you can get more rewards by accumulating login days and logging on the last Saturday of this event! And as always, we’ve got an awesome new costume suit coming at the Item Mall. Don’t forget to check these out and more tomorrow!

[h1][b]3rd Job – 2nd Path Pre-Event[/b][/h1]
It’s time to once again level up like there’s no tomorrow! Items, boosts, and extra special events line up an exciting pre-event so you better not miss it!
[list][*]First up, the character you selected to participate in the event automatically gets half of the EXP required to level up at no cost! You only have to do half the job of leveling that character up!
[*]Characters who achieve [b]Lvl 70[/b] during the event will get the [b]Book of Transcendence: God’s Will[/b] to bypass quests and requirements so you can Transcend in no time!
[*]When you reach level 90, you’ll get a [b]Unique-Grade Heroic Weapon[/b] to deal an even mightier blow! Who can resist such rewards?! Not me, that’s for sure!
[*]And there’s so much more that you’ll definitely need to check out the site tomorrow for all the juicy details![/list]
[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]

Whether you want to look adorable while keeping warm or you want to have a tactical advantage on your enemies from the freezing cold, this [b]Padded Hedgehog Coat Costume Suit[/b] has got your back! Fight for warmth tomorrow!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/tYqb5Q0.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Raise Your Hands if You’re Here! We’re Taking Attendance at the Start of the Year!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/O3x7ZXv.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! How are you all starting your year? Got any gaming resolutions you want to accomplish? We can help with that! The start of the year brings so many new things and we want you to be present at all of them so we’re taking a daily attendance starting tomorrow! But of course, we’ll shower you with TONS of free stuff that will help you out through your journey to become strong! How exciting! And as always, there’s a cool new item at the Item Mall you can check out tomorrow!

[h1][b]Mystery Attendance Event[/b][/h1]
Don’t miss out on this extremely simple event that rewards you with something special every day!
[list][*]Log-in for an accumulated time of 20 minutes using whichever character. Open up the Attendance UI and click on the day to get your random reward! 
[*]You get a fixed reward every Saturday! 
[*]There are also special rewards when you’ve logged in for 3, 7, and 14 days![/list]

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
Cure the disease of a bad fashion day with the [b]Elrios Medical Team Costumes[/b] for the El Search Party! You’ll always be ready for action with this wonderful set! Get them tomorrow!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Y5YqUl5.jpg[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/jUGa5u4.jpg[/img] 

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Start the New Year Right with Maximum Power and a New Pet!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZoF7jGD.jpg[/img]

Happy New Year adventurers! Did you have a fantastic time during the holidays? Did you party in-game and IRL with friends? We’re very certain that you did! Did you also manage to catch all the surprise giveaways and sales too? We hope you did because it was such an awesome surprise and the sales were such steals as well! This week, most of the events are still on-going so keep up the energy until you reach 3rd Job! And we have something new and adorable for you at the Item Mall so you can start your year strong! Don’t forget to check it out tomorrow!

[h1][b]Item Mall[/b][/h1]
Complete your White Dragon: Servius get-up and show off the mighty creature as a humanoid in pet form! Start exploring the vast lands of Elrios with your new [b]Servion[/b] companion tomorrow!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/I65e029.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in game!

notes.title: Celebrate Your Christmas with Elsword and Have a Wintery Merry Blast ALL Week!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/jv8bkRO.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! How were your holiday celebrations? We hope you’re having fun with our events and the 3rd Jobs as much as we are! There’s so much happening this time of year and it gets us really excited, but there’s more coming in this week. From Christmas Eve and entering into the New Year, we have got covered and you’ll never get bored this winter! Don’t forget to login every day because you’ll never know when awesome rewards or boosts are going to suddenly popup! And of course, don’t forget to check out the wonderful Item Mall for limited time holiday sales!

[h1][b]New Year’s Event[/b][/h1]
We want you to start the new year with a bang so we’re preparing awesome things for you! On January 1st, 2018, this fantastic one-day event will be the perfect way to start your year strong!
[list][*][b]DOUBLE EXP & DOUBLE DROP RATES[/b] for the whole day! Time to reach that 3rd Job status, fam!
[*]Get [b]1 [Cobo] Stamina Potion[/b] when you login for 1 minute! Run dungeons to your heart’s content!
[*]Clear Special Dungeon quests for extra special additional rewards!
[*]And lastly, clearing any dungeon within your level range will give you [b]2 [Cobo] Sage’s Magic Stone![/b][/list]

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
Don’t forget to check the Item Mall for extra special package deals and steals! You just might complete your White Dragon: Servius Ice Burner Set in no time!

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in game!

notes.title: Elsword Launches Biggest Update of the Year, 3rd Job 1st Path Update
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/i6tdO2w.jpg[/img]

[i]KOG Games Begins the First of Three Large Updates[/i]

The highly anticipated [b]3rd Job First Path Update[/b] is here! This is the first of 3 updates that will feature 37 new Job classes in total; each update will usher in a new Job for every character for each Line.

In addition, the following features are debuting today:

[list][*]One new dungeon: Forgotten Elrian Sanctum
[*]First and second Job Advance items are free
[*]Visual Update – Every Character (except Rose and Ain) have had their feet and hands resized for aesthetic improvement
[*]In-game Prizes, Playtime Sweepstakes, Snowball Games, 2X’s EXP in PvP Arena and More![/list]

To learn more about Elsword please visit www.elsword.com and keep watching the official Facebook page [url=https://www.facebook.com/Elsword/]here[/url]. 

Play Your Manga!

notes.title: This Christmas, We’re Giving Everyone the Gift of Ultimate Power, Fun Mini-Games, and More!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/HKBTt3p.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! Christmas is just around the corner (we’re very excited!) and so we’ve guaranteed to make your Holidays extra special by bringing out the big guns! Are you as hyped up for 3rd jobs as we are? Because we totally are! A plethora of awesome rewards await you and a new skill system will unlock so you can tinker with it! But that’s not the only thing you can look forward to because we have tons of other amazing events perfect for the Holidays! Like the PVP Pre-Season Events, Christmas Events and so much more! Don’t forget to invite back friends who used to play Elsword or friends you want to introduce Elsword to because we have something extra special for them! And of course, holidays in Elsword would be incomplete without something new and awesome at the Item Mall! Don’t forget to check these out and more tomorrow!

[h1][b]3rd Job Events[/b][/h1]
The biggest and most awaited update in the history of updates is here! Elsword and the Gang break limits to unlock 3rd jobs and with it come fantastic rewards through quest completions or even just by logging in for 10 minutes!
[list][*]Only need a few more levels to get to 3rd jobs? We got you, fam! Login for 10 minutes (per account) and you’ll get not 1, not 3, not even 5, but [b]10 Philosopher’s Scroll![/b] 
[*]If you want a permanent accessory, this event has got the thing for you! Just complete the chain quest and you’ll get a [b]Topiary of Faith![/b]
[*]After reaching 3rd Jobs, head right on to the dungeons to test out your newly unlocked powers! You’ll even get rewarded for it![/list]

[h1][b]Christmas Events[/b][/h1] 
[b][u][i]Throw the Dice: Elriopoly![/i][/u][/b]
Go around the board and get rare rewards after your Item Mall shopping spree! Every 100 K-Ching spent will give you 1 Dice Roll that automatically goes to your Elriopoly UI! 
[b][u][i]Phoru Snowball Game! [/i][/u][/b]
A winter mini-game that guarantees TONS of fun as you try to accumulate points for certain rewards! Hit multiple targets at once for massive points! 

[h1][b]PVP Pre-Season Event[/b][/h1]
We’re making your PVP more fun before the new season starts with these awesome events!
[list][*]Get [b]2X EXP and AP[/b] when you win Arena matches!
[*]Encounter more Epic NPCs!
[*]Get a book that contains TONS of titles when you login for 10 minutes![/list]

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
Dress up for the festivities in a luxurious ensemble that’s posh and fun at the same time! Get the [b]Christmas Velvet Suits and Dresses[/b] tomorrow!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/3hhYysZ.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all

notes.title: We’re Preparing You for Our Biggest and Best Update Yet! 3rd Jobs Are Coming Very Soon!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/KXaGd9Q.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! We’re feeling immense powers looming over the not-so-distant lands and soon it will be yours! You just have to be patient, because great things are worth the wait, after all. However, since we’re so hyped up about it, here’s an overview of what will happen: Your characters will get the most awesome transformation you can imagine complete with the best skills you have ever laid eyes upon! For that to happen, we have to get you all prepped up that’s there will be tons of events and loads of rewards to boost you to 99 in no time! On top of that, we’re bringing you another much the anticipated update of trade improvements and ED limits! You can finally become the savvy business person you’ve always wanted to be in Elrios! And as always, the Item Mall has some wonderful new stuff for you to check out! Don’t miss these updates and more tomorrow!

[h1][b]3rd Job Pre-Event[/b][/h1]
Now’s your chance to level up like a madman! We’ve got special events and boosts to make sure you reach level 99 before 3rd jobs roll in!
[list][*]First up, your selected character to participate in the event automatically gets half of the EXP required to level up at no cost! All you have to do is half the job of leveling that character up! 
[*]Characters who achieve [b]Transcendence[/b] during the event will get [b]Book of Transcendence[/b] to bypass quests and requirements! So convenient!
[*]When you reach level 90, you’ll get a [b]Unique-Grade Heroic Weapon[/b] to deal an even mightier blow! Who can resist rewards?! No one!
[*]And there’s so much more that you’ll definitely need to check out the site tomorrow for all the nitty-gritties![/list]

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
It’s the most wonderful time for Ain! He’s getting two more epic Ice Burner sets to add to his wardrobe with the scholarly [b]Miracle Alchemist Ice Burner Set[/b] and the firey [b]Ignition Caligo Set[/b]. Collect them all tomorrow!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/UZz5jRC.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Chill at Elsword With a New Timeless Accessory Set After All That Thanksgiving Festivities!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/0KZCNL7.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! How was your Thanksgiving week? We hope you were stuffed to the brim with all that wonderful Thanksgiving goodies! Did you get a nice big haul during our Black Weekend Sales? It was super awesome and everything was a such a steal and I’m sure you guys loved it as much as we did! So, for now, it’s time to take things down a notch and chill (just for this week though!). But just because we’re chilling doesn’t mean we ain’t gonna do something. Watch out for a GM Livestream coming to you this Friday but stay tuned for more details! And as usual, there’s an awesome thing at Item Mall you might want to take look at!

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
If you’re looking for a timeless accessory that transcends not only time but also space, then look no further than Henir’s new accessory set! Add these to your normal everyday outfits for that timeless appeal!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/6WsUAJY.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in game!

notes.title: Out of the Screens and Into the Game, We Have Something Special for Everyone!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/6WRG33x.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! How are you all doing? So, you know when Halloween ends the fun Halloween Dungeon will disappear soon, right? Wrong! We saw how much fun you’ve been having at the Hide and Seek Halloween Dungeon so we’re making it a permanent addition to our special dungeon lineups. How awesome is that? Now you can play graveyard hide-and-seek whenever you want! We also have another Balance Patch to bring some balance into your gaming life! It also comes with a very simple event so you get rewards for testing out the balanced skills! There will also be other game related updates and improvements coming in tomorrow! And as always, we have exciting new stuff at the Item Mall coming in tomorrow so stay tuned!

[h1][b]Elsword Anime Recap[/b][/h1]
Wasn’t that last Elsword episode uber exciting? At last the El Search Party has reached Lanox but Edel was much too busy with Town matters to help look for the priestesses. What would become of our red-haired knight and will Elsword and the gang be able to find the priestesses? You’ll have to watch to find out, it’s too exciting! [url=https://elsword.koggames.com/elsword-animation/]Watch Episode 4 here![/url]

[h1][b]Balance Patch Event[/b][/h1]
Test out the newly balanced Pvp and Dungeon skills and get rewarded for it!
[list][*]Get [b]1 Balance Patch Experience Certificate[/b] when you [b]Play 2 Matches in Arena[/b] or [b]Clear 3 Dungeons Within Your Level Range![/b] Do both Daily to get 1 Certificate for each completed task!
[*]Get a [b]Skill Tree Page Expansion[/b] when you collect all [b]14 Balance Patch Experience Certificates![/b]
[*]You can also exchange [b]1 Balance Patch Experience Certificate[/b] through Ariel for any of the following items: [b]10 [Cobo] Complete Recovery Potion, 2 [Cobo] Various Magic Stone Random Cube,[/b] or [b]1 [Cobo] Special Dungeon Entrance Ticket Selective Cube![/b][/list]

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
Play your Anime and experience Elrios in a whole new light! Relive the anime accurately with a costume and sit motion package that’s straight out of the anime ending credits! Get ‘em tomorrow!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/0ldUEsZ.jpg[/img]

And a new stage backdrop has opened at Elrios Studios! Become the idol you were always meant to be! Get a Cobo Entertainment Studio at the Item Mall to unlock the [b]Idol Studio[/b] backdrop tomorrow!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/oCEOHfM.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: If You Can’t Reach for the Stars, Become One as You Take Your Breaks!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/xmPa5N5.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! How was the Halloween event? Did you have fun playing hide and seek at the cemetery? Have you gotten that adorably ghastly reward yet? If not, you still have time to hustle so you don’t miss it! For those not in the know, our lovely Forum Moderators are having another sticker creation contest fit for the holidays and it already started! If you’ve got that creative festive spirit in you, show us what you got and post it on the forum. Winning stickers will become part of Elsword’s forum community and get K-Ching!  And as always, we have lovely items for you at the Item Mall tomorrow so don’t forget to check it out!

[h1][b]Happy Sticker Days![/b][/h1]
Here’s to another round of sticker love for the Holidays! Get those juices flowing and create your best Holiday-themed sticker (Christmas, New Year, Hanukkah) and your creations will have a chance to be part of the forums forever and of course, you’ll get TONS of K-Ching as well! 
[list][*]Check out the rules here [url=https://forum.elsword.koggames.com/forum/news-and-announcements/contests/122576-happy-sticker-days][link][/url] and reserve your spot now![/list]

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
Become the greatest idol Elrios has ever seen! Take to the stage and show ‘em what you got when you’re not destroying hordes of enemies! Get on stage with [b]Elrios Beat[/b] tomorrow!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/i5wWwsn.jpg[/img]

Here comes more fashion choices for Ain! Expand his wardrobe with two new epic sets! The [b]Millennium Fox Ice Burner[/b] and [b]Salvatore Denif[/b] Ice Burners are both coming tomorrow!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/PEWgnxH.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in game!

notes.title: Get Ready for a Fantastic Hallow’s Eve Week with the El Gang!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/OjZUFzD.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! We’ve got a fun week ahead of us starting tomorrow~ But first, a few reminders: We’ve got two Halloween forum events whose deadlines are coming up soon! But don’t worry, you still have a few more days left to submit your awesome pumpkin art and Halloween El-Doodles! And don’t forget to keep exorcising those monsters at the cemetery for awesome rewards! Remember, there’s only a few more days left to get the [b]Candy Devil Pet[/b] using [b]Ghost’s Traces[/b] after that – poof (the Ghost’s Trace, we mean, not the pet)! We also have a new Facebook Event so don’t forget to check those awesome activities out because it’s totally awesome! And as always, we have new stuff at the Item Mall perfect for Halloween, so don’t forget to take a peek!

[h1][b]Facebook Event[/b][/h1]
[b]Trick or Treat![/b]
Excited for Halloween? We are too! Spread the spirit of Halloween by shouting “Trick or Treat!” and taking a screenshot of it! [url=https://www.facebook.com/Elsword/]Post to Facebook[/url] and you just might get an awesome treat on Halloween! Event page opens up tomorrow, but you can get a head start and take your screenshot today.

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
Invoke the spirits in a rest motion that conjures the adorable creatures of the night by your side! Let the [b]Jack-o-Lantern of Light[/b] show you how!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/L28v0vl.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now folks~

See y’all in game!

notes.title: Monsters Come Out of Hiding as Halloween Draws Near! Hang Out at the Cemetery and Party with its Dwellers!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/f3IiMpD.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! You only have a few days left to complete the rewards for the Heartbeat Attendance event! If you missed a few days here and there, we hope you at least still have the chance to get the accumulative log-in rewards, but make sure you don’t miss the remaining days! This week, we’re going to do what every adventure loving chaps like to do; hang out at the cemetery! But we swear it’s going to be extremely fun so don’t forget to check it out! And we have a lovely Halloween set coming to you when you make your way to the Item Mall, so watch out for it!

[h1][b]Elsword’s Spooky Graveyard Adventures![/b][/h1]
A vengeful spirit is wreaking havoc and possessing monsters at the cemetery causing them to move differently and maybe say different things. Find out which monster is possessed and get awesome rewards!
[list][*]For 10 minutes of accumulative log-in time, get [b]3 Rusty Cemetery Keys[/b] every day from Monday to Friday, [b]5 Rusty Cemetery Keys[/b] on the weekends (Saturday and Sunday), and 5 more on October 31st! You’ll be spending your days at the cemetery for the rest of October, that’s for sure!
[*]We’ll also reward you with awesome treats for clearing the cemetery of its vengeful spirit! Clear it [b]once and you’ll get [b]30 [Cobo] Pumpkin Flavored Candy[/b], clear it [b]twice[/b] for [b]30 [Cobo] Every Flavor Candy[/b], and clear it [b]3 times[/b] for [b]30 [Cobo] Brightly Shinning Witch’s Amber![/b]
[*]You’ll also get [b]Ghost’s Trace[/b] which you can collect and exchange for awesome things from Ariel![/list]

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
You don’t have to look far for the best treat this Halloween because you’re it! This devilishly sweet design is enough to destroy your enemies with its sugar content alone (or so we hope!). Check out the [b]Candy Devil Costume[/b] when it comes out!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bv5DnHb.jpg[/img]

If the costumes aren’t sweet enough for you (or the enemy) this little [b]Candy Devil Pet[/b] will definitely make sure to knock out some teeth! Get your sweet new companion soon!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/GyNuJsf.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: We’ve Got Awesome Items for You Everyday and All You Have to do is Login!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/2PE7y67.jpg[/img]

Heya Adventurers! Get ready to fill your sacks with our daily giveaway coming this week! The best part of this giveaway is you only have to check your attendance after 20 mins of log-in! You heard that right, it’s a fuss-free attendance check event with awesome rewards and who can say no to that?! Not me, that’s fo sho! Plus, we’ve got something cool coming at the Item Mall so stay tuned to find out! 

[h1][b]Attendance Event[/b][/h1]
Don’t forget to announce your awesome presence via attendance check because you wouldn’t want to miss even just a day because of the rewards we have in-store!
[list][*]Log-in to the game for an accumulative time of 20 minutes using the character you want to receive the reward. Simply wait for the exclamation mark to appear on the event icon located on top of your screen, click to open the UI and check the date of your attendance to receive a random reward listed at the rewards list!
[*]We also have extra special rewards to those who manage to log-in for 3, 9, and 15 accumulative days! Hnnnggg! Rewards![/list]

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
When evil becomes a fashion statement, you wouldn’t want to be an on-looker because the [b]Evil Tracer 3[/b] Ice Burner set brings something epic to the streets of Elrios! Complete the set!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WY5DB6l.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now folks!

See y’all in game!

notes.title: Go the Distance and Fly High with a Majestic Mount That’s Fit for a True Warrior!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/x3F0KqW.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! I hope you’re all loving our Harmony Festival events because I sure am (keep those FREE pies coming)! I don’t know about you guys, but just the thought of those epic rewards make me want to spring into action and do them all. Plus, those beautifully crafted Harmony Festival costumes are the bomb! Don’t forget that you can still join in on our wonderful Harmony Festival celebration so you too can reap those epic rewards, if you haven’t yet. For this week, we’ve got tons of exciting forum activities for you! Y’all seem to love those so we’ve got more fun forum stuff coming! And, don’t forget to check out the Item Mall because we’ve got an awesome mount waiting for you tomorrow! 

[h1][b]Facebook Events[/b][/h1]
[b]Busty and Moshup Poetry Slam Session[/b]
Show off your poetic genius by creating mad rhymes! All you have to do is create a birthday poem for GM Moshup or GM Busty and the player with the best poem wins K-Ching!

[b]The Perfect Harmony Festival Pie[/b]
If you could create a Harmony Festival Pie, what would it look like? If you have a vision about an Elsword-themed Harmony Festival pies then we want to see it too! Send in your most creative Harmony Festival pie featuring your favorite character and you just might win TONS of K-Ching! 

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
This majestic mount is ready to take on your enemies and bring you to your favorite relaxation spot as well! Watch out for the fierce [b]Golden Falcon[/b] coming at you tomorrow!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/peuG4R6.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, folks!

See y’all in -game~

notes.title: Let Peace and Prosperity Reign Over the Magical Lands of Elrios in the Harmony Festival!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/XpIFwMO.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! We’ve got a fun week ahead of us with revamps and awesome events! First up, we have a Character Balance Revamp to make your battles efficient and fair. You can test out your new skills tomorrow! Our beloved Profession System gets a major revamp with new achievements, new items, and a whole lot of new functions! You just might want to log-in and try it out for yourselves! Then we’re finally launching the new Mentor-Pupil System. Forge lasting friendships with one another while passing down a more experienced player’s knowledge to a new player! How awesome is that?! No more confused and directionless playing (unless that’s your style) again, totes awesome!

And finally, Harmony Festival is back! That’s right, get ready for awesome events, boosts, buffs, costumes, and more! It’s going to be one fantastic festival for sure! And don’t forget to check out the Item Mall for to check out new stuff and things!

[h1][b]Harmony Festival[/b][/h1]
A period of momentary peace has come to Elrios and with it brings lots of goodies and fun! 
[list][*]Start hoarding [b]Harmony Festival Pies[/b] because you can get it for [b]FREE[/b] from Ariel!
[*]Chat up Ariel to unlock special titles and use them during the event!
[*]You also get to use a special skill and get additional Harmony Festival Buffs when you go dungeon running with the Heroes Assemble buff active!
[*]Get [b]Harmony Festival Costume Cubes[/b] when you login for 10 minutes once!  And get even more rewards when you log-in for 10 to 20 minutes daily!
[*]Collect [b]Harmony Festival Coins[/b] to exchange them with Ariel for useful consumables!
[*]There’s also a very special place in Elrios to celebrate the Harmony Festival. Want to find out where it is? You can check it out tomorrow![/list]

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
Make the ladies and gentlemen swoon when you sit down and play your tunes! Get the [b]Eternal Vows Serenade Sit Motion[/b] in black and white tomorrow!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/LdhdJyV.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now folks!

See y’all in game~

notes.title: Looking for a Way to Contribute to Our Elsword Forum Community? Become a Mod!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ceemHiO.jpg[/img]

Hiya adventurers! With the new forums running at full speed, we’re thinking we might need a little help from those of who are able and willing. That’s why for those not yet in the loop or if you just forgot, applications to become a full-pledged Forum Mod is open! If you or anyone you know has the qualifications, the heart, the humor, and the dedication to become a Mod, then you can submit your applications [url=https://forum.elsword.koggames.com/forum/news-and-announcements/moderator-applications-2017/39686-elsword-online-forum-moderator-application]here[/url]. If you think mod responsibilities aren’t for you, well, there’s no need to feel too bad because we have something for you to enjoy this week! What it is, we can’t say… yet! In other news, we also have the much-awaited wedding costume package at the Item Mall coming in tomorrow so stay tuned for this and more!

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]

If you’re planning to have the best wedding in all of Elrios, then your everyday outfit just won’t do! So, we’re bringing you a special outfit for your big day. The best part? You can wear this awesome wedding attire every day!  Get the [b]Eternal Wedding Package[/b] tomorrow!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/C3fTZJU.jpg[/img]

Not planning to wed but love those wedding accessories? We got you, fam! [b]Eternal Wedding Auras[/b] and [b]Eternal Wedding Wings[/b] are available to purchase separately tomorrow!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Im1P6vf.jpg[/img]

Well, that’s all for now, folks!

See y’all in game!
