notes.title: Transcend Erbluhen Emotion to Unlock New Powers And Get Ready For a Fun Valentine's Dungeon Race!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/SGx6vy9.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! Do you know what’s coming tomorrow? Yeah, we think you already know what’s up. But if you don’t know yet, Ain’s Erbluhen Emotion Transcendence comes out tomorrow! If that doesn’t get you to spazz like a maniac then get ready for our fun Valentine’s dungeon? You wanna know why it’s fun? Well, you’ll just have to go in and play to find out! And as always, we’ve got something special at the Item Mall for everyone so don’t forget to check out all these and more tomorrow!

[h1]Ain’s Erbluhen Emotion Transcendence[/h1]
Rewards await everyone, not just Ain! And all you have to do is log-in!
[list][*]All characters who log-in for 10 minutes (accumulated) will receive a [b]ymbol of Transcendence (All) (7 Days)![/b] You don’t have to be Ain to get one!
[*]And all Erbluhen Emotions who transcend will receive a special [b]ymbol of Transcendence (Ain)[/b] just for them![/list]

[h1]St. Valentine’s Dungeon Race[/h1]
A new fast-paced dungeon opens up just for the month of love! Collect Sweets and Roses for the ultimate Valentine’s Reward!
[list][*]The moment you log-in you immediately receive a [b]Summon Stone: Moby Chariot – Sweet Blossom (1 Day).[/b] This cute, pink mount will aid you in your Valentine’s Dungeon run in case you don’t have a mount!
[*]Logging-in for 10 minutes will also give you a [b]Race! Go! Title[/b] to boost your stats in fields and dungeons.
[*]Inside the Valentine’s Dungeon, you’ll get things like [b]Dimension Cookies, Dimension Flowers, Dimension Chocolates, Dimension Marshmallows, Dimension Candies, and Charming Crystals.[/b] Collect 100 of each Dimension items and 3 of the Charming Crystals and craft through Ariel to get a [b]Sweet Love Gift Set.[/b]
[*]If you’ve got extra Dimension materials, you can exchange them through Ariel for [b]Sweet Love Potions.[/b] These potions will recover 100% of your HP and MP![/list]

[h1]Item Mall Goodies[/h1] 
Become the embodiment of love and devotion with this cute one-piece costume suit for your characters. Don the [b]Eternal Love[/b] look tomorrow and start spreading the lurve~

[img]http://i.imgur.com/iqmd2Ea.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now folks!

See y’all in-game~

notes.title: Walk in Ain’s New Path! Lofty: Anpassen and Erbluhen Emotion is Here in Time for The Lunar New Year!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/nDMHxId.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! Guess what we have in store for you tomorrow? Ok, you don't need to guess, it's in the title. But aren't you excited for it? I am! Aside from Ain's 2nd Path, we also have the Lunar New Year's Celebration coming in early so get your fireworks ready! And a new map has become available in the Elrios Studio for your character photo shoots. Win/Lose motions are also now in the studio as well. Check out Solace's Family Garden and the new motions in the studio tomorrow! And last but certainly not the least, we have TONS of stuff coming out at the Item Mall tomorrow. We guarantee that you'll love all of it!

[h1]Ain 2nd Path Event[/h1]
Ain's second path has been revealed and tomorrow you can conquer the whole of Elrios with him! But wait, don't forget to join the event to get epic rewards!
[list][*]Players who have not received [b]Ain's Diorama[/b] during Ain's launch will have another chance to get it tomorrow! You can't be greedy, though. Players who already have Dioramas from Ain’s launch won't be able to see the timer event anymore. 
[*]You will get an [b]El Energy[/b] when you log-in for an accumulated time of 10 minutes. The El Energy can be used to craft a new special accessory!
[*]If you want to craft that special accessory, you only need to party up with an Erbluhen Emotion three times to get [b]God's Power[/b]. Yes, you can get God's Power. You don't even have to party up if you're an Erbluhen Emotion. You can just solo those dungeons, bruh!
[*]Annnnnd when you change from Ain's Base Job to Lofty: Anpassen or Erbluhen Emotion, you get a special equipment cube containing +7 items! Praise Ishmael! [/list]

[h1]Lunar New Year[/h1]
Enter the dragons, and fireworks, and lucky charms! Celebrate the Lunar New Year in Elrios with eggs and Ruchis!
[list] [*]Level up by one using the [b]Sage's Scroll[/b] you’ll get when you login for 60 minutes!
[*]Beat up those pesky [b]Golden Ruchis[/b] disrupting your dungeon runs and you can get a nifty [b]Lucky Pocket[/b] that either gives a stat boost or a helping hand in your run!
[*]Free [b]Golden Eggs[/b] that replenish 100% of your HP and MP over at Ariel's! Why? Because we can!
[*]Log-in for 30 minutes during the second week of the event and you'll get an adorable [b]Mini Ruchi[/b] accessory to accompany you in your travels! [/list]

[h1]Item Mall Goodies[/h1]
Travel the dead-cold terrains in style like the nomads of the olden days with the [b]Arctic Travel[/b] set. If you don’t like traversing ice terrains for fun, it’s also a suitable attire to get extra toasty during the winter. Get it tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/K9HK8sZ.jpg[/img]

You won't need to go to the universe because with the [b]Celestial Master Ice Burner[/b] set the universe is within you or on you… You are the universe! Complete this beautiful set when it comes out tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/xCXK6M5.jpg[/img]

Open your eyes, your eyes are open. Now it's Ain's and Rose's turn. Open their eyes and give them a new set of peepers. Choose from [b]Black Eyes for Rose and Ain[/b], or [b]Cat Eyes for Ain[/b]! Available tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/0YyQUP3.jpg[/img]

Are Rose and Ain catwalk ready or battle ready? They can be both! Get [b]Battle Poses[/b] and [b]Model Poses[/b] for Rose & Ain tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/brUH5OY.jpg[/img]

After all that posing, why don't you let Rose & Ain take a much-deserved rest. Let them have a seat on colorful and whimsical crescent moons with [b]Moonlight Dream[/b] tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/jsWEm4O.jpg[/img]

That's all for now folks!

See y'all in-game~

notes.title: A New Path Will Soon Unfold for the Divine Being but for Now, It’s Rocket Time!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/PWaNL3g.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers, what’s cookin’? We’ve got something special coming out next week, I’m sure you already have your ideas about what that might be but we’ll just keep mum until that day *wink wink*. Let’s get right to it, shall we? This week, we have the Rocket Attendance Event happening tomorrow. If its new, permanent costumes and usable items you want, then you better join this very straightforward event when it comes out. The rewards are ready for the taking tomorrow!  The Item Mall has new stuff coming out tomorrow, as well! Cool costumes, epic mounts, and – well just go crazy when these items arrive tomorrow.

[h1]Rocket Attendance Event[/h1]
If you want a new permanent costume that’s totally free and a number of usable items for your characters, let us take your hand and let’s get ready for lift off!
•	[list][*]Get [b]Rocket Coins[/b] from doing a series of events every day. If you can’t do it on your own, party up and see those sweet, golden coins flowing in!
•	[*]Once you have enough [b]Rocket Coins[/b] you can complete the Attendance Quest every day for a total 9 days! And what do you get for completing? A complete [b]Bad Guys Costume Set, Dual Magic Stones, Twisted Sage’s Magic Stones,[/b] and a [b]Phoru’s Pawprint Gift Set![/b] Remember, the costume parts are given at different days and require different amounts of Rocket Coins to get.
•	[*]If you have completed all the quests for this event and you still have some coins lying around, exchange them to Ariel for useful things![/list]

[h1]Item Mall Goodies[/h1]
Equip Ain with the best Nasod technology money can buy! With the [b]Nasod Battle Suit[/b] found in new Ain Ice Burners, this angel becomes battle ready! Collect the pieces tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Cd3XAPC.jpg[/img]

This new mount straight out of an ancient oriental lore will take you on the ride of your life! [b]Rakshasa[/b] becomes available for our heroes tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/ZMCiMYU.jpg[/img]

“I say, good sir, would you care for a duel?” “I certainly would! But not while wearing those rags my good man!” Duel in style in this one-piece costume suit with great hair and a mighty cape to boot! Dress your heroes in the [b]Noble Duelist[/b] attire and take some time to d-d-d-d-duel!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/rRaPoOJ.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now folks~
See y’all in game!

notes.title: Get Ready for Ain As He Transcends to His Most Divine Form Yet!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/PW5Xdb2.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! Having fun in the new Elysion dungeons? Have you unlocked the major story lines yet? If you haven’t, then keep at it. It’s really good! For this week’s update, we have Ain’s Arme Thaumaturgy’s Transcendence. Yes, it’s finally out! The group’s angel is slowly becoming God-like as the days go by. They all grow up so fast! Another new thing coming in this week, is the Bethtera dungeon for players level 35 to 70. It’s a combination of Bethma and Altera that’s guaranteed to keep your adrenaline pumping and will definitely help you level up faster. 

Does your character just want to relax and soothe their troubles away after a grueling day's work hacking and slashing enemies? Never fear, because we heard your plea! The Lanox and Ruben Hot Springs are back and this time for good! Both hot springs have added a bunch of useful and fun features to make your relaxation session worry free. Play rock-paper-scissors with the NPCs while you're at it! There’s also the Pet Feeding System Revamp and Security Pin Reward Revamp rolling out tomorrow. And as always, we have a never-ending supply of new items coming in at the Item Mall every week and tomorrow is no exception. More items for Ain but that doesn’t mean the others won’t get some love. Go check ‘em out tomorrow!

[h1]Ain 1st Transcendence Event[/h1]
Ain crosses the threshold and Transcends but the rewards aren’t for Ain alone. Everyone gets a reward too!
[list][*]A 10-minute log-in on any character will reward the player with a [b]Symbol of Transcendence (7 Days)[/b]. Now, they too can have a Transcendence accessory again!
[*]Ain characters who Transcend will be given an exclusive [b]Symbol of Transcendence[/b] for Ain! It’s permanent too so if you want it, you gotta make Ain Transcend, yo![/list]
[h1]Bethtera Dungeon Event[/h1]
When players level 35 to 70 log-in for 10 minutes, they will be given a [b]Bethtera Army Assembly Order[/b] that will allow them to enter the new Bethtera dungeon! You don’t even have to do anything while you wait for your pass! 

[h1]Item Mall Goodies[/h1]
Give Ain the ultimate welcome attire with his very own [b]El Search Party Officer[/b] uniform. Now he’ll truly belong with the El Gang! #squadgoals

[img]http://i.imgur.com/om1Pj4O.jpg[/img]

These epic overalls for Ain makes all the racecars’ engines purr. Dress him up in [b]Ain ELS-N1 Grandprix Engineer[/b] costume suit and start living the fast life tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/TRnpS9I.jpg[/img]

The eyes are considered windows to the soul but sometimes you gotta change it up because eyes can get boring. Give Ain the option to put a little oomph in his look with [b]Odd Eyes[/b] and [b]Star Eyes[/b]. We guarantee you won’t get tired of staring.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/milNZbJ.jpg[/img]

The El Gang can finally complete the ultimate whimsical winter wear with accessories you can wear all year. [b]Frost Pixie Accessories[/b] are coming out tomorrow to add the final touches to your Frost Pixie set!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/wsrHfdz.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, folks. Start Transcending Ain tomorrow!

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Finally Know the Truth About El When You Enter The Two New Dungeons!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/eUS7V4P.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! Happy New Year! How were your New Year celebrations? I hope you all saw a lot of awesome fireworks. Did you have fun during our New Year’s events and the rest of Ain’s events? We hope so coz I sure did!  We’re revealing something major at the start of the year in terms of the game storyline. It’s a bit heavy but at the same time very riveting. This will all be revealed tomorrow when Solace’s Fortress and the Halted Sun’s Memory Dungeons open. And as always, we have awesome stuff and things coming in tomorrow at the Item Mall. If you wanna upgrade your wardrobe like I did, you might want to take a gander at our newest selections~

[h1]Elysion Dungeon 6 & 7 Events[/h1]
With the new dungeons coming out tomorrow, you bet your sweet behind that there’ll be events and free stuff! 
[list][*]Accessorize like the newest Dungeon boss with fierce [b]Solace Boss Accessories[/b] when you log-in for 10 minutes or when you defeat Solace in Solace’s Fortress five times!
[*]Clearing the [b]Halted Sun’s Memory[/b] once, twice, and three times will give you an awesome accessory each time! So, keep on going until you complete ‘em all!
[*]Complete Ariel’s quests (Clear any Elysion dungeons 3 times, including Atlas region) 3 times and get a random Elysion title![/list]

[h1]Jackpot Ice Burners (Archpriest)[/h1]
You know what the best deal is? When you spend on something that’s really cheap but it gives double rewards or triple or even 100x! With the Jackpot Archpriest Ice Burners, you have a chance to get 100 Archpriest Ice Burners (Ain included) for the same price as a normal IB! Try your luck out tomorrow!

[h1]Item Mall Goodies[/h1]
Forgive thine enemies for they have wronged thee… Not on your watch! Our heroes are ruthless beings when it comes to the evil that plagues Elrios even while equipped with the [b]Dark Priest[/b] attire. No mercy for creatures of the dark. Get this awesome costume suit tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/1dwgkbx.jpg[/img]

Sit down, relax, and let the [b]Frozen Tree’s[/b] ice-cold branches chill your behinds. It’s the perfect sit motion to go with your Frost Pixie attire too! Compliment that look when it comes out tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Dnhd94E.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now folks!
See y’all in-game!

notes.title: New Year’s Just Around the Corner and Ain’s Journey Has Begun to Unfold!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/fAiS4B2.jpg[/img]

Hey adventurers! So how about that new guy Ain, huh? He’s a really cool addition to the El Search Party, don’t you think? Silver hair, alluring smile, and god-like powers, what more can you ask for? And that’s not even his final form yet!  This week we have a few events that I know some people are eagerly waiting for. We have an event that will make you stronger and better in preparation for the coming year and another one that’s made for some good ol’ laughs and you get free stuff coz we love giving away free stuff. We also have cool thangs and [url=http://elsword.koggames.com/ains-welcoming-ceremony-part-2/]events for Ain[/url] and a beautiful winter costume for all so don’t forget to check everything out tomorrow!

[h1]New Year’s Event[/h1]
If you’re the kind of person who wants to spend the New Year slaying giant birds that appear randomly in dungeons and you also happen to like collecting feathers, then we’ve got a thing for you!
[list][*]Get [b]Ruchi’s Feathers[/b] numbered from 0 to 9 when you slay Enormous Ruchis inside dungeons.
[*]Love [b]Fried Chicken[/b]? We do too! That’s why when you use (right-click) any of [b]Ruchi’s Feathers[/b] you’ll be given [b]5 Fried Chicken[/b] for your consumption! And who doesn’t love fried chicken?
[*]Collecting the right combination of Ruchi’s Feathers will complete a quest that gives your character a cute [b]Doki-Doki 2017[/b] hair accessory!
[*]And if you want to dress up as a Ruchi for some reason, then a 10-minute connection will give you a 7-Day Giant Ruchi costume. If you want this bird suit as a permanent addition to your collection, then an easy task of [b]slaying 50 Giant Ruchis[/b] is what you need to do.[/list]

[h1]Winter Enhancement Event[/h1]
Hit more and be able to take more (hits) with stronger, more reliant, and better equipment at the start of the year. How do you achieve this grueling feat? Worry not, coz we got your back!
[list][*]If you want a little something (and by little we mean a lot) to help you get started on enhancing, log-in for at least 10 to 30 minutes to receive a [b]Moonlight El’s Hammer, [Cobo] Blessed Fluorite Ore, [/b] and a [b] [Cobo] Blessed Restoration Scroll[/b].
[*]When you enhance your equipment during the event, your attempts will be rewarded! Enhancing up to 100 times will give you three useful rewards. The final reward for enhancing attempt number 100 is a lovely [b]Legendary Moon Rabbit (Sunglasses) Costume Suit. [/b]
[*]Reaching 30 mins of log-in time will also reward you with a [b]Moonlight Enhancement Equipment Cube[/b] which can help you get [b]Magic Amulets[/b] for your weapons and armors![/list]

[h1]Item Mall Goodies[/h1]
Does your Ain’s moral compass point true North or is he a bit of a devil? Dress your Ain up in [b]Archangel[/b] and [b]Archdevil[/b] pieces from Ice Burners tomorrow and he can both good and bad!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/nw6K8zG.jpg[/img]

Was that a cold breeze that entered or was it you? Bring the chill everywhere you go with a cute and whimsical costume like [b]Frost Pixie.[/b] You’ll never run out of chill with this on! Get it tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/VVCEthv.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now folks!
See y’all in-game~

notes.title: New Character Update: Ain
notes.content:
KOG Games today announces the launch of Elsword’s newest character, Ain.

For the first time in KOG history, a character is being launched within a week of his launch on the home server in Korea.
Basically, Ain is completely unknown and he’s shaking things up around the world!

Eons back, Ain was sent by the Goddess to descend upon Elrios and the Tree of El. War between the denizens of Elrios was in full swing; prompting the great explosion. This explosion tore through the veil of existence in its entirety, sending Ain reeling through time. Present Day: Standing before the El Search party, Ain introduces himself as a priest serving the Goddess, an angelic figure of uncertain power and an unknown motive. The strikingly attractive and enigmatic character with a purpose and presence that transcends time.

Ain is an unorthodox caster class. Once in-game, it’s apparent that he practices magic on a different level that Elsword players have ever experienced before. His weapon is a pendulum, and he enters the fray by summoning and projecting ethereal weapons from the God's Realm.
He doesn’t need to keep enemies at bay with his magic. Instead, Ain keeps his opponents right where he wants them, and that’s wherever he decides they need to be. Ain is all about controlling his opponent’s position by restricting their options.

Ain has an all new, special system which allows him to change his attack method with two completely different modes:

-          Cycle Mode allows Ain to access to his skills faster by lowering the cooldown and MP cost of all his skills. Additionally, it also endows Ain with the ability to repeatedly dash through the air, at lightning speed, and break out of enemy combos at half the cost.

-          Creation Mode enhances all of Ain’s combos and commands. This gives him the ability to deal immense damage by infusing his attacks with heavenly firepower.

To summarize, Cycle Mode is all about utility while Creation Mode is all about dishing out damage.

As well, Ain will be receiving his first Job Line; a first for an Elsword character launch. Players will not only be able to enjoy a new character, they get to fully experience and play through one of 3 paths to Ain’s end game.
 
A heavenly amount a great events and prizes will be hosted in-game and on Elsword’s official FB page and Forums. As well, the amazingly talented composer Maks_SF is lending his gift of music to Elsword as he brings the angelic Ain to life in this new video – Watch: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=so72Wa8yh8k

Come play Ain. Play Elsword. Play your Manga.

notes.title: Gather Around Because the Newest Member of the El Search Party, Ain, Has Arrived!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/d013oRq.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers, so how about that fun pre-creation event last week? Fun, right? I hope you all got to choose the perfect names for your angel because he’s finally here! Errr… tomorrow! You’ve seen him in action during our livestreams but you can finally test him out for yourselves! Are you excited? You should be because he offers a totally different experience than what we’ve seen from the rest of El Search Party so far, so you better look forward to that!

We’ve got a lot of events rolling out tomorrow to fill up your vacation days with Elsword fun! And these events wouldn’t be extra fun without the sweet rewards you can get after. And as always, the Item Mall is brimming with X-Mas goodies that you’ll want to get your hands on! They also have stuff for Ain so you can start dressing him up in the latest Elrios fashion! Watch out for those and more tomorrow!

[h1]Ain Launch Events[/h1]
Ain greets the players with a plethora of activities and rewards. You’ll be a very blessed player the moment you start a game with our new hero, so let’s get to it!
[list][*]Remember last week when you pre-created Ain? Not only do you have dibs on the name of your choice but you also get an awesome reward for Ain! You’ll receive the [b]Thank You for Creating Ain ♥[/b] cube which contains costumes, accessories, and very useful items.
[*]Players of Ain in different level brackets (10 and up, 40 and up, and 70 and up) will each get a unique accessory (dependent on level bracket) when they log-in for 10 minutes or more. Want to get ‘em all? Then start the grind to 70!
[*]And how would you get to level 70 in such a short time? Fret not weary player we’ve got a Fever event that automatically activates when you log-in! Don’t miss this opportunity to level up![/list]
[h1]Christmas Dungeon[/h1]
Take down those pesky Phorus who planned to steal your presents! This fun, new Christmas dungeon will be your new favorite dungeon this Christmas, or it might be one of those that could destroy friendships. Hmmm…either way, play to find out!

[h1]Winter Bingo! [/h1]
If you’re one of those people who becomes extra lucky during the Holiday Seasons, then this is a thing you don’t want to miss! Every 100 K-Ching you spend gives you a Bingo Coin! You can also get 1 coin every week on the weekend and the weekdays just by logging in for 10 minutes! You’ll have a chance to get rare costume pieces when you successfully complete it!

[h1]Ain Sweepstakes[/h1]
Want to win more stuff? You’ll be automatically entered at the sweepstakes just by playing as Ain for three hours! You’ll have a chance to win epic IRL stuff (US & Canada only) or K-Ching (for everyone) when you do! 

[h1]Item Mall Goodies[/h1]

What’s the best costume to put on Ain? A priest costume of course! And the new [b]Archpriest Ice Burner[/b] made specifically for this divine being is the perfect fit! Complete the pieces tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/arV2QNZ.jpg[/img]

Just hear those sleigh bells jingle~ on your neck~ Then match it with a classy Christmas attire and whimsical reindeer horns. The [b]Christmas Santa Costume[/b] is the perfect Holiday attire for our heroes!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/clairLs.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now folks~
See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Ain, the Envoy of The Goddess, Is Making His Way Towards Elrios. He’s Descending Soon!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/72vph0t.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! Remember that silver-haired guy? Who knew he was so important to the El Search Party that he became a member! Just goes to show that you too can become a member if you have silver-hair, are good-looking, and an angel sent by a Goddess! Believe in yourself, adventurer! We have all manners of Christmas-y stuff for you at the Item Mall to get you in a jollier mood, so don’t forget to check that out tomorrow!

[h1]Ain Pre-Creation Event[/h1]
He may not be all here yet, but you can reserve a name for your new angel to avoid becoming Ain12345 (unless that’s the name you really want, then I say go for it!) when he’s finally released! You even get rewarded for it! Totally awesome!
[list][*]If you want to make your hits extra special, to really feel that critical damage on your enemies, then we have new [b]Damage Skins[/b] that will do the trick! You can easily get these by logging-in. How simple is that?!
[*]You can also exchange the Damage Skins [b](Damage Custom A, Damage Critical A)[/b] you got from logging-in for a different set of Damage Skins [b](Damage Custom B, Damage Critical B)[/b]! Just go to Ariel and exchange them and if you decided you want your original ones, you can exchange them again!
[*]Create your Ain when the Character Select Screen prompts you to, and you’ll be given the [b]Thank You for Creating Ain ♥ Cube[/b] which contains permanent costumes and accessories for Ain (which you’ll get when he’s here)![/list]

[h1]Item Mall Goodies[/h1]

This little Christmas Fairy will bring you good cheer all year, but don’t underestimate her cute and smiley demeanor. She packs a mighty (probably) peppermint-flavored punch for when your enemies become thirsty! Adopt [b]Fairy Merheem[/b] tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/nsL4X8S.jpg[/img]

It’s truly a nightmare before Christmas when you visit your enemies wearing this ominous set and announce their impending doom. But remember, it’s not about the Christmas vibe, it’s about sending a message. Dress your heroes in [b]Fairy/Messenger of the Dark Clouds[/b] tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/eGozFCg.jpg[/img]

Our heroes Luciel and Rose are getting ready for school early! They’re gearing up to become top performers in their crisp, new [b]Star Academy Uniforms[/b].  Now that’s dedication! Don’t you let them fail, get it tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Bomzs2L.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now friends~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: We’re Spreading the Good Cheer All Around with Righteous Costumes and Righteous People
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/FDvnaP5.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! How are you all doing? Did you guys happen to notice that smiley silver-haired guy? Who in the world is he? I seriously have no idea. Probably a passerby. Anyway, we have a bunch of little updates coming in tomorrow! These will improve not only the aesthetics of your game but also your experience in playing them. Alongside the bite-sized updates are the fairly medium sized updates that balances and enhances your skills. You’ll notice these improvements when you log-in to play tomorrow! And since it’s almost Christmas, we’re slowly rolling out Christmas goodies in the Item Mall to spread some good ol’ holiday cheer! But we still have some non-holiday stuff if that ain’t yo thang!  Check it out when it comes out tomorrow!

[h1]Elrios Play Together![/h1]
We know our players are nice people who are always willing to lend a helping hand. With this new event, players needing help and players willing to help will get rewarded for working together! Unity!
[list][*]Players level 10 to 70 will automatically get titles that boosts their dungeon stats when they log in!
[*]Completing the conditions of the Play Together quests will reward players with Play Together! tickets which they can use to exchange for useful items through Ariel. 
[*]And once a week for two weeks and two weekends, you will be given Elrios Harmony tickets. You can use these, together with Play Together tickets, to craft either a [b]Magic Amulet Cube, Random Mount Cube, Random Pet Cube,[/b] or a [b]Twisted Sage’s Magic Stone Cube[/b]. 
[*]And don’t forget, when you log-in on the weekends (for two weekends), [b]Weekend Fever[/b] will activate for whole 3 hours! So, don’t miss it![/list]

[h1]Attribute Revamp[/h1]
The attribute system has been revamped to make for some smooth gaming. It’s best to check it out for yourself by logging in today!
[list][*]On the weekdays and the weekends for two weeks, you will get [b]100 El Shard (Mystery)[/b]. That was not a typo, you really get one hundred pieces of El Shard (Mystery) just by logging in for 4 minutes! Totally amazeballs![/list]

[h1]Item Mall Goodies[/h1]

Enemy sins will not be forgiven easily even when they bow down and repent in front of our heroes while wearing the magnificent [b]Archpriest[/b] set. Complete the pieces tomorrow from Ice Burners!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/2RuObzk.jpg[/img]

Christmas is around the corner and we’re getting you ready for it with the most joyous Yuletide blings and things we can think off! Complete your holly-jolly look with the [b]Snowglobe[/b] sit-motion and [b]X-Mas the Blessing of the Starry Night Fairy[/b] accessory. Get ‘em both tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/exZrMBd.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now folks~
See y’all in game!

notes.title: Have an Early Christmas Treat with Fabulous Christmas Attire!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/rjWhEeP.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! How are you all doing? How was your Thanksgiving? Did you get to hoard all the awesome things from our Black Friday Sale? If you missed our biggest sale for the year, well, there’s always next year so prepare for that!  Thanksgiving may be over but most of our events aren’t! Remember, when joining our Attendance Event, you’ll get rewards like costumes (like our very adorable [b]Elrios Chick Costume Suit[/b]), mounts, and pets for logging-in every day and doing the required tasks. Easy!  And for the dungeon runners, double dungeon rewards event is still on-going so you can collect your materials fairly quickly. Also, if you have not logged in to Elsword for a month or more, now’s your chance to do so! You can get costumes, pets, usable items, and awesome equipment for your character for returning to Elrios to help defeat the baddies! 

[url=https://www.twitch.tv/Elsword]Oh! And we have a GM Livestream you should totally watch out for on Friday![/url]

For the El Search Party, Christmas comes early in Elrios with a cute item from the Item Mall. Prepare to be dazzled and come check it out tomorrow!

[h1]Item Mall Goodies[/h1]

Start the holiday season early with a yuletide costume that looks totally jolly but incredibly deadly! [b]XMAS Fairy of the Holy Night[/b] will be your favorite Holiday costume this season! Watch out for this pretty thing tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/5R2DKVJ.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now folks~

See y’all in game and don’t forget to log-in to receive your rewards!

notes.title: It’s a Happy Thanksgiving with the El Search Party! Pass that Turkey Leg!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/d8SEPBv.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! Happy Thanksgiving in advance to everyone! What’s that? Do you smell that? That, my friends, is the smell of the El Search Party’s strength increasing daily. That or it’s Turkey and cranberry sauce. Mmm Turkey. Of course, after Thanksgiving a special day begins. Tons of accessories, tons of costume, tons of very useful items will rain down from the sky! The only way to catch them is by opening your wallets and throwing your currencies at it… if you can. And while it’s not that day yet, we still have a few amazing items coming in the Item Mall tomorrow. Some old, some new, but there’s definitely something for you. Hah! I rhymed! Check it out tomorrow!

[h1]Attendance Event[/h1]
This new attendance event will motivate the pants out of you to log-in everyday and do the quests. Why? Because of all the useful stuff you can get of course! All you have to do is log-in and do the quests! Easy-peasy!
[list][*]Returning adventurers, welcome back! If you haven’t logged in for more than a month then we’ve got something to help you get back on your feet! Just do 1 quest and you’ll get [b][Cobo] Returning Adventurers’ Support Cube![/b] It contains all kinds of goodies from potions to 30-Day pets and a lot more! 
[*]Present! Make your presence known for two whole weeks by doing dungeon quests and in return epic stuff will be rewarded to you! What are you waiting for, do it now! Oh wait, you’re waiting for tomorrow. 
[*]Dungeon runners, today… err… tomorrow is your day! Get double rewards from Heroic Dungeon and Secret Dungeon daily quests for the duration of the event
[*]To top it all off, there’s also a big Weekend Fever happening and it starts when you log-in and lasts for 3 hours! How’s that?![/list]

[h1]New Game Contents[/h1]
We’ve got skill updates and skill balances coming in tomorrow! Test your newly updated skills against enemies or each other! Most notable is [b]El Resonance[/b] where reaching Level 99 opens up a whole new set of passive skills! Interested? Find out tomorrow!

[h1]Item Mall Goodies[/h1]

In terms of looks, would you choose the one that portrays good or the one that portrays evil? Does it even matter? What if you look good in both? Back in Ice Burners are [b]Archangel[/b] and [b]Archdevil[/b]! Choose light or dark or better yet, choose both sets to complete! Watch out for these two tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/SsgFaaH.jpg[/img]

If you love the [b]Grace Fairy/Shadow Incubus[/b] set but didn’t get to complete (or get any at all) the set last time, now’s your chance to do it! Don the dainty look of the Fairies and throw in a touch of darkness for the Incubi. Get ‘em tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/sXiOGyc.jpg[/img]
Disguising as your opponents is part of the element of surprise. Give your enemies a heart attack when they find out it was you all along when [b]Evil Tracer 1 Ice Burner[/b] set returns tomorrow! 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/j01fGxA.jpg[/img]

[b]Nono[/b] is your new best friends that’s ready to take you to the biggest adventures of your life! Whether it’s doing simple errands, travelling to infinity and beyond, or wherever grand adventurers your wandering heart feels it must go to. Start journeying with this adorable Nasod mount tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/ZWl1veV.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now folks~

We hope you’ll have a wonderful Thanksgiving celebration and I’ll see y’all in game~

notes.title: The Royal Birthday Bash for the Queen of Nasods Continues!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/MlPtzPP.jpg[/img]
Hiya adventurers, are y’all enjoying the hot springs? Satisfied with the benefits of relaxing in such a nice and soothing place? We are! It’s such a fun and peaceful place to hang out alone or with friends, is it not? And the hot springs wear is not only very comfy but incredibly cute too! You can even wear it outside the hot springs if you want! Visit all you want, it’s for everyone! By now, you guys already know who our special Birthday girl is. We’ve already rolled out her events last week and the only things you guys need to do is join, join, join! Keep liking the posts, participate in the creation events and you just might win one of Eve’s special prizes! We also have new items at the Item Mall so don’t forget to check those out tomorrow!

[h1]Eve’s Birthday Celebration[/h1]
Hear ye, hear ye! Eve, The Nasod Queen, turns 5 and we’ve got a lot of events and prizes to giveaway during her birthday! Check out Eve’s Events and join them all!
[list][*][url=https://www.facebook.com/events/931179257026747/]Continue liking those Eve posters on our Facebook page.[/url] Remember, the number of likes on each image will have an equivalent amount of K-Ching which one lucky winner will receive! But fret not, there won’t be just one winner, others will also be chosen to receive a smaller prize! 
[*]What better way to greet someone on their special day than with a birthday card? But Eve won’t accept any premade birthday cards from your local shop, no! [url=https://www.facebook.com/events/160071267793904/]She wants you to create your own and showcase your design on our Facebook page so that thousands of players will have a chance to judge and admire your work![/url]
[*]For those more inclined to wordsmithing rather than designing, you won’t be disappointed. [url=https://www.facebook.com/events/218763848546016/]You’ll have a chance to visualize and write about how you think Nasods celebrate their birthdays.[/url] No one knows how, but this will surely get your creative juices flowing!
[*]If your expertise includes using physical materials to create things, then you’re in luck! Eve wants you to create a gift for her using tangible items. [url=https://elswordforum.koggames.com/showthread.php?273363-A-Gift-for-a-Queen-Craft-a-Unique-Gift-for-Eve]Create a gift for the queen then take a picture of it to show off your masterpiece![/url]
[*]Sauron agrees that there must only be one thing to rule all other things! He thinks the same should apply to Eves too. Do you think YOUR Eve is the one Eve to rule them all? [url=https://elswordforum.koggames.com/showthread.php?273373-One-Eve-to-Rule-Them-All-Eve-Pageant]Enter them in the forum pageant and find out during the livestream![/url][/list]

[h1]Item Mall Goodies[/h1]

If fixing up cars and being on the race tracks give you a mighty rush, then the [b]Grand Prix Engineer Costume Suit[/b] is for you! This all-in-one attire is quick to put on and take off, perfect for the fast-paced race car engineer in you! Get it tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/vdL3Fjk.jpg[/img]

Let the armor of ancient dragons fill you with might and aid you in your battles, oh brave warrior Rose! The power you seek is within grasp with [b]Dragon Knight Ice Burner[/b] set! Collect the pieces tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/8A5Stip.jpg[/img]

Accessorize your SWAT attire with the right embellishments and blow your opponents out of the battlefield! [b]SWAT Accessories[/b] are on their way tomorrow! 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/jPM9rF1.jpg[/img]

notes.title: The Royal Birthday Bash for the Queen of Nasods Continues!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/MlPtzPP.jpg[/img]
Hiya adventurers, are y’all enjoying the hot springs? Satisfied with the benefits of relaxing in such a nice and soothing place? We are! It’s such a fun and peaceful place to hang out alone or with friends, is it not? And the hot springs wear is not only very comfy but incredibly cute too! You can even wear it outside the hot springs if you want! Visit all you want, it’s for everyone! By now, you guys already know who our special Birthday girl is. We’ve already rolled out her events last week and the only things you guys need to do is join, join, join! Keep liking the posts, participate in the creation events and you just might win one of Eve’s special prizes! We also have new items at the Item Mall so don’t forget to check those out tomorrow!

[h1]Eve’s Birthday Celebration[/h1]
Hear ye, hear ye! Eve, The Nasod Queen, turns 5 and we’ve got a lot of events and prizes to giveaway during her birthday! Check out Eve’s Events and join them all!
[list][*][url=https://www.facebook.com/events/931179257026747/]Continue liking those Eve posters on our Facebook page.[/url] Remember, the number of likes on each image will have an equivalent amount of K-Ching which one lucky winner will receive! But fret not, there won’t be just one winner, others will also be chosen to receive a smaller prize! 
[*]What better way to greet someone on their special day than with a birthday card? But Eve won’t accept any premade birthday cards from your local shop, no! [url=https://www.facebook.com/events/160071267793904/]She wants you to create your own and showcase your design on our Facebook page so that thousands of players will have a chance to judge and admire your work![/url]
[*]For those more inclined to wordsmithing rather than designing, you won’t be disappointed. [url=https://www.facebook.com/events/218763848546016/]You’ll have a chance to visualize and write about how you think Nasods celebrate their birthdays.[/url] No one knows how, but this will surely get your creative juices flowing!
[*]If your expertise includes using physical materials to create things, then you’re in luck! Eve wants you to create a gift for her using tangible items. [url=https://elswordforum.koggames.com/showthread.php?273363-A-Gift-for-a-Queen-Craft-a-Unique-Gift-for-Eve]Create a gift for the queen then take a picture of it to show off your masterpiece![/url]
[*]Sauron agrees that there must only be one thing to rule all other things! He thinks the same should apply to Eves too. Do you think YOUR Eve is the one Eve to rule them all? [url=https://elswordforum.koggames.com/showthread.php?273373-One-Eve-to-Rule-Them-All-Eve-Pageant]Enter them in the forum pageant and find out during the livestream![/url][/list]

[h1]Item Mall Goodies[/h1]

If fixing up cars and being on the race tracks give you a mighty rush, then the [b]Grand Prix Engineer Costume Suit[/b] is for you! This all-in-one attire is quick to put on and take off, perfect for the fast-paced race car engineer in you! Get it tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/vdL3Fjk.jpg[/img]

Let the armor of ancient dragons fill you with might and aid you in your battles, oh brave warrior Rose! The power you seek is within grasp with [b]Dragon Knight Ice Burner[/b] set! Collect the pieces tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/8A5Stip.jpg[/img]

Accessorize your SWAT attire with the right embellishments and blow your opponents out of the battlefield! [b]SWAT Accessories[/b] are on their way tomorrow! 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/jPM9rF1.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now folks~

See y’all in-game~!

notes.title: Elysion Bosses Gather at Henir’s Time & Space But At Least You Can Relax at a Hot Spring First!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/m69Bb3p.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! Guess what! We have a special birthday celebration coming up. Can you guess whose birthday it is? If you already know, let’s have the others guess just for funsies. It’s happening soon so you’ll find out eventually! Are you stressed out from fighting monsters field after field and dungeon after dungeon? Why don’t you relax and unwind at the newly-opened Elrios Hot Springs? That’s right, Elrios now has hot springs located in both Ruben & Lanox. Visit and enjoy a relaxing soak in the Hot Springs tomorrow! 

For all our challenge-seeking, adrenaline-pumped players, prepare to be challenged once more. Henir’s Time & Space has been revamped and it includes your favorite Elysion bosses in the line-up. If you think they’re challenging now, well, it’s best to make sure you go in prepared tomorrow. We’ve also got three Ice Burner costumes coming back so you can finally complete if you haven’t already. Watch out for these and more tomorrow!

[h1]Henir’s Time and Space Revamp[/h1]
Woah there Billy, you just don’t go inside Henir’s Time & Space unprepared. Plus, it’s dangerous to go alone (unless you really want to), it’s best to take these cubes and get your rewards from them:
[list][*]It’s cubes, cubes, cubes tomorrow! When you log-in for 30 minutes, you’re given 5 [b]Chaotic Time and Space Cubes[/b]. You open these cubes and inside the cube is another cube. You’ll get 5 different types of Monster Cubes which you can open using a special key.
[*]The [b]Time & Space Key[/b] you’ll get from doing quests can be used to open to [b]Monster Cubes[/b].
[*]What are you going to do with all these cubes? Why exchange them of course! Exchange them for, you guessed it, another cube! The [b]Henir’s Time & Space Cube[/b] will yield 5 Chaotic Time and Space Cube and a [b]Time and Space Treasure Chest[/b] which contains helpful items for your journey into Time and Space. Whew![/list]

[h1]Elrios Hot Springs[/h1]
Relax, unwind, and let the hot, soothing waters of the Ruben and Lanox Hot Springs wash your troubles away!
[/list][*]Get [b]Hard-boiled Eggs[/b] as a quest reward for visiting either one of the new hot springs and receiving the buff! Perfect to snack on and boiled to perfection from the very waters you’re bathing in. Probably.
[*]Get the Hot Spring buff faster when you put on [b]Spa Wear[/b] while visiting the Hot Springs! It’ll cut your rejuvenation time in half, coz you know, heavy armors inside a hot spring isn’t all that nice of an experience. 
[*]You can buy the Spa Wear from Ariel for only 1,000,000 ED![/list]

[h1]Item Mall Goodies[/h1]
The official look of the El Search Party is back! Get a chance to once again complete the [b]El Search Party Officer Uniforms[/b] tomorrow! 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/jqffTlj.jpg[/img]
Nasod armors are one of the best creations in the land. Admired by members of the El Search Party not only for their aesthetics (I’m looking at you Rose) but for their efficiency in battle as well, we’re bringing the [b]Nasod Battle Suit[/b] back for a limited time so you can complete it! Start tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/uiiNDl7.jpg[/img]

Dress your heroes as imperial guards of Velder and wipe out the enemies that threaten to harm the city! [b]Velder Imperial Guard[/b] is back for a limited time only! Complete the set starting tomorrow before it disappears!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/1Wc0fcJ.jpg[/img]

There’s a special offer on these Ice Burner sets starting tomorrow. Buy the Ice Burner package of 5 and get 3 Ice Burners for free! All those K-Chings saved! Why, you could already purchase an accessory set from the amount you saved!  Remember there’s a purchase limit of 3 per day per account. 

That’s all for now folks~

See y’all in game!

notes.title: Get to Know The El Search Party and Watch Your Heroes’ Past Unfold Before Your Eyes!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/5rXsRjx.jpg[/img]

Hi adventurers! How was your Halloween? Are your teeth rotting from the sugar overload yet? Just kidding, please brush your teeth! We hope you had fun trick or treatin’, partying, or playing Elsword this Halloween! We’ve got a new update coming to you tomorrow. We’re adding the main characters’ stories and it mostly involves looking into their pasts. It’d be so interesting to know how our heroes came to be and what their motivations are, don’t you think? Watch out for some new Story Quest additions and dig deep inside their pasts when it comes out tomorrow! And as always cool, new items will come out at the Item Mall so watch out for it and maybe get your hand on ‘em too!  

[h1]Item Mall Goodies[/h1]

When there’s some violence in the neighborhood, who you gonna call? The El Search Party SWAT Team! That’s right, now you can become a part of the Elsword special ops in this new [b]SWAT Costume[/b]! Get it tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/OW1HWYl.jpg[/img]

SWAT doesn’t really join in field battles but in Elrios, they have their very own sit motion that creates a little sanctuary from the onslaught of perceived bullets! Sit back, relax, and let the enemies run wild while you take refuge in [b]SWAT Break Time Sit Motion[/b]. Coming tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/At4FSXC.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now folks~

See y’all in game!

notes.title: Transcendence Phase 3 is Here! And The Thrilling Halloween Celebration Continues at Elsword!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/5EZQpu8.jpg[/img]

Hiya adventurers! Halloween is only just a few days away! Why aren’t you excited yet? The dead will rise from their graves to mingle with the living, and who doesn’t find that exciting? The Halloween celebration continues in Elrios which means you can still beat up some dancing zombie horde, have a thriller night, and party till you drop dead with Dancing King Mike! Just be careful not to turn into one of them, or if that’s your thing then go for it! 

The final phase of Transcendence rolls out tomorrow! You’ll get to have your last set of skills and become the ultimate warrior! Don’t forget to check out the Item Mall because we’ve something lovely for Rose coming in. Watch out for it tomorrow! 

[h1]Transcendence Phase 3[/h1]
The last phase of Transcendence comes around with the last set of epic skills. Destroy your enemies and become the ultimate hero in this last phase of Transcendence! We’ll help you do it!
[list][*]Get [b]Transcendence Random Cubes[/b] when you log-in daily and hang out for a short while during Transcendence Phase 3. You’ll receive useful items every time you open one of these babies!
[*]You’ll also get [b]Job Change Tickets[/b] for 1st Job, 2nd Job, and Transcendence just by logging in! What are you waiting for?[/list]

[h1]Item Mall Goodies[/h1]
This new Ice Burner set for the Empyrean Gunner will conjure up the mighty powers of some benevolent nature spirits from the Orient. The [b]Diamond Yaksha[/b] is not only for aesthetics, it also boosts Rose’s power immensely! Complete the pieces of this mystical set from Rose Ice Burners tomorrow! 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/RvOqbk5.jpg[/img]

To change the color of the any of the pieces of Diamond Yaksha from Red to Blue, players would need to craft it through Ariel.

That’s all for now folks~

Enjoy your Halloween and see y’all in-game!

notes.title: Have a Killer Halloween with Dancing Zombies and Winning Costume Designs!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/CEHIINl.jpg[/img]

Hiya adventurers! Halloween comes early to Elrios but that’s because everyone’s just so excited to call on the living dead! No need to dust off your Ouija boards or hold a séance, we’ve got a special dungeon rife with dancing zombies where players can start bustin’ out dance moves and slayin’ zombies at the same time! 

Annnnd we have another big update coming out next week! What could that update be? Well, you’ll just have to find out but all we’re going to say is that we’re going to cap off something big, so stay tuned! We have a bunch of lovely Halloween stuff at the Item Mall coming out tomorrow that you will most definitely fall in love with! Most of what we have are designed by our talented players so take a look and marvel at each of their creative designs!

[h1]Spooky Zombie Night Dungeon Event[/h1]
It’s time to put your dancing shoes on and jam with the living dead to avoid being turned into a zombie! You’ll also reap awesome rewards! 
[List][*]A 10-minute connection gives you a [b]1 Day 2016 Halloween Contest Winner Costume[/b] for your character and a [b]30 Day Dancing King Mike’s Wig[/b]. A 10-minute connection on the weekend gives you a special [b]Magic Pumpkin Weapon Cube[/b] for Halloween!
[*]During the event, material items called [b]Halloween Zombie Disks[/b] will drop in the Halloween Dungeon or when you defeat normal dungeon bosses. You can exchange these for special Halloween accessory cubes that have a chance to yield permanent accessories.
[*]Or if you’ve got [b]Permanent Corrupted Accessory Exchange Tickets[/b] you can go to Ariel to craft your non-permanent accessories to permanent ones![/list]

[h1]Halloween Chain Sales Event[/h1]
If you want to get the full Halloween items (pets, costumes, and sit motions) for less, then this is your chance! For the first timers here’s how the Chain Sale works:
[list] [*]Go to the Item Mall Chain Rewards option or Luciel Chain Sale (if your character is Luciel). Choose any of the two available options to you and then buy!
[*]Once the first item has been bought, the second items in the chain will now be available for purchase. The same mechanics apply for succeeding purchases. 
[*]The first item can be purchased again once the last item in the chain has been bought. 
[*]Enjoy your new Halloween items that you bought for less than their original price. Then gloat to your friends! Such fun![/list]

[h1]Item Mall Goodies[/h1]

Marvel at the creativity of our players with these magnificent costume designs. Each character gets a unique costume that’s fit for Halloween or for any occasion! Peruse through the collection tomorrow and get one while you’re at it!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/0atsyxH.jpg[/img]

Our players’ creativity doesn’t stop with just costumes, no. 
Our featured pet for Halloween was thought of by one of the contest winners as well. A Rabbit and pumpkin! Whodathunk they’d go so well together? Check out the [b]Rabbit Pumpkin[/b] pets tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/zfUB5TG.jpg[/img]

The new [b]Fantasy[/b] and [b]Sticky Halloween Sit Motions[/b] will definitely sweeten the day of the dead when you relax after a grueling trick or treat session. Grab this sugary seat tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Xd1yRzB.jpg[/img]

Rose may look dainty and sweet in [b]Grace Fairy[/b] but she packs a mighty punch! You’ll never underestimate a gunner wearing fairy wings again. Complete this whimsical set from Rose Ice Burners tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/1ESP9CL.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now folks~

Hiya adventurers! Halloween comes early to Elrios but that’s because everyone’s just so excited to call on the living dead! Annnnd we have another big update coming out next week! What could that update be? Well, you’ll just have to find out but all we’re going to say is that we’re going to cap off something big, so stay tuned! We have a bunch of lovely Halloween stuff at the Item Mall coming out tomorrow that you will most definitely fall in love with! Most of what we have are designed by our talented players so take a look and marvel at each of their creative designs!

It’s time to put your dancing shoes on and jam with the living dead to avoid being turned into a zombie! You’ll also reap awesome rewards!

[h1]Halloween Chain Sales Event[/h1]
If you want to get the full Halloween items (pets, costumes, and sit motions) for less, then this is your chance! For the first timers here’s how the Chain Sale works:
[list] [*]Go to the Item Mall Chain Rewards option or Luciel Chain Sale (if your character is Luciel). Choose any of the two available options to you and then buy!
[*]Once the first item has been bought, the second items in the chain will now be available for purchase. The same mechanics apply for succeeding purchases. 
[*]The first item can be purchased again once the last item in the chain has been bought.

We hope to see y’all in game~

notes.title: Transcend to Phase 2 Because The Battle Has Just Begun
notes.content:
[IMG]http://i65.tinypic.com/315fw20.jpg[/IMG]

Heya adventurers~ We’re entering the second phase of Transcendence tomorrow and that means new skills are coming for you! How are you liking your new skills so far? They’re pretty cool, if you ask me! We also have another big update rolling out tomorrow and it’s one that will set everyone into beast mode every day! I’m not just talking about the PVP Revamp where you’ll find PVP has become more balanced, I’m also talking about the new PVP Mode, Tournament. That’s right, a Tournament Mode scheduled every day where you guys can just battle it out and become the top dog of your league. How awesome is that? So, are you excited for tomorrow yet? Well, you better be! Don’t forget to also check out the Item Mall tomorrow for awesome new stuff!

[h1]Transcendence Phase 2 Event[/h1]
Getting stronger doesn’t have to be so complicated and that’s the goal for tomorrow’s Phase 2 event. We just want you to get stronger and take all these stuff from our hands!
[list][*]Collect [b]Transcendence Resonance Coins[/b] which you can get when you complete a bunch of repeat quests. You can exchange them for exclusive accessories and other usable items![/list]

[h1]PVP Tournament Mode Event[/h1]
Why don’t you try the new PVP Tournament? It’s fun, it’s great, you can beat other players up and show ‘em who’s the strongest among you lot. What are you waiting for? Get your game faces on!
[list][*]In this Tournament event, we give you a [b][Cobo] Gold Tournament Trophy (1 Day)[/b] just by logging in. You haven’t even won anything yet, and we’re already giving you a trophy! 
[*]You’ll also get a special costume by logging in from the [b][Cobo] Dark Gladiator Tournament Supply Set[/b] to look extra intimidating when you step inside the arena!
[*]Do the quest that gives you [b][Cobo] Tournament Accessory Fragments[/b] so you can have a magnificent floating trophy forever![/list]

[h1]Item Mall Goodies[/h1]
Do you want to dance or run away? Well, why not both? With costumes inspired by award winning Kpop boyband, BTS, you’ll find it easy to do both at the same time! Take a gander at the [b]BTS ‘Run’ Costumes[/b] tomorrow!

[IMG]http://i64.tinypic.com/2ppws91.jpg[/IMG]

This greedy lord still lives in form and maybe in spirit if you get a little materialistic, but who wouldn’t? When you look as menacing as him when wearing his threads, you’d want one (or six) for yourself too! Don’t be scared, try on [b]Perkisas – Guise of Greed[/b] when it comes out tomorrow!

[IMG]http://i68.tinypic.com/6xw9kj.jpg[/IMG]

A little visit from our friend Death and he has already latched himself unto you. Be an ominous presence with Death behind your back and when every step you take creates a dark and foreboding aura. Don’t forget about those floating candles to light your way in the dark! Get the [b]Death Slayer Accessories[/b] tomorrow!

[IMG]http://i68.tinypic.com/2qulueq.jpg[/IMG]

That’s all for now folks~ 

See y’all in-game and in the arena!

notes.title: October’s Here and Halloween’s Creepin’ Around the Corner So Dress like a Pirate and Set Sail!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/smc9RSH.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! It’s finally October and you know what that means, Halloween is just around the corner! Get your Halloween costumes ready and let’s scare the pants off of people. Don’t forget to start hoarding all that pumpkin-y goodness for pumpkin pies and pumpkin spice! How are you all liking Transcendence Phase 1? It’s pretty awesome, huh? Well hold on to your shirts because we have 2 more phases of Transcendence coming in the following weeks. That means more chances to level up faster and gain those coveted Transcendence skeelz! We also have an awesome new set at the Item Mall you might want to take a gander at or better yet, buy!

[h1]Item Mall Goodies[/h1]

Ahoy thar, mateys~ Are you ready to sail the seven seas? Not without the proper attire you’re not! Get that pirate look with [b]Shark Hunter[/b] and leave the landlubber life behind! Dress up tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/hEFRTah.jpg[/img]

Captain Hook has an alligator following him around, but you’ve something less sinister but still very intimidating and it’s not going to eat you (we hope). Accessorize your heroes with [b]Shark Hunter Accessories[/b] like earring and a shark or an orca fin circling around you! Get ‘em tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/FzogrSn.jpg[/img]

After all that pillaging and sailing, you might want to sit down for a much deserved rest and relaxation. Take a seat on your [b]Shark Hunter’s Pile of Treasure![/b] It may not be very comfortable but it sure as hell is satisfying! 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/TcAmXjK.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, folks!

See y’all in game~

notes.title: It’s Go Time! Break Power Barriers and Surpass Limits with Transcendence Phase 1!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/D9JLhKb.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! Well, are you ready to know what the big thing that’s coming today is? Well? Are ya? Ok, two things: One is Transcendence. Push your heroes to their limits and they can gain new skills for that fun, hard-hitting action we know we can’t live without. The second thing is Hero Dungeon: Hell Mode! This new infernal dungeon mode guarantees your trip inside every dungeon makes you come out a changed player. Two big updates back to back to maximize and test out your newly gained Transcendence skills. No time to snooze and dilly-dally coz this ain’t no walk in the park! Don’t forget to check out the Item Mall for three items that made a comeback!

[h1]Transcendence Events[/h1]
You’ll be over 9000 when you’re done with Transcendence events. Plus, think of all the awesome rewards you’ll get for finishing the quests! 
[list]
[*]Choose your rewards by choosing which quests to do. Choose from the 3 types of quests like Transcendence of Growth, Advanced Transcendence, and Transcendence of Power.
[*]Everyone will have a chance to create a new character and have it jump levels. The highest level characters can do is 70 and you have to do a quest first otherwise you’re just creating a normal character.
[*]You can also get special Equipment Cubes for every phase you finish in the Transcendence Jumping quest. The best part? Those wonderful free equips level up with you!
[*]Also, characters level 10 and above who log-in for 10 minutes get a Symbol of Transcendence (7 Days). It’s pretty, it’s glow-y, and has some nice stats to boot![/list]

[h1]Heroic Dungeon: Hell Mode Events[/h1]
Gather all your friends and brave the open gates of hell. Which hell? Choose one! Are you ready to take on a more challenging Heroic Dungeon? Well, step in and find out!
[list]
[*]Players level 80 and above, and 90 and above will receive an equipment cube for an accumulative connection of 10 minutes. These cubes will contain +8 weapons! How great is that? Pretty spiffy, I’d say!
[*]Receive Equipment Tickets and trade them to Glave for a random but stronger equipment. Clearing quests on Normal Mode will give players [Cobo] Hero’s Equipment Exchange Ticket and clearing Hell Mode will give players [Cobo] Enhanced Hero’s Equipment Exchange Ticket to get even stronger equipment.[/list]

[h1]Item Mall Goodies[/h1]
Our Heroes are cleaning up Elrios a second time around with [b]Royal Maid[/b]. Order each other around and let your floaty friend tell you (with silence) what a great job you’re doing! Collect the set tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/OTYtVa4.jpg[/img]

From the wonderful lands of the orient where the sun rises, harness the sun’s power with [b]Salvatore Solace[/b]. Start collecting the sun’s rays—err—pieces tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/3DMgXVM.jpg[/img]

Fans of Aquaman will definitely love the return of [b]Salvatore Denif[/b]. With its aquatic motif you’ll be diving into the heart of the battle in no time! Hold your breaths until tomorrow, though!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/8hajaxF.jpg[/img]

And because we love you all so much we’re having a special sale at the Item Mall with these three lovely sets. Get 3 free Ice Burners when you buy 5! That’s 8 Ice Burners for the price of 5! How truly wonderful!

That’s all for now adventurers~

See y’all in game~

Also, characters level 10 and above who log-in for 10 minutes get a Symbol of Transcendence (7 Days). It’s pretty, it’s glow-y, and has some nice stats to boot!

Players level 80 and above, and 90 and above will receive an equipment cube for an accumulative connection of 10 minutes. These cubes will contain +8 weapons! How great is that? Pretty spiffy, I’d say!

Receive Equipment Tickets and trade them to Glave for a random but stronger equipment. Clearing quests on Normal Mode will give players [Cobo] Hero’s Equipment Exchange Ticket and clearing Hell Mode will give players [Cobo] Enhanced Hero’s Equipment Exchange Ticket to get even stronger equipment.

Our Heroes are cleaning up Elrios a second time around with [b]Royal Maid[/b]. Order each other around and let your floaty friend tell you (with silence) what a great job you’re doing! Collect the set tomorrow!
From the wonderful lands of the orient where the sun rises, harness the sun’s power with [b]Salvatore Solace[/b]. Start collecting the sun’s rays—err—pieces tomorrow!
Fans of Aquaman will definitely love the return of [b]Salvatore Denif[/b]. With its aquatic motif you’ll be diving into the heart of the battle in no time! Hold your breaths until tomorrow, though!
Get 3 free Ice Burners when you buy 5! That’s 8 Ice Burners for the price of 5! How truly wonderful!

notes.title: We’re All About Breaking Limits and Smashing Power Ceilings in Next Week’s Update!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/yLnptKx.jpg[/img]

Hiya adventurers! We’ve got another major update coming very soon, not tomorrow, but very soon (next week) and we’re thinking of pushing your heroes to their limits with this one. It’s not that hard. Seriously. Maybe? Oh don’t worry, we know you can overcome it and become the very best that no one ever was! The teaser event tomorrow will give you a sneak peek of sorts and we’re sure it’s going to be super easy for you guys. We also have a new field opening in Elysion called Judge’s Sanctuary so get ready to explore and fight harder enemies. We believe in your abilities, adventurers! And lastly, don’t forget to check out our amazing selection at the Item Mall because we know y’all want to ~

Special Game Update’s Teaser Event
We’ve got a few stuff going on as preparation for that special game update that’s guaranteed to push the limits of your heroes’ powers.
•	When you complete the condition of one quest to get a ticket, you can use that ticket to exchange for cool character summons with cool skeelz!
•	If you like puzzle pieces, then we have something similar when you collect the special game update’s fragments and then craft through Ariel to get a cool box with cool stuff inside!
•	You’ll also notice two new skill slots. Why? For the Special Game Update, of course! But you can’t use them yet. The anticipation is slow murder isn’t it?

Elrios Schoolwear Event
 Do you like school uniforms? If so, we’ve got an event just for you! You’ll get an abundance of school uniform pieces to mix and match, plus there’s a chance to turn them into permanent pieces!
•	Easily get Attendance Cubes which yields either one or more Elrios School Uniform Collection Cubes, Schoolwear Combiners and a Summon Stone: Maru (15 Days) when you log-in for 10 mins for the week’s attendance check!
•	The Attendance Stamp you get when you open Attendance Cubes can be exchanged with Ariel for helpful items. 
•	You can also get Elrios School Uniform Collection Cubes from dungeon monsters. Happy Hunting!

Item Mall Goodies

Take a seat on a hat big enough to fit not only your bunny but also three generations of bunnies in his family tree. With a flick of your wand, your bunny will start “performing” while you sit back and relax on your Great Magician’s Hat. You can finally complete your magician set tomorrow with this lovely sit motion!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/SyDlLAQ.jpg[/img]

Look like a total tough guy or gal when you cruise the lands of Elrios in this deadly-looking bike. There’s a reason why they call it Nightmare – Black Blood. Watch out for it tomorrow and get one or fifty!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/5edhKKr.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now ladies and gents~ Don’t forget to log-in tomorrow to check out the special pre-event!
See y’all in-game!

notes.title: AIN’T NO PARTY LIKE AN ELSWORD PARTY!
notes.content:
Irvine, Calif., April 29, 2015- KOG Games, a leading developer and publisher of popular free-to-play action MMORPGs, today announces a birthday bash like no other.  More than cake and candles, dungeons and Swag! Elsword pulls out all the stops for their 4th Anniversary Celebration!

KOG Games starts the party with a bang by inviting Elsword players to come down and party with them at Howie’s Game Shack in sunny Orange County, California. The folks at KOG Games have invited a handful of lucky players to partake in a pleasant stroll through some artfully executed bouts of Dungeon Crawling and PvP at Howie’s Game Shack. Then, strategy and villainy will be cordially (yeah right!) discussed over dinner, and then everyone’s off to offer up redemption and possibly even the score with some friendly *cough!*, Players vs. KOG, no-holds-barred games of lazer tag!     

Now on to the in-game festivities! ~ Elsword goes all out with some major updates on this 4 year anniversary patch. Players have asked, and they will receive. Here’s the list:
• A new Party Kick System that empowers the devoted Dungeon Crawlers with the ability to vote-out any player that isn’t pulling their weight and contributing to the cause
• Keeping competitive integrity at the forefront, a large number of characters are receiving some love and receiving some needed Rebalancing
• A new Star Rank system will allow players to shine. Both PvE and PvP efforts will be rewarded with a new title and badge. This system will reward the top 100 players in both categories
• Level up faster with the new EXP Table revamp
• Massive Dungeon Upgrades! – Shorter, refined Dungeons, better Dungeon graphics and backgrounds, new result screen UI, monsters that deal more damage occupy more area with their big-damage tells and better in-Dungeon stage progression on popular dungeons gives players a more linear and fun experience
• Ereda Island, the very popular, objective-based PvP Co-op feature gets a big facelift and new challenges await, and whole slew of dedicated in-game events and rewards to go with the update. In addition, the stellar Ereda Island character chat feature “Quick Voice” to call out character-based voice commands and text in combat! Quick Voice will not only be added to Ereda Island, but players will be able to use this new feature in Dungeons, Fields and in Arena PvP!

Don’t go anywhere, the party’s just started!  Players who login with a level 10+ character will receive a FREE, permanent pet, costume set and a timed Dragon Mount! 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/nyHunvfm.jpg[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/wryCvywm.jpg[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/dWn4I7Sm.jpg[/img]

If you’re new to Elsword or you’re taking a break … You’re invited too! New players who register during the event period and players who haven’t logged in since April 1st, 2015 will receive a free +10 Enhanced Weapon!  

During the event period, Elsword players will receive 2x’s EXP, 2x’s Drop rates and unlimited stamina! In addition, just logging into game and playing gets you prizes. Players will receive a daily buff, prize exchange tickets, and for those who slay big, nasty elite monsters, keep your eyes peeled for some crazy anniversary-themed loot boxes!       

And finally… The Swag! 
All players who create a new character, and level that character to 10 or higher during the event period (4/29/15 – 5/12/15 PDT) will be entered to win some amazing, exclusive Elsword-themed goodies. 519 players in total will win!
 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/ODZJgH5l.jpg[/img]

Cake and candles are optional for this celebration, but there ain’t no party like an Elsword party!
Come party with Elsword… Play Your Manga!

notes.title: Steam Only Exclusive DLC: Free from March 18 - 22
notes.content:
Celebrate the arrival of Time Tracer in Elsword Online with the Steam exclusive Time Tracer's DLC Package! Featuring the brand-new Time Tracer’s Hover Board, a special permanent accessory available only thru Steam. This pack also includes 1x Magic Necklace (15 days), 1x Summon Stone: Ice Hameling Mount (15 days), and 1x EXP Boost Medal 50% (3 days).

To redeem your DLC in-game simply go to the Item Mall in Elsword and proceed to the Enter Coupon button. Enter the code provided by the DLC you purchased.

Read up all about these awesome goodies:

• Time Tracer’s Hover Board - This totally rad accessory has Add the Time Tracer's crazed face on it. When equipped on your character, this goes to the Top Piece accessory slot.

• Magic Necklace (15 days) - Equip this accessory on your character to increase MP by 30% while attacking or being attacked. This item disappears after 15 days.

• Summon Stone: Ice Hameling Mount (15 days) - Right click on this item to acquire a mount, then press F to summon. The Ice Hameling is a nice little ice dragon that will carry you through the dungeons and fields, as well as lend you its impressive powers. This one disappears after 15 days.

• EXP Boost Medal 50% (3 days) - Keep this in your specific character’s inventory to gain 50% extra experience points in dungeons and level faster. It disappears after 3 days.

Valued at $20, this pack is a steal! Get Time Tracer's DLC Package today!

notes.title: Want Your Own Foxy Pet?
notes.content:
Hi-ya, Elpeeps! So, how about that nine-tailed pet? Revel in the ancient mystery this week in Millennium Fox’s Calling. In this Elsword Online in-game event, the Millennium Fox chooses to journey with you. Will you accept? It’s not that simple, though. If you prove yourself worthy, the pet will stay with you for good! 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Vtsc2i3l.jpg[/img]

Here’s a quick summary of steps to make this happen with Zero K-Ching:

1.	Get the Millennium Fox’s Hairpin. Play for 10 minutes to receive this pet summoning item. Right-click to equip the Millennium Fox as your pet for 15 days.
2.	Get the Weak Millennium Fox’s Soul. Play for 60 minutes to receive and keep this in your inventory for now.
3.	Complete the quest, Millennium Fox’s Soul. Acquire the item called Millennium Fox’s Soul by handing the Weak Millennium Fox's Soul and 70 Fragments of Millennium Fox's Soul (from clearing dungeons in your level range) to Ariel. And at the same time… 
4.	Bring your pet Millennium Fox’s Affinity up to 100%. Keep playing while this temporary pet is equipped until it reaches 100% special status. Be sure to feed it with Millennium Fox’s Orbs from Ariel!
5.	Apply the Millennium Fox’s Soul. Right click on this item while the Millennium Fox pet is equipped, and it’s yours to keep!

Think you can do it? Gather up your Elpeeps and make this a fun group quest! As an alternative, you can get the cash version of the Millennium Fox’s Soul for just 400 K-Ching. Afterward, once you’ve succeeded in making the event pet permanent, you might like to take it up a notch—get better stats, a roomier pet bag, and even an adorably sinister look with the Awakened Millennium Fox’s Soul for only 400 K-Ching!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/KWpr6VCl.jpg[/img]

Plus, don’t forget to check out the new Curious Fox costume suits!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/N0gWN8ql.jpg[/img]
 
Watch out for more details in Elsword after the patch this Wednesday!

tags.feature: Plus, don’t forget to check out the new Curious Fox costume suits!

Afterward, once you’ve succeeded in making the event pet permanent, you might like to take it up a notch—get better stats, a roomier pet bag, and even an adorably sinister look with the Awakened Millennium Fox’s Soul for only 400 K-Ching!

Plus, don’t forget to check out the new Curious Fox costume suits!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/N0gWN8ql.jpg[/img]
 
Watch out for more details in Elsword after the patch this Wednesday!

notes.title: New Character Elesis Arrives to Elsword!
notes.content:
Gotta love those female character releases! Elesis finally makes her crossover to Elsword Online as the noble Red Knight. For a long time Elesis of Grand Chase has always been speculated to be the sister of Elsword but now it is finally confirmed!! Oh you guys are good…

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/lANTVoGl.jpg[/IMG]

[b]The Story[/b]

After a long absence from training of her own, Elesis returns to Ruben Village bringing her teachings to her little bro Elsword. During a training session Elesis and Elsword come face to face with Scar, Captain of the Demon World, who has come for Elesis’ head. 

Being the fearless knight that she is, she stands her ground and defeats Scar with the help of Elsword. After the demons retreat, Elsword is left wounded.

While Elsword recovers at home, Elesis becomes anxious. Now realizing that the demons are becoming an even bigger threat, she decides to leave again in order to seek them out and protect her brother. While she does not know when, Elesis eagerly awaits the day she can reunite with her little brother.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/IsmHqVBl.jpg[/IMG]

[b]Playing as the Red Knight[/b]

Elesis wields the claymore and is the first female melee character of Elsword. In addition to mastering the sword she is fully equipped with fire attacks. You may see some similarities between Elsword and Elesis, but guess who he learned all his moves from?! His big sis of course!

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/MYfWM44l.jpg[/IMG]

[b]Chivalry System[/b]

Much like Elsword’s Way of the Sword, Elesis has the Chivalry System to maximize her skills. The gauge is filled depending on which type of skills you use. The Chivalry gauge is filled inversely. Using Gale skills consumes Gale points and pulls the gauge toward Annihilation, while using Annihilation skills consumes Annihilation points and moves the gauge toward Gale. 

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/879BSrzl.jpg[/IMG]

[b]Aura of Gales Stats[/b]

- Movement and jump speed increase. 

- A special effect takes place after every 5 hits, which increases awakening charge speed by 5% and MP by 25%. Effect duration lasts 5 seconds.

- Knockdown is reduced by as much as 40% for Gale combos.

- MP consumption of Gale skills is reduced.

- Gale skills cool-down time is reduced by as much as 75%.

[b]Spirit of Annihilation[/b]

- Annihilation skills and combos get 100% critical rate and disregard defensive moves. Knocked-down opponents suffer the skills’ full effects.

- Holding down Z or X allows Elesis to deflect enemies as they attack and go into mana break that consumes the Chivalry gauge instead of MP.

- Combo attack damage is amplified by 1.5x

[b]New at the Item Mall Tomorrow[/b]

With Elesis’s arrival comes with new gear! Two new Ice Burners hit the ItemMall for our Red Knight. Check out the Dragon Knight and El Officer Set for Elesis.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/cZPDWeUl.jpg[/IMG]

notes.title: Massive Skill Tree System Update Incoming!
notes.content:
We’ve got a great game update coming in tomorrow for you to explore and enjoy. Here’s the lowdown on this extensive skill tree system update!

[b]Brand-new Skills for All Characters[/b]
You will have the chance to learn additional skills with awesome effects and graphics. I can only show you some of them right now, but there will be multiple new skills per character, so play hard to learn all of them soon! See this one of Elsword’s:
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/gWoCq8dl.jpg[/IMG]

Here’s one of Rena’s:
 [IMG]http://i.imgur.com/AKAEQfAl.jpg[/IMG]

And a spectacular one of Aisha’s:
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/dkw72Fml.jpg[/IMG]
 

[b]Renewed Skill Tree and Points Structure[/b]
Experience the new skill tree, where you are required to make the choice between skills, but also where you can improve each skill up to Lv. 20! In order for you to do so, each time you level up you will earn 4 skill points, and more as you go higher. It’s intense!

[b]More Stuff!![/b]
You can also expect improvements on sealed skills, skill rings, and skill notes, as well as a selective character rebalance. See, it’s a pretty big deal of an update, so to help you make the most of it, there will also be events rewarding free skill reset items and an Elsword Online first—an all-in-one costume! See this version for Raven? Ooh, I can’t wait!

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/5UBO996l.png[/IMG]
 
[b]Turn Friends into Elpeeps[/b]
We’re also holding an exciting referral program for two weeks! If you created your account today or earlier, you can become an El Recruiter starting tomorrow by inviting a friend who has never played Elsword Online. The two of you can both earn a heap of in-game stuff! So gather your non-playing pals and help them thrive in Elsword Online for maximum returns! Check www.elswordonline.com for the mechanics and reward details after the scheduled maintenance.

[b]Bad Boys and Bad Girls[/b]
Misbehaving and looking good go together like a black leather jacket and spiky hair… or Eve and her drones in this brand new costume from the Item Mall:
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/xODrub2l.png[/IMG]

Get ready for these and more this November 6th!
